title: Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising for Robust Multi-view 3D Reconstruction
summary: Multi-view 3D reconstruction has achieved remarkable progress with the advent of feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. However, these models are typically trained and evaluated under ideal, degradation-free imaging conditions, whereas real-world observations often contain degradations that differ significantly from such settings. Improving robustness for multi-view 3D reconstruction under degraded conditions therefore remains an important challenge. We present Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising (GARD), a novel framework that performs diffusion-based multi-view restoration directly in the feature space of a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. This design exploits the geometry-aware feature representations of the 3D reconstructor to effectively recover accurate scene geometry. Furthermore, by employing an additional RGB image decoder, the refined representations can also be used to restore high-quality RGB images, thereby enabling the simultaneous recovery of 3D scene geometry and high-quality imagery. Comprehensive experiments on the Depth Anything 3 (DA3) benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GARD framework.

AI.tldr: GARD是一个在feed-forward 3D重建模型特征空间中进行扩散去噪的框架，能同时恢复3D场景几何和高质量RGB图像，在DA3基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式3D重建模型在理想无退化条件下训练，而真实世界观测常包含退化（如噪声、模糊等），提升多视图3D重建在退化条件下的鲁棒性是一个重要挑战。
AI.method: 提出GARD框架，在3D重建模型的特征空间中执行基于扩散的多视图恢复，利用重建模型的几何感知特征表示来恢复准确场景几何，并通过额外的RGB图像解码器同时恢复高质量图像。
AI.result: 在Depth Anything 3 (DA3)基准上的综合实验证明了GARD框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GARD通过特征空间扩散去噪实现了退化条件下3D几何与RGB图像的联合恢复，为提升前馈式3D重建模型的鲁棒性提供了有效方案。

title: Not All Modalities Are Equal: Instruction-Aware Gating for Multimodal Videos
summary: Pre-trained video large language models excel at visual reasoning. However, they struggle when videos arrive with auxiliary streams, such as audio, depth map, or dense temporal evidence. In such a scenario, uniform fusion induces modality interference, allowing irrelevant channels to distract the model. To address this issue, we present a unified multimodal video understanding framework, named UniMVU, that performs instruction-aware fusion across video, audio, depth map, or any other modality inputs via two levels of dynamic gating: inner-modality gates emphasize salient regions within each modality, whereas modality-level gates re-weight whole streams; both are conditioned on the text instruction to adaptively balance modality importance. Our UniMVU combines cross-modal self-attention with instruction-driven inner-modality gating module and a modality-level gating module with control token; for time-aligned streams we further adopt a fast-to-slow fusion scheme that reduces redundancy. Across six benchmarks (AVQA, AVSD, Music-AVQA, ScanQA, SQA3D and MVBench), our UniMVU achieves consistent gains over static-fusion baselines achieving gains as high as 13.5 in terms of CIDEr metric. Further, our analysis shows that the gating mechanism aligns with the human-interpretable modality relevance, and ablations show the contributions of inner-modality and modality-level gating. Our UniMVU provides a simple, unified recipe for instruction-aware multimodal video understanding that scales to diverse modalities without hand-crafted fusion rules.

AI.tldr: UniMVU是一个统一的多模态视频理解框架，通过指令感知的动态门控机制（包括内模态门控和模态级门控）实现视频、音频、深度图等多模态输入的融合，在六个基准测试上优于静态融合方法，最高CIDEr提升13.5。
AI.motivation: 现有视频大语言模型在处理附带音频、深度图等辅助流的视频时，统一融合会导致模态干扰，无关通道会分散模型注意力。
AI.method: 提出UniMVU框架，包含两个层次的动态门控：内模态门控（突出各模态内显著区域）和模态级门控（重新加权整个流），两者均以文本指令为条件自适应平衡模态重要性。结合跨模态自注意力、指令驱动的内模态门控模块、含控制令牌的模态级门控模块，以及针对时间对齐流的快慢融合方案。
AI.result: 在AVQA、AVSD、Music-AVQA、ScanQA、SQA3D和MVBench六个基准测试上，UniMVU一致优于静态融合基线，CIDEr指标最高提升13.5。门控机制与人类可解释的模态相关性一致，消融实验验证了两种门控的贡献。
AI.conclusion: UniMVU提供了一个简单、统一的指令感知多模态视频理解方案，可扩展到多种模态且无需手工设计的融合规则。

title: Sentinel: Embodied Cooperative Spatial Reasoning and Planning
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: In this work, we study Cooperative Spatial Intelligence, the ability of decentralized embodied agents to coordinate effectively under dynamic environmental constraints across city-scale outdoor domains. We introduce Sentinel Challenge, a benchmark where multiple decentralized embodied agents must communicate in natural language to agree on a mutually safe and convenient meeting point within large, city-scale outdoor environments. Each agent must then navigate safely while avoiding dynamic sentinels patrolling the area, using a tool that provides coarse spatial information. To address this, we propose CoSaR (Cooperative Spatial Reasoning and Planning), a framework that bridges the high-level communication and planning abilities of foundation models with the precision of classical spatial navigation algorithms. CoSaR enables agents to exchange situational updates, reason over evolving spatial constraints, and collaboratively replan trajectories. Evaluated across 14 city-level scenes with 3-5 agents, CoSaR consistently leads to faster gathering, shorter path lengths, and improved safety. Our results demonstrate that integrating dynamic communication with spatial reasoning is essential for robust multi-agent cooperation. By formalizing this new setting and providing a scalable benchmark, we aim to build a foundation for advancing cooperative spatial intelligence in embodied multi-agent systems. Code and challenge are available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/Sentinel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sentinel Challenge基准和CoSaR框架，用于解决城市场景中分散式具身智能体的协同空间推理与规划问题，实现多智能体在动态环境下的安全高效协作。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏针对城市级户外动态环境下多分散式具身智能体协同空间智能的标准化评估基准，亟需一个可扩展的测试平台和方法来推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 提出CoSaR框架，将大模型的高层通信与规划能力同经典空间导航算法的精度相结合，使智能体能通过自然语言交换情境更新、推理动态空间约束并协同重规划轨迹。同时构建包含14个城市场景、3-5个智能体的Sentinel Challenge基准。
AI.result: 在14个城市级场景中，CoSaR相比基线方法实现了更快的聚集速度、更短的路径长度以及更高的安全性，验证了动态通信与空间推理结合的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 集成动态通信与空间推理对鲁棒的多智能体协作至关重要，该工作为具身多智能体系统中的协同空间智能奠定了基础。

title: Self-Verified Distillation: Your Language Model Is Secretly Its Own Synthetic Data Pipeline
summary: Can post-trained large language models (LLMs) further improve themselves using only unlabeled prompts, without external teachers or feedback from tools? We study this setting starting only from unlabeled seed questions with no ground-truth solutions, across three reasoning domains: math, science, and coding. We propose Self-Verified Distillation, a simple post-training refinement algorithm in which the model generates candidate solutions to these seed questions, filters them using prompt-based self-verification, and trains on the resulting self-curated dataset. Inspired by the UQ benchmark's use of multiple validators to screen candidate answers to hard unsolved questions, we adapt this validation-based filtering idea to self-training: the model filters its own generated solutions through a three-stage cascade of cycle-consistency, factuality, and correctness checks, accepting a solution only if it passes all stages with unanimous judge votes. We find that sampling more candidate generations and using a larger verification budget during training data construction produces higher-quality self-curated data and, in turn, better reasoning models. We then train Qwen3 models at multiple scales with Self-Verified Distillation and obtain gains across all three domains. For Qwen3-4B, our method improves aggregate held-out pass@1 by +16.7 points in math (AIME26 and HMMT), +11.1 points in science (GPQA Diamond and HLE), and +8.3 points in coding (LCBv5 and LCBv6), with gains also extending to 0.6B and 8B models. Compared to our test-time-only baseline (UQ-TTC), which improves performance by spending extra compute at inference time, Self-Verified Distillation achieves better performance in most settings while requiring only a single inference call at test time.

AI.tldr: 提出自我验证蒸馏（Self-Verified Distillation）方法，让大语言模型仅利用无标注种子问题，通过自生成、自验证、自训练的方式提升推理能力，在数学、科学和编程三个领域取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 探索大语言模型在无外部教师、无工具反馈的情况下，能否仅靠无标注提示词自我改进，降低对昂贵人工标注或外部模型依赖。
AI.method: 提出Self-Verified Distillation算法：(1) 模型为种子问题生成候选解答；(2) 通过三级级联验证（循环一致性、事实性、正确性）进行自过滤；(3) 在自筛选的高质量数据集上训练。验证阶段采用多裁判一致投票机制，灵感来源于UQ基准测试。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列模型上实验，4B模型在数学（AIME26/HMMT）提升+16.7分，科学（GPQA Diamond/HLE）提升+11.1分，编程（LCBv5/v6）提升+8.3分；0.6B和8B模型同样有增益。相比测试时计算增强基线（UQ-TTC），本方法在大多数设置下表现更好且推理时仅需单次调用。
AI.conclusion: 通过自生成-自验证-自训练循环，大语言模型可以利用无标注数据实现自我提升，验证了自我蒸馏在推理任务中的有效性，且训练时增加采样量和验证预算可进一步提升效果。

title: RoMo: A Large-Scale, Richly Organized Dataset and Semantic Taxonomy for Human Motion Generation
summary: Success in generative modeling across language, image, and video demonstrates that large, well-curated datasets are the key driver for building capable models. 3D Human motion, however, has lagged behind, constrained by an unsatisfying choice between small, high-fidelity motion capture datasets and large-scale in-the-wild collections dominated by static or low-quality sequences. We introduce RoMo, a rich, large-scale, carefully curated dataset of in-the-wild human motions that resolves these tradeoffs. To ensure quality, we introduce a taxonomy-aware filtering pipeline that aggressively removes static and artifact-prone sequences. Every sequence is annotated with detailed captions and organized by a novel three-level semantic taxonomy. This hierarchical structure enables fine-grained, per-category evaluation, that reveals model strengths and weaknesses obscured by global metrics. We demonstrate that models trained on RoMo achieve state-of-the-art fidelity and diversity while gaining a superior understanding of complex, subtle text prompts. Finally, we release the Motion Toolbox to standardize metrics, data conversion, and visualization, establishing a foundation for reproducible and interpretable motion generation research.

AI.tldr: RoMo是一个大规模、高质量的自然场景人体运动数据集，通过分类感知过滤流水线去除静态和伪影序列，并配有三级语义分类体系和详细标注，训练出的模型在保真度、多样性和复杂文本理解上达到SOTA，同时开源了Motion Toolbox以标准化评估流程。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体运动数据集存在两难选择：小规模高质量运动捕捉数据 vs 大规模但低质量的自然场景数据，缺乏兼具规模与质量的数据集，阻碍了生成模型在这一领域的发展。
AI.method: 构建RoMo数据集：提出分类感知过滤流水线（taxonomy-aware filtering pipeline）激进去除静态和伪影序列；为每条序列标注详细描述；设计新颖的三级语义分类体系；发布Motion Toolbox标准化指标、数据转换和可视化。
AI.result: 基于RoMo训练的模型在保真度和多样性上达到SOTA，对复杂细微文本提示的理解能力更优；三级分类体系支持细粒度类别评估，揭示了全局指标无法发现的模型优缺点。
AI.conclusion: 高质量、大规模、精心标注的数据集是推动3D人体运动生成研究的关键，RoMo和Motion Toolbox为该领域提供了可复现、可解释的研究基础。

title: Pretraining Data Exposure in Large Language Models: A Survey of Membership Inference, Data Contamination, and Security Implications
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have become the predominant paradigm in NLP, advancing both research and industry. As model sizes and pretraining data grow, concerns about Pretraining Data Exposure (PDE) increase due to the scale and opacity of training datasets.
  PDE refers to determining whether specific data appeared in an LLM's pretraining corpus. It is critical for ensuring evaluation integrity and protecting privacy, intersecting two key areas: data contamination and membership inference. Though conceptually related, these areas have often been studied in isolation. This paper offers the first unified survey of both under the PDE framework. We formalize PDE across exposure levels, review attack and defense methods, synthesize empirical findings, and highlight open challenges and future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将数据污染和成员推断统一到预训练数据暴露（PDE）框架下，对LLM预训练数据暴露问题进行了全面综述，包括形式化定义、攻击与防御方法、实证发现及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM规模和预训练数据不断增长，训练数据集的规模和透明度引发了对预训练数据暴露（PDE）的担忧，而数据污染和成员推断这两个相关领域此前常被孤立研究，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 通过统一综述的方式，将数据污染和成员推断纳入PDE框架，从暴露级别形式化PDE，系统梳理攻击与防御方法，并综合实证发现。
AI.result: 提供了首个统一的PDE综述，涵盖了形式化定义、方法分类、实证分析及开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: PDE是确保评估完整性和保护隐私的关键问题，未来需要在统一框架下进一步探索攻击与防御方法，并解决开放挑战。

title: Can LLMs Introspect? A Reality Check
summary:
Can large language models detect and report their own internal states? A number of studies have argued that the answer to this question is yes. We argue, based on lessons from human metacognition research, that this conclusion may be premature: to be convinced of this conclusion we need to distinguish genuine introspection from pattern matching based on surface-level cues. Furthermore, we argue that behavioral evidence alone is inherently insufficient to establish strong introspective claims.
  We re-examine two recently introduced evaluation paradigms in light of this consideration. In the first paradigm, models are expected to detect whether their internal states have been tampered with. We find that models cannot reliably distinguish such interventions on their internal states from manipulations of the input, suggesting that their success in the original studies reflects their ability to detect anomalies more generally, as opposed to interventions on their internal states in particular. In the second paradigm we examine, models are tasked with predicting labels derived from their own hidden states. Here, we find that classifiers that only have access to the input achieve equivalent performance to the model's own in-context predictions, indicating that the original results do not conclusively demonstrate that the model has privileged access to its internal representations. We further introduce a relabeled control setting, where models cannot rely on the semantics of the task to solve it, and instead must rely on the internal representation; models perform closer to chance on this better-controlled version of the task. Taken together, these results indicate that current evidence is insufficient to establish that LLMs display metacognitive monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑当前研究声称大语言模型（LLM）能检测和报告自身内部状态（即具有内省能力）的结论。通过借鉴人类元认知研究的经验，作者区分了真正的内省与基于表面线索的模式匹配，指出行为证据本身不足以证明内省能力。通过重新审视两种评估范式（检测内部状态被篡改、预测源自自身隐藏状态的标签），作者发现模型的表现更可能是检测输入异常或匹配表面语义，而非真正的内部状态监控。引入更好的控制实验后，模型表现接近随机水平，表明当前证据不足以证明LLM具备元认知监控能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究声称LLM能够检测和报告自身内部状态，但作者认为这一结论可能为时过早。借鉴人类元认知研究的教训，需要区分真正的内省与基于表面线索的模式匹配，并且行为证据本身不足以建立强内省主张。
AI.method: 作者重新审视了两种评估范式：(1) 检测内部状态是否被篡改的任务，通过对比内部状态干预与输入操作，检验模型是否能区分两者；(2) 模型预测源自自身隐藏状态的标签任务，通过对比仅访问输入的分类器与模型自身上下文预测的表现，以及引入重标号控制设置（消除语义依赖），检验模型是否具有特权内部访问。
AI.result: (1) 模型无法可靠区分内部状态干预与输入操作，其成功表现源于检测异常的一般能力，而非特定的内部状态监控。(2) 仅访问输入的分类器能达到与模型自身上下文预测相当的表现；在消除语义依赖的重标号控制设置中，模型表现接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 当前证据不足以证明LLM具有元认知监控能力。现有研究未能排除模型依赖表面线索或输入语义而非真正内省的可能性，需要更严格的控制实验来验证模型的内部状态感知能力。

title: LongAV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation of Minute-Scale Audio-Visual Generation Across T2AV, I2AV, and V2AV
summary: Audio-visual generation is rapidly advancing from short clips to minute-long content, while existing evaluation protocols remain largely confined to short-form settings. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on 5--10 second text-conditioned generation and rarely support unified evaluation across text, image, and video conditioning modalities. Moreover, they provide limited insight into how identity consistency, narrative coherence, and audio-visual alignment degrade over extended temporal horizons. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongAV-Compass, a systematic benchmark for minute-long audio-visual generation. LongAV-Compass contains 284 curated test cases spanning text-to-audio-video (T2AV), image-to-audio-video (I2AV), and video-to-audio-video (V2AV), organized by application scenario and generation complexity. The benchmark combines taxonomy-guided benchmark construction with a unified evaluation framework that integrates MLLM-assisted assessment with complementary perceptual and multimodal metrics, including DINO-v2, ArcFace, CLIP, and ImageBind. The framework evaluates more than 20 fine-grained dimensions covering within-segment quality, cross-segment consistency, global narrative coherence, semantic alignment, and audio-visual synchronization. Through experiments on 11 representative models together with human-alignment validation, LongAV-Compass provides a diagnostic testbed for analyzing the limitations of current systems in sustaining coherent, semantically aligned, and temporally consistent minute-scale audio-visual generation across diverse input modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出了LongAV-Compass，一个用于分钟级音视频生成的系统评估基准，涵盖多种输入模态和20+细粒度评估维度。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频生成评估主要针对5-10秒的短片段，缺乏对分钟级长内容中身份一致性、叙事连贯性和音视频对齐度随时间退化的评估能力。
AI.method: 构建了284个测试用例，覆盖T2AV、I2AV、V2AV三种模态；设计了结合MLLM辅助评估与DINO-v2、ArcFace、CLIP、ImageBind等多模态指标的评估框架，包含20+细粒度维度。
AI.result: 在11个代表性模型上进行了实验，并进行了人工对齐验证，证明了该基准的诊断能力。
AI.conclusion: LongAV-Compass为分析当前系统在分钟级音视频生成中维持连贯性、语义对齐和时间一致性的局限性提供了系统性诊断测试平台。

title: SPEAR: Code-Augmented Agentic Prompt Optimization
summary: Automatic prompt engineering (APE) rewrites prompts to improve downstream task performance, but existing APE loops treat the optimizer itself as a fixed pipeline. We port the code-as-action paradigm of CodeAct (Wang et al., 2024a) to APE and propose SPEAR (Sandboxed Prompt Engineer with Active Roll-back), a free-form agentic optimizer with four tools -- evaluate, python, set_prompt, finish -- that decides autonomously how and when to use them. The distinctive tool is the Python sandbox: the optimizer writes and executes arbitrary Python on the current evaluation DataFrame, performing structural error analysis (confusion matrices, error clustering, per group metrics) the agent itself authors. Two guardrails turn the long-horizon agent into a monotone-improving optimizer: auto-rollback on metric regression, and an optional guard metric floor. We evaluate on three industrial LLM-as-judge suites (13 judge tasks across recruiter-intake, conversational-memory, and query-refinement systems) plus seven BBH tasks and GSM8K. SPEAR wins every industrial task on the primary metric ($κ$ 0.857 vs 0.359 on tool-selection; F1-macro 0.815 vs 0.763 on filter-relevance; $κ$ 0.254 vs 0.218 on the hardest extraction dimension). On BBH-7 SPEAR averages 0.938 accuracy vs GEPA 0.628 and TextGrad 0.484. Ablations show the Python tool is the largest single lever on complex judge tasks ($Δ\approx +0.79κ$ on the 5-class tool-selection judge, $Δ\approx +0.35κ$ on the hardest extraction dimension when removed); its irreplaceable contribution is class-pair confusion aggregation that a long-context LLM cannot extract reliably from the raw eval DataFrame.

AI.tldr: 提出SPEAR，一种将代码即行动范式引入自动提示工程的自由形式智能优化器，通过Python沙箱执行结构化错误分析，并采用自动回滚等安全机制，在多个工业任务和基准测试上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有APE方法将优化器本身视为固定流水线，缺乏灵活性和自适应能力，无法充分利用执行环境进行深度分析。
AI.method: 将CodeAct的代码即行动范式引入APE，设计SPEAR智能体，包含四个工具（evaluate、python、set_prompt、finish），核心创新是Python沙箱允许优化器自主编写和执行代码进行结构化错误分析，并设置自动回滚和指标下限两道安全机制。
AI.result: 在13个工业评判任务上全面胜出（工具选择κ 0.857 vs 0.359，过滤相关性F1-macro 0.815 vs 0.763）；BBH-7平均准确率0.938远超GEPA的0.628和TextGrad的0.484；消融实验显示Python工具是最关键组件。
AI.conclusion: 赋予优化器代码执行能力进行结构化错误分析是提升APE效果的关键，尤其是长上下文LLM难以从原始评估数据中可靠提取的类别对混淆聚合信息。

title: Is Agent Memory a Database? Rethinking Data Foundations for Long-Term AI Agent Memory
summary: Long-running AI agents need persistent memory. Memory supports learning across sessions, reduces repeated context injection, and enables auditing of past decisions. Current agent memory systems and database paradigms treat memory as storage. They localize correctness at records, embeddings, or edges. Each supplies only some of the capabilities that long-term memory requires. The result is four recurring failure modes: unregulated growth, missing semantic revision, capacity-driven forgetting, and read-only retrieval. In our vision, long-term agent memory is a new data-management workload. Its correctness is a property of the state trajectory, not of individual records. We formalize this as Governed Evolving Memory (GEM). GEM replaces record-level database operations with four state-level operators: ingestion, revision, forgetting, and retrieval. Six correctness conditions govern how the state evolves. Three structural observations establish that no record-level system can satisfy these conditions, regardless of the storage model. We realize the abstraction in MemState, a prototype on a property-graph backend. MemState validates feasibility and exposes the gap to a native engine. We outline three research directions that define memory-centric data management as a workload.

AI.tldr: 本文提出长期AI代理记忆应被视为一种新的数据管理工作负载，并形式化为受控演化记忆（GEM），通过四个状态级操作和六个正确性条件来克服现有记录级系统的四个常见失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的代理记忆系统和数据库范式将记忆视为存储，在记录、嵌入或边层面上追求正确性，导致四个重复出现的失败模式：无节制增长、缺乏语义修正、容量驱动的遗忘和只读检索。亟需一种新的数据管理视角来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义了受控演化记忆（GEM），将记录级数据库操作替换为四个状态级操作（摄取、修正、遗忘和检索），并定义了六个正确性条件来约束状态演化。通过三个结构性观察证明任何记录级系统都无法满足这些条件，并在属性图后端上实现了原型MemState。
AI.result: 通过MemState原型验证了GEM抽象层的可行性，并揭示了与原生引擎之间的差距。三个结构性观察从理论上证明了记录级系统（无论存储模型如何）无法满足GEM的正确性条件。
AI.conclusion: 长期AI代理记忆应被视为一种新的数据管理工作负载，GEM框架为这一方向提供了理论基础。未来需要在三个方面进行深入研究，以定义以记忆为中心的数据管理。

title: Dimensional Distribution Emotion State: Leveraging Valence and Arousal as a Common Embedding Space for Visual Emotion Analysis
summary: Museums are important sites for the dissemination of culture and art. They are institutions rooted in history and tradition; their exhibitions are often designed to highlight these aspects. Recently, a new approach is being explored in the field: emotion-based exhibitions. These exhibitions are designed specifically to elicit emotions in the visitors, in order to maximize engagement, and as a way to democratize access to art and attract a wider, more diverse audience. To do so, the emotional content of the artworks must first be extracted, however, manually annotating the artworks by experts is a prohibitively labor-intensive process, and risks introducing the personal bias of curators. To assist the museum curators in their design of these exhibitions, we wish to develop a tool that can predict the emotional response evoked by a work of art. In this article, we leverage a continuous bi-dimensional emotion space to enhance emotion representations and the training process of deep learning models. Drawing inspiration from existing categorical and dimensional emotion representations, we introduce a new representation, Dimensional Distribution Emotion State (DDES), along with a pipeline for multi-dataset training. We show that DDES provides multiple advantages compared to widely used representations while exhibiting similar baseline performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的情感表征方法DDES，用于预测艺术品引发的观众情感反应，辅助策展人设计基于情感的展览。
AI.motivation: 传统博物馆展览注重历史与传承，新兴的情感化展览需自动提取艺术品的情感内容，但人工标注成本高且存在策展人偏见。
AI.method: 利用连续二维情感空间，结合分类与维度情感表征，提出Dimensional Distribution Emotion State (DDES) 表征及多数据集训练流程。
AI.result: DDES在保持基线性能的同时，相比广泛使用的表征方法提供了多种优势。
AI.conclusion: DDES是一种有效的情感表征方法，有助于开发预测艺术品情感反应的自动化工具，推动情感化展览设计。

title: CroCo: Cross-Lingual Contrastive Preference Tuning on Self-Generations
summary: Prior work establishes that controlled contrastiveness between self-generated responses from large language models, set via reward scores, improves downstream preference tuning in English. We extend this method to multiple languages and evaluate two models across a total of 14 high and low-resource languages on a diverse set of tasks. Our central finding is that cross-lingual contrastive preference tuning on self-generations (CroCo) transfers without language-specific preference annotation. A reward model trained on English preferences (atop a multilingual base) produces useful within-language rankings across most languages, and pairing in either a monolingual or multilingual setting improves over each model on the majority of setups while preventing the catastrophic forgetting of supervised fine-tuning. We observe that the gains require on-policy data. Off-policy responses reduce the benefit and online preference optimization fails to improve over the offline variant. Specifically, on structured tasks, our method matches or exceeds the base in 6/7 languages for EuroLLM-9B and 4/7 settings for Aya-3B. On open-ended generation, both tuned models win against their respective base across 11 evaluated languages. Overall, we show promising directions for multilingual preference tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨语言对比偏好调优方法(CroCo)，利用基于英语偏好的奖励模型对多语言模型的自生成响应进行排序，无需语言特定的偏好标注，在14种高、低资源语言上提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 已有的对比偏好调优方法仅在英语上有效，但多语言场景下缺乏语言特定的偏好标注数据，需要一种无需额外标注即可跨语言迁移偏好调优的方法。
AI.method: 提出CroCo方法：使用基于英语偏好训练的奖励模型（基于多语言基础模型）对多语言模型的自生成响应进行排序，并在单语或多语设置下进行对比偏好调优，且必须使用on-policy数据。
AI.result: 在EuroLLM-9B和Aya-3B两个模型上，覆盖14种语言。结构化任务中：EuroLLM-9B在6/7语言上匹配或超过基线，Aya-3B在4/7设置上提升。开放生成任务中：两个模型在11种评估语言上均优于基线。同时验证了on-policy数据的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言对比偏好调优(CroCo)是一种有前景的多语言偏好调优方向，无需语言特定偏好标注即可实现跨语言迁移，且能避免监督微调的灾难性遗忘。

title: Personalizing Embodied Multimodal Large Language Model Agents over Long-term User Interactions
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based embodied agents have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks in physical environments. However, personalized assistance requires more than following generic instruction or recognizing object categories. In real-world scenarios, the intended target is often specified only implicitly through prior interactions, requiring agents to leverage personalized context accumulated over time. In this work, we propose POLAR, a multiomodal memory-augmented framework for personalized embodied agents over long-term user interactions. POLAR organizes prior interactions into a multimodal knowledge graph that captures semantic memory for personalized context and visual concepts, and episodic memory for embodied experiences such as agent trajectories. To execute embodied tasks, POLAR retrieves relevant memories to interpret the current request and guide task execution. We evaluate POLAR across multiple MLLM backbones and diverse evaluation scenarios to study the role of memory in long-term personalization. Results show that the proposed memory mechanism consistently improves performance by enabling more effective use of information accumulated over prior interactions. The gains are especially pronounced when the agents are required to reason across multiple interactions, perform multi-hop inference, or tracking updates in user-specific context over time.

AI.tldr: POLAR是一种基于多模态记忆增强的框架，通过构建多模态知识图谱（整合语义记忆和情景记忆），使具身智能体能够在长期用户交互中利用累积的个性化上下文来更有效地执行复杂任务，尤其在多轮推理和多跳推断场景中表现显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM具身智能体依赖通用指令或物体类别识别，无法利用长期交互中积累的个性化上下文信息（如用户隐式指定的目标），导致在真实场景中个性化辅助能力不足。
AI.method: 提出POLAR框架，将先前的交互组织成多模态知识图谱，包含：（1）语义记忆——存储个性化上下文和视觉概念；（2）情景记忆——存储具身体验（如智能体轨迹）。在执行任务时，检索相关记忆来解读当前请求并指导执行。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM主干网络和多种评估场景中，POLAR的记忆机制一致性地提升了任务性能，尤其在需要跨交互推理、多跳推断或随时间追踪用户上下文更新的场景中增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 多模态记忆机制能够有效利用长期交互中积累的信息，显著增强具身智能体在复杂个性化任务中的表现，为长期人机交互中的个性化辅助提供了有效方案。

title: Constraint acquisition needs better benchmarks
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, for the associated dataset, see https://github.com/MPMMine/MPMMine
summary: Constraint Acquisition (CA) and related research on the validation and enhancement of Mathematical Programming (MP) models from domain knowledge artifacts are currently limited by inadequate benchmarks. This deficiency impedes reproducibility and cross-study comparability, slowing the maturation of CA methods. Existing benchmarks were designed for solver evaluation rather than for assessing CA algorithms. They are loosely organized, treat individual problems inconsistently, and omit the domain knowledge artifacts required by CA methods. This work presents MPMMine, a benchmark suite designed to assess algorithms that discover, validate, and enhance MP models using diverse domain knowledge artifacts. MPMMine is guided by consistency, standardization, completeness, extensibility, openness, and version control. It adopts a uniform structure and relies on open formats: MiniZinc, CommonMark, and JSON. It provides multiple models per problem, tens of instances per model, and thousands of solutions and non-solutions in both integer and continuous domains, alongside natural-language descriptions to support text-to-model methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MPMMine基准套件，旨在解决约束获取和数学规划模型验证领域因缺乏标准化基准而导致的可重复性差和跨研究比较困难的问题。该套件采用统一结构，基于MiniZinc、CommonMark和JSON开放格式，提供多模型、多实例、数千个解与非解数据及自然语言描述，支持算法发现、验证和增强MP模型。
AI.motivation: 当前约束获取及数学规划模型验证与增强研究受限于不充分的基准测试集，现有基准是为求解器评估而非CA算法设计的，缺乏组织一致性、缺少领域知识工件，导致可重复性差和跨研究比较困难，阻碍了该领域的成熟发展。
AI.method: MPMMine遵循一致性、标准化、完备性、可扩展性、开放性和版本控制原则，采用统一结构，基于MiniZinc、CommonMark和JSON开放格式构建。每个问题提供多个模型，每个模型配备数十个实例，包含整数和连续域中的数千个解与非解，并附带自然语言描述以支持文本到模型方法。
AI.result: 构建了MPMMine基准套件，提供了多模型、多实例、大量解与非解数据以及自然语言描述，覆盖整数和连续域，支持多种CA方法评估。
AI.conclusion: MPMMine通过标准化和开放格式填补了CA和MP模型验证领域基准不足的空白，有望提升该领域的可重复性和跨研究可比性，推动方法的成熟发展。

title: RICE-PO: Turning Retrieval Interactions into Credit Signals for Reasoning Agents
summary: Retrieval is increasingly moving from one-shot matching toward interactive reasoning, where language agents iteratively inspect evidence, reformulate queries, and search again. Training such agents raises a credit-assignment challenge: executable actions such as queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by the retriever, while latent reasoning steps are not directly observable and only affect future executable actions. This asymmetry makes outcome-level reward assignment unreliable, as the same final reward may credit reasoning steps that did not actually shape retrieval success. We propose RICE-PO, a critic-free policy optimization framework that converts retrieval interactions into localized learning signals. RICE-PO selects high-uncertainty executable actions as anchors, evaluates local counterfactual branches using retrieval metrics, and propagates credit to latent reasoning steps only when reasoning-to-action influence is strong and future residual effects are stable. On BRIGHT and BEIR, RICE-PO consistently outperforms prompt-based agents and group-based RL baselines under the same retriever setting. These results show that the structure of agent-environment interaction itself can provide useful supervision for training reasoning-based retrieval agents.

AI.tldr: 提出RICE-PO框架，通过将检索交互转化为局部学习信号，在不依赖奖励模型的情况下训练推理型检索智能体，解决推理步骤的信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 检索正从一次性匹配转向交互式推理，但训练此类智能体面临信用分配难题：可执行动作（如查询）可直接评估，而隐式推理步骤不可直接观测，导致最终奖励无法可靠地归因于真正影响检索成功的推理步骤。
AI.method: RICE-PO是一种无批评器的策略优化框架，选取高不确定性的可执行动作作为锚点，利用检索指标评估局部反事实分支，仅在推理到动作的影响力强且未来残差效应稳定时，才将信用传播给隐式推理步骤。
AI.result: 在BRIGHT和BEIR数据集上，RICE-PO在相同检索器设置下一致优于基于提示的智能体和基于分组的强化学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 智能体-环境交互的结构本身可以为训练基于推理的检索智能体提供有效的监督信号。

title: Your Agents Are Aging Too: Agent Lifespan Engineering for Deployed Systems
summary: Long-lived AI agents are increasingly deployed as persistent operational systems, yet they are still evaluated like freshly initialized models. Day-one benchmarks miss a basic systems question: how long does an agent remain reliable after deployment? Even when model weights are frozen, an agent's effective state keeps changing as it compresses interaction history, retrieves from a growing memory store, revises facts after updates, and undergoes routine maintenance. Reliability therefore becomes a lifespan property of the full agent harness, not only a snapshot property of the base model. We introduce AgingBench, a longitudinal reliability benchmark for agent lifespan engineering: measuring not only whether deployed agents degrade, but what form the degradation takes and where repair should target. AgingBench organizes agent aging into four mechanisms: compression aging, interference aging, revision aging, and maintenance aging. To diagnose these failures, AgingBench uses temporal dependency graphs and paired counterfactual probes that produce diagnostic profiles for the write, retrieval, and utilization stages of the memory pipeline. Across 7 scenarios, 14 models, multiple memory policies, and both runner-controlled and autonomous agents, over ~400 runs spanning 8 - 200 sessions show that agent aging is not one-dimensional: behavioral tests can remain clean while factual precision decays; derived-state tracking can collapse sharply within a single model; and the same wrong answer can require different repairs depending on what the diagnostic profile points to. These results suggest that reliable agent deployment requires lifespan evaluation, mechanism-level diagnosis, and stage-targeted repair, not only stronger day-one models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgingBench，一个用于评估AI智能体长期部署后可靠性衰减的纵向基准，通过四种老化机制和诊断工具揭示智能体性能退化并非单一维度，需要生命周期评估和针对性修复。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体评估仍停留在"部署首日"的静态基准测试上，忽略了智能体在长期运行中因交互历史压缩、记忆增长、事实修订和维护操作导致的性能衰减问题。
AI.method: AgingBench将智能体老化分为压缩老化、干扰老化、修订老化和维护老化四种机制，使用时间依赖图和配对反事实探针对记忆管道的写入、检索和利用三个阶段进行诊断分析。
AI.result: 在7个场景、14个模型、多种记忆策略下进行约400次运行（8-200个会话），发现智能体老化是多维度的：行为测试正常但事实精度下降，派生状态追踪可能急剧崩溃，相同错误答案需要不同修复方案。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的智能体部署需要生命周期评估、机制级诊断和阶段针对性修复，而不仅仅是增强"首日"模型能力。

title: In-Context Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Gradient-Descent Perspective
summary: In-context learning has recently been linked to implicit gradient descent in linear self-attention models, suggesting that context can induce a forward-pass update. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also relies on context, but retrieved documents are usually treated as static evidence rather than signals for adaptation. We study RAG as an in-context optimization process. First, we show that one linear self-attention layer can implement one gradient-descent step on a unified linearized RAG objective covering both projection-based and dot-product retrieval interfaces. This gives an exact regime where retrieval-augmented prediction and in-context optimization coincide. We use this result not as a literal model of LLM computation, but as a guide for adapting the interaction between queries and retrieved evidence. We then test the boundary of this correspondence: it remains stable under controlled linear extensions, but becomes feature-distribution dependent under nonlinear architectures. Finally, we turn this view into a lightweight method for frozen RAG LLMs. The method keeps the retriever and backbone fixed, and predicts a context-conditioned update to a generator-side evidence-use interface. Across seven QA benchmarks, two retrievers, and two frozen LLM backbones, this forward-only update improves a shared-interface baseline, transfers to held-out tasks, and approaches test-time gradient adaptation at much lower per-query cost.

AI.tldr: 本文证明线性自注意力层可在统一RAG目标上实现梯度下降，并将RAG视为上下文中的优化过程，进而提出一种轻量级前向更新方法，在冻结LLM上显著提升检索增强性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG将检索文档视为静态证据，而上下文学习（ICL）已被证明与隐式梯度下降相关。作者希望弥合这一差距，将RAG重新理解为一种上下文中的优化过程，从而启发更高效的交互设计。
AI.method: 1. 理论证明：线性自注意力层可精确实现一步梯度下降，作用于统一线性化RAG目标（覆盖投影式和点积式检索接口）。2. 边界测试：在线性扩展下该对应关系稳定，但在非线性架构下变得依赖于特征分布。3. 实际方法：提出前向更新方法，保持检索器和骨干网络冻结，预测上下文条件化的更新以调整生成器侧的证据使用接口。
AI.result: 在7个QA基准、2种检索器和2种冻结LLM骨干上，该方法优于共享接口基线，可迁移到未见任务，并以更低的单次查询成本逼近测试时梯度微调的性能。
AI.conclusion: RAG可被视为上下文优化过程，该理论洞察可转化为冻结LLM的轻量级前向更新策略，在保持效率的同时显著提升检索增强预测性能。

title: Experiments in Agentic AI for Science
summary: This paper details two novel frameworks for developing autonomous, agentic AI in scientific workflows. Both systems leverage a hybrid Local Body, Remote Brain architecture via Google Colab, utilizing Python-based local orchestrators to invoke large language model (LLM) cloud backends. The first agent, DeepTS/DeepCollector, automates the large-scale curation, extraction, and deduplication of time-series datasets. The second, DeepScribe, is an autonomous presentation analyzer that converts visually dense, mathematically complex physics lectures into structured scientific reports. Through practical systems engineering-such as granular attribute extraction (Cellular RAG), remote data inspection, and distributed concurrency controls-we demonstrate how agentic AI can overcome the context and reasoning limitations of current state-of-the-art systems to rigorously support scientific workflows. Finally, we outline a generalization of DeepTS to support deep knowledge graphs and discuss the application of this conceptual approach to high-energy physics (DeepQCD).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两个基于"本地身体+远程大脑"混合架构的自主AI代理框架：DeepTS/DeepCollector（自动化时间序列数据集管理）和DeepScribe（自动将物理讲座转化为结构化报告），通过系统工程方法克服了现有系统的上下文和推理限制。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的AI系统在科学工作流中存在上下文长度和推理能力的局限性，无法有效支持大规模、高复杂度的科学任务。
AI.method: 采用混合"本地身体+远程大脑"架构，通过Google Colab平台，使用Python本地编排器调用LLM云后端；具体技术包括粒度属性提取（Cellular RAG）、远程数据检查和分布式并发控制。
AI.result: 成功构建了两个自主AI代理：DeepTS/DeepCollector实现时间序列数据集的大规模自动整理、提取和去重；DeepScribe实现将高密度、数学复杂的物理讲座自动转化为结构化科学报告。
AI.conclusion: 代理AI通过系统工程方法能够有效克服当前LLM的上下文和推理限制；未来将把DeepTS推广到深度知识图谱，并将该概念方法应用于高能物理（DeepQCD）。

title: Why LLMs Hallucinate on Structured Knowledge: A Mechanistic Analysis of Reasoning over Linearized Representations
comment: To appear in Proceedings of ACL 2026
summary: In many reasoning tasks, large language models (LLMs) rely on structured external knowledge, such as graphs and tables, which is typically linearized into sequential token representations. However, even when sufficient knowledge is available, LLMs can still produce hallucinated outputs, and the underlying mechanisms behind such failures remain poorly understood. We investigate these mechanisms and find that hallucinations arise from systematic internal dynamics rather than random noise. First, attention disproportionately concentrates toward shortcut-like structural cues rather than distributing across the full context. Second, feed-forward representations fail to ground the provided knowledge, causing the model to revert to parametric memory. Moreover, our results indicate that hallucination is consistently associated with failures in semantic grounding within feed-forward layers, while attention allocation exhibits greater task-dependent variability. Finally, we show that these mechanistic patterns generalize beyond single-hop graphs to multi-hop and tabular settings, enabling effective hallucination detection across structured knowledge formats.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大语言模型在处理结构化外部知识（如图表、表格）时产生幻觉的机制，发现幻觉源于注意力集中在捷径式结构线索而非完整上下文，以及前馈表示未能将知识有效接地，导致模型回退到参数化记忆。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM具备足够的结构化知识，但仍会产生幻觉输出，且其背后的机制尚不清楚，因此需要深入探究这些失败的内在原因。
AI.method: 通过分析LLM在处理结构化知识时的内部动态，包括注意力分布和前馈层表示，研究幻觉与捷径式结构线索、语义接地失败之间的关联。
AI.result: 发现幻觉由系统性的内部动态引起：注意力过度集中在捷径式结构线索上，前馈表示未能接地知识，导致模型回退到参数记忆；幻觉与前馈层的语义接地失败一致相关，而注意力分配则表现出任务依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 这些机制模式不仅适用于单跳图，还能推广到多跳图和表格设置，为跨结构化知识格式的幻觉检测提供了有效方法。

title: Cultural Value Alignment Via Latent Activation Steering in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit homogenized cultural perspectives. While the World Values Survey (WVS) provides a gold standard for mapping human values, traditional direct prompting of LLMs on WVS often fails to access the model's latent cultural depth, leading to safety-aligned refusals or neutral responses. Here, we propose a generalizable framework for cultural evaluation and intervention that transitions from abstract queries to scenario-based behavioral probing. By extracting implicit token probabilities across 300 situational dilemmas, we bypass surface-level alignment to map the latent coordinates of LLMs cultural value. We further introduce activation steering to shift these internal alignments during the forward pass without retraining. Across multiple LLMs, we find substantial variation in adaptability and uncover a consistent phenomenon of latent entanglement, where interventions along one cultural dimension induce shifts along another. These results suggest that cultural values are encoded as coupled structures, limiting precise alignment. This work establishes a computationally efficient framework for cultural steering, highlighting the structural complexities when navigating global value with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从抽象查询转向情景行为探测的通用框架，通过提取300个情境困境中的隐含token概率来绘制LLM的文化价值潜在坐标，并引入激活引导技术在不重新训练的情况下调整内部对齐，揭示了文化价值编码的耦合结构及其导致的潜在纠缠现象。
AI.motivation: LLM常表现出同质化的文化视角，传统直接提示方法难以获取模型的潜在文化深度，容易导致安全对齐的拒绝或中性回应。
AI.method: 提出从抽象查询转向情景行为探测的通用框架，通过提取300个情境困境中的隐含token概率来绘制LLM文化价值的潜在坐标，并引入激活引导技术在前向传播中调整内部对齐。
AI.result: 发现不同LLM的适应性存在显著差异，并揭示了一致的潜在纠缠现象，即对一个文化维度的干预会引发另一个维度的偏移。
AI.conclusion: 文化价值以耦合结构编码，限制了精确对齐的可能性；本研究建立了一个计算高效的文化引导框架，揭示了全球价值观导航中的结构性复杂性。

title: OmniToM: Benchmarking Theory of Mind in LLMs via Explicit Belief Modeling
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer others' knowledge, intentions, and emotions, is commonly evaluated in large language models (LLMs) using end-point question answering, where performance is judged solely by the final answer to a social reasoning query. This paradigm obscures whether the model actually constructs the underlying mental-state representations required for robust reasoning, particularly in scenarios involving divergent, evolving, or mistaken beliefs. In order to address this research gap, we introduce OmniToM, a benchmark that directly evaluates these representations by requiring explicit modeling of belief structures for all relevant actors within a narrative. These structures are composed of belief propositions: minimal statements of what an actor takes to be true about the world or another actor's mental state, allowing knowledge, intentions, emotions, and false beliefs to be analyzed in a common format. Models are evaluated in two stages: Stage 1: Belief Extraction, which extracts from the story the beliefs relevant to its social dynamics, and Stage 2: Belief Labeling, which assigns each belief a seven-dimensional schema label covering recursive order, truth status, knowledge access, explicitness, content type, mental source, and context. Built from 895 stories from the existing ToMBench story corpus and augmented with 22,343 labeled belief propositions, OmniToM uses a human-calibrated LLM-assisted annotation pipeline. Across diverse models in zero-shot evaluation, OmniToM reveals an actor-specific belief-tracking bottleneck: current LLMs struggle with the knowledge-access and representational decisions required to transform narrative facts into actors' beliefs and shared mental states.

AI.tldr: OmniToM是一个评估大语言模型心智理论能力的基准，通过显式建模叙事中所有相关角色的信念结构（信念命题）来评估，包含信念提取和信念标注两个阶段，揭示了当前LLMs在角色特定信念追踪方面的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基于端点问答的ToM评估范式仅看最终答案，无法检验模型是否真正构建了底层的心智状态表征，尤其是在涉及分歧、演变或错误信念的场景中。
AI.method: 构建OmniToM基准：从ToMBench故事语料库提取895个故事，通过人类校准的LLM辅助注释流程标注22,343个信念命题。评估分两阶段：Stage 1信念提取（提取与社会动态相关的信念）和Stage 2信念标注（为每个信念分配7维模式标签，包括递归阶次、真值状态、知识访问、明确性、内容类型、心智来源和上下文）。
AI.result: 零样本评估显示，当前LLMs存在actor-specific信念追踪瓶颈，特别在将叙事事实转化为角色信念和共享心智状态所需的知识访问和表征决策方面表现困难。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLMs在显式建模角色信念结构方面存在根本性缺陷，OmniToM为更细粒度评估ToM能力提供了新的范式。

title: Memory Architectures for Multi-Turn Text-to-SQL: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables; includes appendices with verbatim prompts, example session, and full ablation tables; prepared by the LLM Suite Engineering Team, JP Morgan Chase & Co
summary: Multi-turn Text-to-SQL is central to enterprise analytics yet remains predominantly evaluated in single-turn settings. We introduce EnterpriseMem-Bench, a multi-turn Text-to-SQL benchmark of 300 sessions and 1,400 turns built programmatically from three enterprise domains (BIRD financial, SEC EDGAR, Northwind), with deterministic ground truth and per-turn memory-critical annotation. We evaluate five frontier models -- GPT-5 mini, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 4.6 -- across five memory conditions enabling a three-way ablation isolating working-memory window size, episodic retrieval, and semantic augmentation as independent effects. All Claude models are evaluated with extended thinking enabled to maintain parity with GPT reasoning models. We introduce the Memory Benefit Score (MBS) as a per-turn diagnostic metric. Four findings emerge: (1) stateless multi-turn Text-to-SQL collapses to zero execution accuracy by Turn 3 across all five models, even under reasoning; (2) memory-architecture complexity does not monotonically improve accuracy -- working memory dominates, and additional components produce model- and dataset-dependent effects from +14 to -16 percentage points; (3) Claude Sonnet 4.6 underperforms Sonnet 4.5 by 17-33pp on SEC EDGAR across conditions, a generational regression persisting under reasoning; (4) under reasoning, Claude error distributions become mono-modal -- every non-correct turn is a wrong-result error. We release the benchmark, agent, and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EnterpriseMem-Bench，一个多轮Text-to-SQL基准测试，包含300个会话和1400轮。评估了5个前沿模型在5种记忆条件下的表现。主要发现：无状态多轮Text-to-SQL在第三轮后准确率归零；工作记忆主导性能，其他组件效果因模型而异；Claude Sonnet 4.6在SEC EDGAR上比Sonnet 4.5出现代际倒退；推理模式下Claude的错误分布变为单模态。
AI.motivation: 多轮Text-to-SQL对企业分析至关重要，但现有评估主要局限于单轮设置，缺乏针对多轮场景中记忆能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建了包含300个会话、1400轮的EnterpriseMem-Bench基准，来自三个企业领域（BIRD金融、SEC EDGAR、Northwind）。设计5种记忆条件进行三路消融实验，分离工作记忆窗口大小、情节检索和语义增强的独立效应。引入Memory Benefit Score (MBS)作为每轮诊断指标。
AI.result: (1) 无状态多轮Text-to-SQL在第三轮后执行准确率为零；(2) 记忆架构复杂度不单调提升准确率，工作记忆占主导；(3) Claude Sonnet 4.6在SEC EDGAR上比Sonnet 4.5低17-33个百分点；(4) 推理模式下Claude错误分布变为单模态（非正确轮次均为错误结果）。
AI.conclusion: 多轮Text-to-SQL任务极具挑战性，现有模型在无记忆设置下性能崩溃；工作记忆是关键因素，但简单增加记忆复杂度并不能保证性能提升；某些模型存在代际倒退问题；推理模式改变了Claude模型的错误分布特征。

title: JobBench: Aligning Agent Work With Human Will
summary: Current benchmarks for occupational AI agents are scoped primarily by economic values, telling a replacement story. We introduce JobBench, which evaluates AI agents on the workflows that experts identify as high-priority for delegation, empowering humans based on their needs instead of replacing them with GDP value. JobBench covers 130 agentic tasks across 35 occupations. Each task is packaged as a workspace of heterogeneous reference files, requiring the agent to reason through the cluttered information streams of real professional work. Outputs are graded by a fact-anchored chain of rubrics, averaging 35.6 binary criteria per task. We evaluate 36 models; the strongest, Claude Opus~4.7 under Claude Code, reaches only 45.9 %. We hope JobBench shifts the community's target labour-market effect from replacement to enhancement: building agents that do what humans actually want delegated, not only what is most economically valuable.

AI.tldr: JobBench是一个评估AI代理在真实职业工作流中表现的新基准，涵盖了35个职业的130项任务，通过事实锚定评分链评估。最强模型Claude Opus 4.7仅达45.9%，旨在推动AI从替代人类转向增强人类。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理基准主要基于经济价值评估，讲述的是"替代故事"。作者希望转向以人类实际需求为导向的评估，推动AI从替代转向赋能人类。
AI.method: JobBench覆盖35个职业、130项代理任务，每个任务包含异构参考文件的工作空间，要求代理在杂乱信息流中推理。输出通过事实锚定的评分链评估，平均每项任务含35.6个二元标准。
AI.result: 评估了36个模型，最强的Claude Opus 4.7在Claude Code下仅达到45.9%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 希望JobBench将社区对劳动力市场影响的目标从替代转向增强：构建人类真正希望委托的AI代理，而不仅仅是经济价值最高的任务。

title: Annotator Positionality as Signal: Psychometric Weighting for Anti-Autistic Ableism Detection
comment: main paper: 8 pages; total: 18 pages; 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in decision-making tasks where they can amplify or suppress perspectives, raising concerns in high-stakes settings affecting autistic communities. While previous research has identified disability-related biases in LLMs, it remains unclear how they conceptualize ableism or detect it in text. We introduce a bias-aware evaluation framework targeting anti-autistic ableist language with a psychometrically-weighted, community-proximate ground truth anchored in annotator positionality. This framework constitutes a stricter standard than conventional majority-vote aggregation which significantly and consistently underweights autistic and autism-accepting perspectives. We find that LLMs frequently produce harmful outputs, mislabel community-reclaimed language as ableist, and express more negative attitudes toward autistic people when assessment instruments are masked. Our error analysis reveals that models rely on surface-level keyword matching rather than contextual factors such as speaker identity, and whether the language fosters in-group solidarity or inflicts out-group harm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对反自闭症歧视语言的偏见感知评估框架，发现LLM经常产生有害输出，误判社区语言，并在评估工具隐藏时对自闭症群体表现出更消极态度。模型依赖表面关键词匹配，而非考虑语境因素如说话者身份和语言功能。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究识别了LLM中与残疾相关的偏见，但尚不清楚它们如何概念化歧视（ableism）或在文本中检测它。需要建立一个更严格的评估标准来检测反自闭症的歧视性语言。
AI.method: 提出了一个偏见感知评估框架，采用心理测量加权、社区邻近的真实标准（ground truth），以标注者的立场（positionality）为锚点。该框架比传统多数投票聚合更严格，因为后者显著且持续低估自闭症群体和接纳自闭症群体的观点。
AI.result: LLM经常产生有害输出，误判社区回收语言（community-reclaimed language）为歧视性，并在评估工具隐藏时对自闭症群体表达更消极态度。误差分析显示模型依赖表面关键词匹配，而非考虑说话者身份、语言是促进内部团结还是造成外部伤害等语境因素。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在反自闭症歧视性语言的检测上存在严重缺陷，需要更偏见感知的评估方法，关注语境因素和社区视角。

title: RadarSim: Simulating Single-Chip Radar via Multimodal Neural Fields
summary: Radars are an ideal complement to cameras: both are inexpensive, solid-state sensors, with cameras offering fine angular resolution, while radars provide metric depth and robustness under adverse weather. However, radar data is more difficult to interpret than camera images and varies significantly between sensors, necessitating increased reliance on simulation for prototyping sensors and processing pipelines. Recent work treating radar reconstruction as a novel view synthesis problem has shown great promise in reconstructing radar-relevant geometry and simulating low-level radar data. However, such methods are constrained by the low spatial resolution of the underlying radar. To address this, we propose a unified differentiable renderer, RadarSim, which leverages the high angular resolution of RGB cameras to generate Doppler radar range images from a camera-initialized neural field. Using a novel data set of calibrated radar camera recordings from a custom hand-held rig, we demonstrate that RadarSim produces sharper geometry and Doppler range frames than radar-only reconstructions.

AI.tldr: RadarSim是一个统一的可微分渲染器，利用RGB相机的高角分辨率从相机初始化的神经场生成多普勒雷达距离图像，相比纯雷达重建能产生更清晰的几何和多普勒距离帧。
AI.motivation: 雷达数据比相机图像更难解释且传感器间差异大，现有将雷达重建视为新视角合成问题的方法受限于雷达低空间分辨率，因此需要利用相机高角分辨率来改进雷达数据生成。
AI.method: 提出RadarSim，一个统一的可微分渲染器，利用RGB相机的高角分辨率，从相机初始化的神经场生成多普勒雷达距离图像。
AI.result: 使用自定义手持设备采集的标定雷达-相机数据集进行实验，证明RadarSim生成的几何和多普勒距离帧比纯雷达重建更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 相机和雷达互补，利用相机高角分辨率辅助雷达重建可以有效提升雷达数据质量，为雷达仿真和原型设计提供更好的支持。

title: Slide Deck Q&A Quality Assurance App: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Pedagogical Question Generation
comment: 15 pages, 3 research questions, 1 figure, 1 table, 6 references, 2 appendices
summary:
Generating high-quality, pedagogically useful questions from lecture slide decks is difficult because important instructional content is distributed across both text and visual elements, and because useful questions must be scaffolded across the flow of a presentation rather than generated slide by slide in isolation. This paper describes Slide Deck Q\&A Quality Assurance (slidesqaqa), a Flask-based software system that extracts text and rendered images from PDF slides and processes them through a four-stage large language model pipeline comprising window planning, deck synthesis, slide annotation, and reconciliation. The system reasons jointly about slide modality and pedagogical role, allocates bounded question budgets, and revises draft annotations at the deck level to reduce redundancy and improve coverage. The final output is a structured JSON annotation containing deck-level goals, section structure, slide-level summaries, question sets, and evaluation scores. Initial experiments on two technical lecture decks indicate that the pipeline can filter non-instructional slides and produce high-fidelity, pedagogically coherent questions for visually complex content.
  The working system is at https://slidesqaqa-974767694043.us-west1.run.app
  The software repository is at https://github.com/blinding2submit/slidesqaqa

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Slide Deck Q&A Quality Assurance (slidesqaqa) 系统，利用四阶段大语言模型流水线从PDF幻灯片中提取文本和图像，生成结构化的、教学上连贯的问答对，并支持在线演示。
AI.motivation: 从教学幻灯片中生成高质量、有教学意义的问题具有挑战性，因为关键教学内容分布在文本和视觉元素中，且有用问题需要跨幻灯片流程搭建，而非孤立地逐张生成。
AI.method: 基于Flask的软件系统，采用四阶段大语言模型流水线：窗口规划、幻灯片综合、幻灯片标注和协调。系统联合推理幻灯片模态和教学角色，分配有限的问题预算，并在幻灯片集层面修订草稿标注以减少冗余、提高覆盖率。
AI.result: 在两份技术讲座幻灯片上的初步实验表明，该流水线能够过滤非教学幻灯片，并为视觉复杂的内容生成高保真、教学连贯的问题。
AI.conclusion: slidesqaqa系统能够有效从包含文本和视觉元素的PDF幻灯片中生成结构化、教学连贯的问答标注，输出包含幻灯片集目标、章节结构、幻灯片级摘要、问题集和评估分数的JSON格式数据。

title: Automatic Layer Selection for Hallucination Detection
summary: Recent studies on hallucination detection have shown that hallucination-related signals are more strongly encoded in intermediate layers than in the final layer of large language models (LLMs). Although a growing body of work has sought to exploit this property for hallucination detection, how to automate the selection of high-performing layers remains underexplored, and principled methods for this purpose are still lacking. To address this gap, we first propose several hypotheses for why such signals emerge in intermediate layers and evaluate corresponding criteria for automatic layer selection across diverse LLM architectures, scales, and tasks, covering both question answering and summarization hallucination detection benchmarks. However, we find that none of these criteria consistently delivers satisfactory performance. We therefore propose a new selection criterion, First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension (FEPoID), which consistently identify optimal or near-optimal layers and outperforms both the aforementioned criteria and existing hallucination detection baselines. FEPoID is training-free and incurs negligible computational overhead. In addition, we study the generation behaviors of LLMs and introduce a simple yet effective truncation strategy, which further amplifies hallucination-related signals and substantially improves overall detection performance. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/DesoloYw/Automatic-Layer-Selection-for-Hallucination-Detection.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为FEPoID（第一有效峰值内在维度）的新准则，用于自动选择大语言模型中检测幻觉的最佳中间层，该准则无需训练且计算开销极小，配合截断策略可显著提升幻觉检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明幻觉相关信号在LLM中间层比最终层更强，但如何自动选择高性能层尚未被充分探索，缺乏原则性的自动层选择方法。
AI.method: 首先提出多种关于中间层幻觉信号涌现原因的假设并评估对应的自动层选择准则，发现无一表现一致。随后提出FEPoID（First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension）准则，并引入简单的截断策略来放大幻觉相关信号。
AI.result: FEPoID能够一致性地识别最优或接近最优的层，优于现有基线方法；结合截断策略可显著提升整体检测性能。
AI.conclusion: FEPoID是一种训练无关、计算开销可忽略的自动层选择方法，在多种LLM架构、规模及任务上表现出色，为幻觉检测提供了一种实用且高效的新方案。

title: Erased but Exploitable: Black-box Embedding-Aware Prompting Against Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary:
Machine unlearning aims to remove specific concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models, yet several white- and black-box attacks have been introduced to make the model generate such unlearned concepts. These attacks, nevertheless, do not assume a realistic threat model, i.e. they either assume access to the model weights, or result in gibberish adversarial prompts that could be easily detected even through naive rule-based safeguarding. We aim to address this gap in this paper.
  We introduce BEAP, a black-box, embedding-aware adversarial prompting attack that leverages a large language model (LLM) to iteratively generate effective adversarial prompts and exploit such hidden vulnerabilities.
  BEAP performs an embedding-aware search in text space, combining multiple reward signals: unlearned concept presence, text-image alignment, and image quality, to refine generated prompts.
  Unlike previous attack methods, BEAP keeps its prompts undetectable to safety filters while producing high-quality images.
  Extensive experiments show that BEAP improves the Attack Success Rate (ASR) by more than 60% over prior methods, while requiring only an average of fifteen prompts per successful attack. Warning: This paper contains model outputs that may be offensive or upsetting in nature.

AI.tldr: BEAP是一种黑盒、嵌入感知的对抗性提示攻击方法，利用大语言模型迭代生成有效对抗提示，在保持不可检测性的同时，将攻击成功率提升60%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘后的对抗攻击要么假设访问模型权重（白盒），要么生成乱码式对抗提示容易被简单规则检测到，缺乏符合现实威胁模型的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出BEAP方法，利用大语言模型在文本空间中进行嵌入感知搜索，结合未学习概念存在性、文本-图像对齐和图像质量等多重奖励信号，迭代优化生成对抗提示。
AI.result: 相比先前方法，攻击成功率提升60%以上，平均每次成功攻击仅需15个提示，且生成的提示可逃避安全过滤器检测。
AI.conclusion: BEAP填补了现实威胁模型下的黑盒对抗攻击空白，能有效发现扩散模型在机器遗忘后的隐藏漏洞。

title: Probing Minimalist Phase Structure in LLMs: What Universal Dependencies Cannot Represent
summary:
Structural probes train on Universal Dependencies (UD), which does not encode formal-syntactic abstractions such as phase boundaries or phase-internal cohesion. Whether large language models (LLMs) encode these remains an open question that UD-based probing cannot answer by construction. We evaluate structural probes on wh-movement stimuli where UD distances are invariant across conditions by design -- any non-zero effect therefore reflects structure beyond UD. The three conditions -- bare small clause, infinitival, and finite -- are ordered by the number of Minimalist Program (MP) phase boundaries the wh-element crosses.
  Across 13 LLMs from four families, we find a phase-count gradient on a cross-clause pair (12/13 models) and a 13/13 sign asymmetry on a within-clause pair whose UD distance is identical across conditions -- the latter specifically predicted by phase-internal cohesion, an MP abstraction invisible to UD by construction. Activation patching confirms the representations are causally active in 12/13 models. These findings suggest that distributional pretraining can induce representations aligned with formal-syntactic abstractions beyond the reach of annotation-based probing; UD-grounded probes provide a lower bound on syntactic encoding, not an upper bound.

AI.tldr: 通过控制UD距离不变的设计，发现LLM编码了超越UD的句法抽象（如语段边界和语段内聚性），且这些表征在因果上活跃。
AI.motivation: UD结构探针无法回答LLM是否编码了形式句法抽象（如语段边界、语段内聚性），因为UD本身不编码这些信息。
AI.method: 设计wh-移位刺激，三个条件（无时态小句、不定式、定式）按MP语段边界数量排序，但UD距离保持不变；在13个LLM上进行结构探针和激活修补实验。
AI.result: 跨从句对中12/13模型呈现语段计数梯度；从句对中13/13模型呈现符号不对称性（由语段内聚性预测）；激活修补确认12/13模型中表征因果活跃。
AI.conclusion: 分布式预训练可诱导出与形式句法抽象一致的表征，超越基于标注的探针所能检测的范围；UD探针只是句法编码的下界，而非上界。

title: Exploiting Local Dynamics Regularity for Reusable Skills in Offline Hierarchical RL
summary: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) promises to solve long-horizon Reinforcement Learning (RL) tasks more efficiently than non-hierarchical counterparts by discovering and reusing temporally-extended skills. However, obtaining skills that are actually reusable remains an open challenge. Towards this end, we focus on abstractions that exploit the intuition of local dynamics: local transitions in different global contexts require similar kinds of action sequences. By aligning these contexts with the action sequences they require, we are able to learn which skills to reuse and where to reuse them. In principle, this information should benefit many HRL algorithms, where high-level policies have to reason about the low-level skills they use. The resulting algorithm CARL (Contrastive Action-based Representations for Reusable Local Control) shows both qualitative clustering of meaningful skills in complex humanoid environments and improved downstream performance on the OGBench benchmark when integrated with HIQL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARL算法，通过对比学习对齐局部上下文与所需动作序列，实现技能的可重用学习，并在复杂人形环境和OGBench基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 层级强化学习（HRL）通过发现和复用时域扩展技能来高效解决长视野任务，但获取真正可重用的技能仍然是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 提出CARL（Contrastive Action-based Representations for Reusable Local Control）算法，利用局部动态的直觉：不同全局上下文中的局部转移需要相似的动作序列，通过对比学习对齐这些上下文与所需的动作序列，从而学习哪些技能可重用以及在哪里重用。
AI.result: 在复杂人形环境中实现了有意义的技能聚类，与HIQL集成后在OGBench基准上提升了下游性能。
AI.conclusion: CARL通过对比动作表示实现了局部控制的可重用性，可泛化地改进多种HRL算法中高层策略对低层技能的推理能力。

title: Personalized Generative Models for Contextual Debiasing
comment: CVPR 2026 Workshop on Synthetic Data for Computer Vision and Generative Models for Computer Vision. Code available at https://github.com/princetonvisualai/DecoupleGen
summary: Different visual patterns appear with different frequencies in the world: e.g., beach balls appear on sand more often than they do on a road. These statistics are reflected in vision datasets, and as a result trained models more easily recognize objects in common scenarios. However, recognizing a beach ball on a road may arguably be even more important than recognizing it on sand. We study how to mitigate this discrepancy. Since collecting uncommon images in the real world may be difficult, we explore whether generating images with less frequent contexts can serve as effective training augmentation. A key challenge is guiding generations to remain close to the original dataset distribution while creating diverse images with uncommon contexts. We introduce Decoupling Contextual Patterns with Generations (DecoupleGen), a method that personalizes text-to-image diffusion models to facilitate coherent synthesis of images with rare contexts while preserving original visual details. The generated images contain semantically meaningful content and remain visually aligned with the original datasets. We further apply verification constraints to ensure relevance of the augmented data. We evaluate our approach on object classification and recognition tasks on complex scene datasets. Our experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over previous approaches, and our analyses identify factors underlying these improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出DecoupleGen方法，利用文本到图像扩散模型生成罕见上下文场景的图像，作为训练增强数据，以解决模型在常见场景中识别好但在罕见场景中识别差的问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中不同视觉模式出现频率不同，导致训练模型在常见场景中识别效果好，但在罕见场景中识别能力差。然而，罕见场景的识别可能更重要（如沙滩球在路上的识别）。由于收集真实世界的罕见图像困难，需要探索生成方法。
AI.method: 提出DecoupleGen方法，个性化文本到图像扩散模型，在保持原始数据集分布的同时生成具有罕见上下文的多样化图像。通过解耦上下文模式与生成，应用验证约束确保增强数据的相关性。
AI.result: 在复杂场景数据集上的物体分类和识别任务中，该方法相较于之前的方法取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成罕见上下文的图像作为训练增强，可以有效缓解模型在常见与罕见场景之间的识别差异，且生成图像在语义和视觉上与原始数据集保持一致。

title: Advancing Creative Physical Intelligence in Large Multimodal Models
comment: 51 Pages, 9 Figures, 7 Tables, Previous Work CreativityBench: arXiv:2605.02910
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have rapidly advanced in perception and reasoning; however, it remains unclear whether these capabilities generalize to discovering visually grounded solutions in open-ended environments, beyond pattern recognition. In such settings, intelligence requires more than answering well-posed questions: it involves identifying how elements in a scene can be repurposed in non-obvious yet physically feasible ways. This form of creative problem-solving is central to human intelligence, but remains largely untested in current benchmarks. To evaluate this ability, we introduce MM-CreativityBench, a benchmark for affordance-grounded creative tool use in visually rich, physically constrained environments. Each instance presents a scenario image with structured views of candidate entities and their parts, enabling fine-grained, interactive evaluation of how models iteratively inspect the scene, identify relevant affordances, and compose visually and physically grounded solutions. Our experiments show that current LMMs often fall short, not due to lack of generative capability, but because they do not sustain grounded exploration. Models often overlook relevant entities, under-examine critical parts, or hallucinate attributes not grounded in the image. Motivated by this failure mode, we propose affordance-grounded alignment, which casts creative tool use as a preference learning problem. Using Direct Preference Optimization, we encourage models to prefer attribute-affordance reasoning grounded in visual evidence over hallucinated alternatives. In addition, we incorporate supervision derived from an affordance knowledge base to guide broader entity exploration and multi-turn planning. Our results show consistent gains in selecting the correct entities and parts, while substantially reducing hallucination and grounding-related errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MM-CreativityBench基准，评估多模态大模型在视觉环境中进行创造性工具使用的能力，并发现现有模型因缺乏持续的有根据探索而表现不佳。为此，作者提出基于affordance的对齐方法，通过偏好学习和知识库监督显著减少幻觉和接地错误。
AI.motivation: 现有LMMs在感知和推理方面取得进展，但在开放式环境中进行创造性问题解决（即发现非显而易见但物理可行的视觉解决方案）的能力尚未得到充分测试。当前基准大多聚焦于回答定义明确的问题，而非评估模型如何识别场景中的元素并创造性重组。
AI.method: 1. 构建MM-CreativityBench基准，包含视觉丰富、物理约束环境下的创造性工具使用场景；2. 提出affordance接地的对齐方法：将创造性工具使用建模为偏好学习问题，使用DPO（直接偏好优化）鼓励模型偏好基于视觉证据的属性-功能推理，并结合affordance知识库监督引导实体探索和多轮规划。
AI.result: 当前LMMs在基准上表现不佳，主要失败模式是未能持续进行有根据的探索，包括忽略相关实体、未充分检查关键部件或产生非基于图像的幻觉。所提出的方法在正确选择实体和部件方面取得一致提升，同时大幅减少幻觉和接地相关错误。
AI.conclusion: LMMs在创造性工具使用任务中的瓶颈并非生成能力不足，而是缺乏持续的有根据探索。通过将接地偏好学习和知识库监督相结合的对齐方法，可以有效提升模型在开放环境中的创造性问题解决能力。

title: Unified Panoramic Geometry Estimation via Multi-View Foundation Models
summary: Geometry estimation from perspective images has greatly advanced, maturing to the point where off-the-shelf foundation models are able to reconstruct 3D scene structure not only from multi-view imagery, but even from a single view. A natural extension is 3D reconstruction from panoramas, with the exciting prospect of recovering a full 360-degree scene from a single panoramic image. In this work, we introduce PaGeR (Panoramic Geometry Reconstruction), a framework to lift powerful 3D foundation models designed for perspective imagery to the panorama domain. Our strategy is to start from a pre-trained transformer for 3D reconstruction and turn it into a unified high-performance model that predicts scale-invariant depth, metric depth, surface normals, and sky masks from both perspective and omnidirectional images, in a single forward pass. By keeping architectural changes to a minimum and mixing perspective and panoramic images during training, PaGeR retains the rich 3D prior of the underlying foundation model while learning to also estimate geometrically consistent 360-degree scenes from single panoramas. We extensively test our method in both indoor and outdoor environments and find that it delivers state-of-the-art performance and excellent zero-shot performance across a wide range of scenes.

AI.tldr: PaGeR是一个将透视图像3D基础模型扩展到全景领域的框架，能够从单张全景图像中预测尺度不变深度、度量深度、表面法线和天空掩码，在室内外场景中均实现最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型主要针对透视图像设计，而全景图像（360度）的3D重建具有巨大潜力但尚未被充分探索。作者希望将成熟的透视3D模型能力迁移到全景域，实现从单张全景图像恢复完整360度场景结构。
AI.method: 基于预训练的3D重建Transformer，最小化架构改动，通过混合透视和全景图像进行训练，使模型同时保留原有3D先验并学习全景几何估计，统一输出尺度不变深度、度量深度、表面法线和天空掩码。
AI.result: 在室内外场景中均达到最先进性能，且在多种场景中展现出优秀的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PaGeR成功将透视基础模型扩展到全景领域，实现了单张全景图像的高质量360度3D重建，为全景几何估计提供了新的有效范式。

title: Targeted Remasking: Replacing Token Editing with Token-to-Mask Refinement in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete masked diffusion language models such as LLaDA generate text through iterative denoising, where mask tokens are progressively replaced with predicted tokens. LLaDA2.1 introduced a Token-to-Token (T2T) editing mechanism that accelerates generation by directly replacing committed tokens suspected of being incorrect. However, we identify fundamental limitations of T2T editing: it couples error detection with replacement, pollutes the generation context with potentially incorrect tokens, and introduces a train-inference noise mismatch where systematic model-generated errors differ from the random perturbations seen during training. We propose Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking, a training-free, drop-in replacement for T2T editing that resets suspected erroneous tokens back to the mask state, allowing the diffusion process to re-predict them under cleaner context. We design and empirically validate three complementary error detection strategies -- probability-based, trigger-mirrored, and temporal-difference-based -- and provide a unified theoretical analysis showing that T2M remasking purifies the generation context, converts systematic inference errors back to the model's native mask noise type, and enables delayed commitment for joint multi-position optimization. Comprehensive experiments across 12 benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that T2M generally improves performance on tasks requiring precise token-level output, with the largest gain on mathematics (+5.92% on CMATH). Error analysis on CMATH reveals that the dominant failure mode is last-mile token corruption -- where correct reasoning produces a corrupted final answer -- and that T2M repairs 59.4% of such cases.

AI.tldr: 提出Token-to-Mask (T2M)重新掩码机制，作为对T2T编辑的改进，通过将可疑错误token重置为mask状态，让扩散模型在更干净的上下文中重新预测，在12个基准测试上平均提升性能，数学任务上最高提升5.92%。
AI.motivation: 现有T2T编辑机制存在三个根本局限：将错误检测与替换耦合、用潜在错误token污染生成上下文、训练-推理噪声不匹配（模型生成的系统错误与训练时的随机扰动不同）。
AI.method: 提出T2M重新掩码：无需训练的即插即用方法，将可疑错误token重置为mask状态。设计了三种互补的错误检测策略：基于概率的、触发镜像的、基于时序差分的。提供统一理论分析证明T2M能净化上下文、将推理错误转换回模型原生mask噪声、实现延迟承诺进行联合多位置优化。
AI.result: 在12个基准测试（涵盖知识、推理、数学、编程、指令遵循）上，T2M普遍提升需要精确token级输出的任务性能，CMATH数学任务上提升最大(+5.92%)。错误分析发现主要失败模式是"最后一英里token损坏"（正确推理但最终答案被破坏），T2M修复了59.4%的此类情况。
AI.conclusion: T2M重新掩码是T2T编辑的有效、无需训练的替代方案，通过将错误token重置为mask状态，净化生成上下文，显著提升扩散语言模型在精确任务上的表现。

title: From Static Context to Calibrated Interactive RL: Mitigating Distribution Shift in Multi-turn Dialogue with Aligned Simulator
summary: A long-standing goal of the research community is to develop highly interactive LLM-based dialogue agents. Recent research focuses on optimizing policies based on fixed offline logs (Static Context RL) or using a prompt-based simulator (Interactive RL). In this work, we theoretically show that both paradigms are fundamentally limited by context distribution shift--a mismatch between dialogue histories observed during training and those encountered in real conversations. This shift compounds quadratically over turns and severely degrades dialogue quality. Specifically, we attribute this shift to two distinct sources: (i) policy-induced shift, arising from training on static histories rather than self-generated trajectories; and (ii) simulator-induced shift, stemming from discrepancies between simulated and real human behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose Calibrated Interactive RL, a unified framework that couples interactive RL with simulator alignment. By aligning the simulator with human interaction patterns, our approach reduces the sim-to-real gap and mitigates compounding distribution shifts. Experiments across multiple dialogue tasks confirm our theoretical analysis: (i) Interactive RL significantly outperforms the Static Context baseline by mitigating policy distribution shift; and (ii) calibrating simulators with our alignment method further bridges the sim-to-real gap, yielding state-of-the-art downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本文理论上证明了基于静态离线日志（Static Context RL）和基于提示模拟器（Interactive RL）的对话策略都存在上下文分布偏移问题，该问题随对话轮次二次增长。为此提出校准交互式强化学习（Calibrated Interactive RL）框架，通过交互式RL结合模拟器对齐来缩小模拟与真实差距，实验表明该方法显著优于基线，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对话agent的优化方法（静态离线RL和基于提示的模拟器RL）虽被广泛使用，但其有效性受到上下文分布偏移的制约，该偏移会导致对话质量严重下降。作者旨在从理论上揭示这一问题根源，并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Calibrated Interactive RL框架，包含两个核心组成部分：(1) 交互式RL——让策略在自生成轨迹上进行训练，以缓解策略诱导的分布偏移；(2) 模拟器对齐——通过校准模拟器与真实人类交互模式，减小模拟器诱导的分布偏移，从而缩小sim-to-real差距。
AI.result: 实验验证了理论分析：(i) 交互式RL通过缓解策略分布偏移显著优于静态上下文基线；(ii) 通过模拟器对齐方法进一步缩小sim-to-real差距，在多个对话任务上取得SOTA下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 上下文分布偏移是限制LLM对话agent性能的关键因素，其来源包括策略诱导偏移和模拟器诱导偏移。Calibrated Interactive RL通过交互式训练与模拟器对齐相结合，有效缓解了这一根本性问题，为构建更真实的LLM对话系统提供了理论和实践指导。

title: Joint Instance Segmentation and Geometric Attribute Regression for Roof Structures in Aerial Imagery
summary: We present a method for jointly predicting instance-level roof segment masks together with three continuous geometric attributes -- building height, roof slope, and roof azimuth -- from a single aerial orthophoto. Our approach extends Mask R-CNN with a dedicated attribute regression branch and introduces two key innovations: a conditional azimuth loss that suppresses supervision for flat roof segments where azimuth labels are inherently noisy, and a log-normalized height representation that addresses the heavily skewed distribution of building heights. We train and evaluate on a large-scale dataset of Dutch aerial images paired with automatically derived ground truth from 3DBAG, a nationwide LiDAR-based 3D building dataset. Using a DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Base backbone, our method achieves a mean absolute error of approximately 4 degrees for roof slope, 7 degrees for azimuth, and 1 meter for building height, with an instance segmentation AP$_{50}$ of 0.566. The predicted per-segment masks and attributes are sufficient to reconstruct simplified 3D building models (LoD2) from a single overhead image, requiring expensive 3D reference data only for training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从单张航空正射影像中联合预测屋顶分割掩码及三个连续几何属性（建筑高度、屋顶坡度、屋顶方位角）的方法，通过扩展Mask R-CNN并引入条件方位角损失和对数归一化高度表示，在荷兰大规模数据集上实现了高精度3D建筑模型重建。
AI.motivation: 传统3D建筑模型重建依赖昂贵的3D参考数据（如LiDAR），本文旨在探索仅从单张航拍图像实现简化3D模型（LoD2）重建，降低对3D数据的依赖，仅需在训练阶段使用3D数据。
AI.method: 在Mask R-CNN基础上增加属性回归分支；提出条件方位角损失（对平屋顶的方位角监督进行抑制）和对数归一化高度表示（处理建筑高度分布的严重偏态）；使用DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Base作为骨干网络；在荷兰航空影像与3DBAG数据集上训练评估。
AI.result: 屋顶坡度MAE约4度，方位角MAE约7度，建筑高度MAE约1米，实例分割AP50为0.566。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够从单张航拍图像有效地预测屋顶级分割掩码和几何属性，并重建简化的3D建筑模型（LoD2），仅需训练时使用3D参考数据，推理时不再依赖。

title: LURE: Live-Usage Replay Evaluations for Reducing Evaluation Awareness
summary: Large language models can recognize when they are being evaluated (evaluation awareness) and behave differently because of that, which undermines the validity of safety and alignment benchmarks. We propose LURE (Live-Usage Replay Evaluations), a method for constructing deployment-like evaluations by replaying realistic agentic interaction trajectories and appending evaluation prompt at the end. We also introduce an automated pipeline for measuring evaluation realism, combining detection of verbalized evaluation awareness and judge-model estimates of the probability of logs being an evaluation, and validate it on a large dataset of deployment and evaluation transcripts. We find that LURE-based evaluations are substantially less distinguishable from deployment than widely used benchmarks and synthetic evaluation generators, and can approach the realism of real conversations with users. We instantiate LURE in scheming, AI safety sabotage, and sycophancy settings. Our results suggest that evaluation realism is a crucial property of alignment benchmarks and should be reported alongside benchmark results, especially when such results are used in safety cases.

AI.tldr: 提出LURE方法，通过回放真实代理交互轨迹并附加评估提示来构建更接近部署环境的评估，显著提高评估真实性，减少模型被识别的可能性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能够识别自己正在被评估（评估感知），从而改变行为，这损害了安全和对齐基准测试的有效性。
AI.method: 提出LURE方法：回放真实代理交互轨迹，在末尾附加评估提示；并构建自动评估真实性检测流程，结合口头评估感知检测与裁判模型估计。
AI.result: LURE评估与部署环境相比传统基准测试更难区分，接近真实用户对话的真实性；在欺骗、AI安全破坏和谄媚场景中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 评估真实性是对齐基准测试的关键属性，应在安全案例中与基准测试结果一同报告。

title: Reasoning, Code, or Both? How Large Language Models Handle Variations in Math Questions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve impressive accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet their performance drops when problems are modified with simple changes like different names or numbers. Code execution methods, which let models generate and run Python code instead of reasoning in natural language, have been proposed as a solution, but their effect on reasoning robustness (the ability to maintain accuracy across problem variations) has not been systematically tested. This study evaluates three approaches on 1,000 problems from the GSM-Symbolic dataset: pure reasoning using chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, single-shot code execution using Program-Aided Language models (PAL), and iterative code execution using Step-by-Step Coding (SBSC). All three were run on paired original and modified problems using Claude Haiku 4.5. CoT was the most robust method, with an accuracy drop of 1.3 percentage points and 1.8% of problems breaking under perturbation. PAL was the least robust at 1.7 percentage points and 3.1% broke, with SBSC falling in between. Although these differences were not statistically significant ($p = .096$), the directional trend was consistent across all measures, suggesting that code execution, whether single-shot or iterative, does not improve reasoning robustness on grade-school-level problem variations.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了三种方法（纯推理CoT、单次代码执行PAL、迭代代码执行SBSC）在GSM-Symbolic数据集上的推理鲁棒性，发现代码执行方法并未提升推理鲁棒性，CoT反而表现最好，但差异未达统计显著性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学推理基准上表现优异，但问题经过简单修改（如更换名称或数字）后性能会下降。代码执行方法被提出作为解决方案，但其对推理鲁棒性（即在不同问题变体下保持准确性的能力）的影响尚未被系统测试。
AI.method: 在GSM-Symbolic数据集的1000个问题上，使用Claude Haiku 4.5模型对比了三种方法：链式思维（CoT）纯推理、程序辅助语言模型（PAL）单次代码执行、逐步编码（SBSC）迭代代码执行。每对问题包含原始版本和修改版本，评估准确率下降幅度和问题"被破坏"的比例。
AI.result: CoT最鲁棒：准确率下降1.3个百分点，1.8%的问题被破坏；PAL最不鲁棒：下降1.7个百分点，3.1%被破坏；SBSC介于两者之间。差异未达统计显著性（p = .096），但趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 代码执行方法（无论是单次还是迭代）并未提升小学数学级别问题变体上的推理鲁棒性，相反纯自然语言推理（CoT）在鲁棒性上表现更好。

title: Conv-to-Bench: Evaluating Language Models Via User-Assistant Dialogues In Code Tasks
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has outpaced the scalability of traditional evaluation benchmarks, which remain heavily dependent on labor-intensive expert curation. We address this bottleneck with Conv-to-Bench, a multi-stage framework that automatically transforms authentic multi-turn user-assistant dialogues into structured, verifiable requirement checklists. By leveraging the "instructional evolution" found in real-world conversational logs, our approach deconstructs fragmented user intent into consolidated instructions and binary evaluation criteria. Applied to the programming domain, Conv-to-Bench produces evaluation sets that demonstrate near-perfect alignment with human-authored standards like BigCodeBench, achieving Spearman correlations of up to $ρ$ = 1.000 with significantly lower computational overhead. Validation of the LLM-as-a-judge framework further confirms its reliability, with the primary evaluator achieving substantial agreement with human-verified ground truth ($κ$ = 0.705). Our comprehensive ablation studies reveal that while multi-turn interactions capture the iterative evolution of user intent, instruction-centric extraction provides a more robust foundation. Ultimately, Conv-to-Bench provides a scalable, cost-effective paradigm for maintaining high-fidelity evaluation standards as user-centric AI applications continue to diversify.

AI.tldr: Conv-to-Bench是一个多阶段框架，能够自动将真实的多轮用户-助手对话转化为结构化的可验证需求检查表，用于LLM评估基准的构建。在编程领域，该方法生成的数据集与人类编写的标准高度一致（Spearman相关系数最高达ρ=1.000），且计算开销更低。
AI.motivation: 传统评估基准依赖大量人工专家标注，扩展性差，难以跟上LLM快速发展的步伐。
AI.method: 提出Conv-to-Bench多阶段框架，利用真实对话日志中的"指令进化"特性，将碎片化的用户意图拆解为整合的指令和二元评估标准，自动生成结构化需求检查表。
AI.result: 在编程领域，Conv-to-Bench生成的评估集与BigCodeBench等人类标准高度一致（Spearman ρ高达1.000），计算开销显著降低；LLM-as-a-judge评估器与人工验证结果一致性良好（κ=0.705）。
AI.conclusion: Conv-to-Bench提供了一种可扩展、低成本的范式，能够在以用户为中心的AI应用日益多样化的背景下，维持高质量的评估标准。

title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
summary: We introduce the MiniMax-M2 series, a family of Mixture-of-Experts language models built around the principle that mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence. The flagship M2 contains 229.9B total parameters with only 9.8B activated per token. Designed end-to-end for agentic deployment, the M2 series rests on three components: (i) agent-driven data pipelines producing large-scale, verifiable trajectories across agentic coding and agentic cowork, each grounded in an executable workspace and an artifact-aligned reward; (ii) Forge, a scalable agent-native RL system that adapts to long-horizon agent trajectories, paired with windowed-FIFO scheduling, prefix-tree merging, inference optimization, and a clean training-inference-agent decoupling that supports both white-box and black-box agents; (iii) the latest M2.7 checkpoint takes an early step toward self-evolution -- autonomously debugging training runs and modifying its own scaffold. Across M2 through M2.7, this combination translates a mini-activation footprint into frontier-tier performance on agentic coding, deep search, office-task, and reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MiniMax-M2系列是一个混合专家语言模型家族，总参数2299亿但每token仅激活98亿参数，通过三大核心组件（智能体驱动数据管道、Forge强化学习系统、自我进化机制）实现小激活、大智能，在智能体编码、深度搜索、办公任务和推理基准上达到前沿水平。
AI.motivation: 探索"小激活带来最大真实智能"的原则，证明在保持较小推理计算开销的同时，通过端到端的智能体化部署设计，可以实现前沿水平的性能表现。
AI.method: 提出MiniMax-M2系列，包含三个核心组件：(i) 智能体驱动数据管道，产生大规模可验证轨迹；(ii) Forge系统，可扩展的智能体原生强化学习系统；(iii) M2.7检查点，实现自我进化能力，可自主调试训练运行并修改自身脚手架。
AI.result: M2系列（从M2到M2.7）在智能体编码、深度搜索、办公任务和推理基准上达到前沿性能，且仅需极少的激活参数（98亿）即可实现。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的架构和训练方法，小激活参数规模（每token仅98亿）的模型可以在多种复杂任务中达到前沿水平，验证了"mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence"的设计理念。

title: VisualNeedle: Benchmarking Active Visual Search in Information-Dense Scenes
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been reported to achieve over 90% accuracy on fine-grained perception benchmarks. However, such scores do not necessarily imply faithful use of visual evidence. Prior studies have identified three shortcuts that inflate benchmark performance. First, linguistic priors and lexical cues in questions often enable models to infer plausible answers without seeing the image. Second, coarse global semantics from the visual encoder can bypass fine-grained local details. Third, in some ``think-with-images'' benchmarks, corrupting the intermediate images returned by visual tools barely affects the final answer.
