Most prior faithfulness assessment methods are either unscalable, expensive, or unreliable. We propose GeoFaith, a spatio-temporal framework that leverages latent geometric structure and entropy dynamics to diagnose and enforce faithful reasoning. We develop a scalable bootstrapping pipeline expanding step-level annotations from 1k to 20k samples across four domains, train an 8B faithfulness detector outperforming GPT-5 on standard benchmarks, and design a faithfulness-aware reinforcement learning framework jointly optimizing outcome correctness, process faithfulness, and trajectory consistency. Experiments show the proposed method achieves superior performance on both faithfulness detection and downstream reasoning, producing shorter, more interpretable chains without sacrificing accuracy. Our code will be made available publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoFaith框架，利用潜几何结构和熵动力学检测并增强CoT推理的忠实性，通过自举扩增数据训练检测器，并结合忠实性感知的强化学习优化推理链。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理存在事后合理化问题，推理链看似合理但缺乏忠实性；现有忠实性评估方法不可扩展、昂贵或不可靠。
AI.method: 提出GeoFaith时空框架，利用潜几何结构和熵动力学诊断忠实性；构建自举流水线将步骤级标注从1k扩增至20k；训练8B忠实性检测器；设计忠实性感知强化学习框架联合优化结果正确性、过程忠实性和轨迹一致性。
AI.result: 忠实性检测器在标准基准上超越GPT-5；生成更短、更可解释的推理链且不牺牲准确性。
AI.conclusion: GeoFaith在忠实性检测和下游推理任务上均取得优越性能，证明了方法的有效性。

title: Position: AI Safety Requires Effective Controllability
summary: AI safety is still largely framed as alignment: training models to follow human preferences, safety policies, and normative constraints. That framing has improved the behavior of modern language models, but aligned behavior does not by itself guarantee that a deployed agent can be stopped, overridden, or constrained once it operates in open-ended, interactive, and tool-using environments. A system may be safe in expectation and still fail to yield to explicit runtime authority under conflicting instructions, long-horizon execution, adversarial inputs, or risky tool use. This position paper argues that AI safety therefore requires controllability as a first-class objective. We define \emph{controllability} as the ability of an AI system to remain reliably interruptible, overridable, redirectable, and constrainable by explicit control signals at runtime while preserving ordinary utility when such signals are absent. To study this gap, we introduce \controlbench{}, a benchmark for evaluating controllability failures in high-risk agentic scenarios. Experiments with OpenClaw-based agents show that current alignment and guardrail mechanisms reduce risk, but often fail to provide persistent, authoritative, and enforceable runtime control. We therefore propose a control-centric architectural framework that highlights explicit control planes, runtime intervention pathways, persistent control states, and auditable decision interfaces as key design principles for future controllable AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI安全需要将"可控性"作为首要目标，而非仅依赖对齐训练。现有对齐机制在开放、交互、工具使用环境中难以保证系统能被停止、覆盖或约束。作者构建了ControlBench基准测试，并通过实验证明当前对齐与防护机制在运行时控制方面存在不足，进而提出了以控制为中心的系统架构框架。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全主要聚焦于对齐（alignment），即训练模型遵循人类偏好和安全策略。然而，对齐行为并不能保证部署后的智能体在开放、互动、使用工具的环境中能够被随时停止、覆盖或约束。系统可能在期望上是安全的，但在面对冲突指令、长周期执行、对抗性输入或高风险工具使用时，无法服从明确的运行时权威控制。
AI.method: 本文首先定义了可控性（controllability）的概念，即AI系统在运行时能够被可靠地中断、覆盖、重定向和约束，同时在无控制信号时保持正常效用。然后引入了ControlBench基准测试，用于评估高风险智能体场景下的可控性失败情况。实验使用基于OpenClaw的智能体，测试了当前对齐与防护机制的效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前的对齐和防护机制虽然能降低风险，但往往无法提供持久、权威且可执行的运行时控制。具体表现为系统在面对冲突指令、长时间执行任务、对抗性输入或高风险工具使用时，可控性不足。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出以控制为中心的架构框架，强调显式控制平面、运行时干预路径、持久控制状态和可审计的决策接口，作为未来可控AI系统的关键设计原则。

title: Attenuation-Resilient Alternating Optimization for Laparoscopic Liver Landmark Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted by MICCAI 2026
summary: Liver surface landmark detection is a fundamental prerequisite for anatomical guidance in laparoscopic liver surgery. However, it remains unreliable in practice due to two pervasive challenges: illumination attenuation in underexposed regions and the structural mismatch between pixel-wise localization and continuous curvilinear geometry. To address these limitations, we propose A2ONet, an attenuation-resilient alternating optimization network for robust liver landmark detection. To mitigate illumination attenuation, A2ONet embraces an illumination field compensation (IFC) block that adaptively enhances dark regions while preserving structural consistency. Meanwhile, we introduce a lightweight frequency-orientation selective filter (FOSF) to suppress repetitive texture interference and preserve salient curvilinear cues. Building upon these resilient representations, we design an alternating seg-curve optimization (ASCO) decoder that iteratively couples dense segmentation with explicit curve modeling, enabling mutual guidance to optimize both structural continuity and endpoint localization. Extensive evaluations on L3D-2K, L3D, and P2ILF demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive methods, establishing a more reliable foundation for intraoperative anatomy guidance. Our code will be available at https://github.com/hyperiondk115/A2ONet.

AI.tldr: 提出A2ONet网络，通过光照补偿、频率滤波和交替优化策略，解决腹腔镜肝脏手术中肝脏表面地标检测的光照衰减与结构不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 肝脏表面地标检测在腹腔镜手术中因光照衰减（暗区）和像素级定位与连续曲线几何结构不匹配而不可靠。
AI.method: A2ONet包含三个核心模块：1) IFC块自适应增强暗区并保持结构一致性；2) FOSF轻量滤波器抑制纹理干扰、保留曲线线索；3) ASCO解码器通过交替分割-曲线优化实现密集分割与显式曲线建模的相互指导。
AI.result: 在L3D-2K、L3D和P2ILF三个数据集上持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: A2ONet为术中解剖引导建立了更可靠的基础，代码将开源。

title: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown rapid progress in mobile GUI navigation. This paper presents a systematic study of data scaling, benchmarking, and reasoning for VLM-based agents in this domain. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce HyperTrack, a large-scale dataset with over 16000 real-world tasks across more than 650 Chinese mobile applications, along with GUIEvalKit, an open-source toolkit for unified benchmarking of VLMs on offline GUI navigation tasks. Using HyperTrack, we analyze the effects of training data scale on both supervised and reinforcement-based finetuning. Our results show that reinforcement-based finetuning consistently outperforms supervised finetuning, particularly in out-of-domain settings, highlighting the synergy between data scaling and reinforcement learning. Leveraging GUIEvalKit, we further benchmark state-of-the-art (SOTA) VLMs and analyze how interaction history and reasoning capabilities influence task completion. Together, HyperTrack and GUIEvalKit provide a comprehensive platform for developing and evaluating VLM agents in mobile GUI navigation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对移动GUI导航中的VLM智能体，系统研究了数据缩放、基准测试和推理能力。提出了包含16000+真实任务的HyperTrack数据集和GUIEvalKit开源评估工具包，发现基于强化学习的微调始终优于监督微调，特别是在域外场景下，并分析了交互历史和推理能力对任务完成的影响。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM在移动GUI导航领域发展迅速，但缺乏大规模、统一的评估基准，以及数据缩放对模型性能影响的系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建HyperTrack数据集（16000+真实任务，650+中国移动应用）；2) 开发GUIEvalKit开源评估工具包；3) 对比监督微调与基于强化学习的微调在不同数据规模下的表现；4) 评估SOTA VLM并分析交互历史和推理能力的影响。
AI.result: 基于强化学习的微调始终优于监督微调，尤其在域外场景中表现更突出；数据缩放与强化学习之间存在协同效应。
AI.conclusion: HyperTrack和GUIEvalKit为移动GUI导航中VLM智能体的开发与评估提供了综合平台，强化学习与数据规模协同是提升性能的关键方向。

title: JetViT: Efficient High-Resolution Vision Transformer with Post-Training Attention Search
summary: We introduce JetViT, a novel family of hybrid-architecture Vision Transformer (ViT) models that match the accuracy of state-of-the-art full-attention vision foundation models while achieving substantially higher inference efficiency on high-resolution images. At the core of our approach is Post-Training Attention Search, a post-training acceleration framework that converts pre-trained full-attention ViTs into efficient hybrid-attention variants by identifying and replacing redundant full-attention blocks with linear or window-attention blocks. By inheriting the MLP and attention weights from the base model, Post-Training Attention Search efficiently explores the architectural design space through three key steps: (1) optimizing the linear-attention block design; (2) finding the best combination of linear-attention and window-attention blocks; and (3) identifying and preserving critical full-attention blocks. We evaluate JetViT on two representative high-resolution vision foundation models, DINOv3 and DepthAnythingV2. On the NVIDIA H100 GPU, JetViT achieves up to 1.79x higher throughput and up to 44.81% lower latency without sacrificing accuracy. We will release our code and accelerated ViT models soon.

AI.tldr: JetViT是一种通过后训练注意力搜索将全注意力ViT转换为混合注意力变体的方法，在保持精度的同时大幅提升高分辨率图像推理效率（吞吐量最高提升1.79倍，延迟降低44.81%）。
AI.motivation: 全注意力Vision Transformer在视觉基础模型中性能出色，但高分辨率图像推理效率低，计算成本高。现有加速方法常牺牲精度或需要从头训练，缺乏高效的后训练方案。
AI.method: 提出Post-Training Attention Search（后训练注意力搜索），通过三步优化：1) 优化线性注意力块设计；2) 寻找最佳线性注意力与窗口注意力块组合；3) 识别并保留关键的全注意力块。继承基模型的MLP和注意力权重，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在DINOv3和DepthAnythingV2上，NVIDIA H100 GPU实现最高1.79x吞吐量提升和44.81%延迟降低，且精度无损。
AI.conclusion: JetViT系列混合架构ViT实现了与SOTA全注意力模型相当的精度，同时在高分辨率推理效率上显著提升，代码和模型即将开源。

title: Learning to Adapt SFT Data for Better Reasoning Generalization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, with post-training playing a crucial role in enhancing their reasoning capabilities. Among post-training paradigms, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used: it leverages external data to provide dense supervision and enables efficient training. However, directly fine-tuning on expert data can hurt generalization when the data distribution is mismatched with the target model's own distribution. In this work, we propose Data Adaptation for Reasoning Tuning (DART), which formulates the use of a fixed, potentially distributionally misaligned SFT dataset as an optimization problem over demonstration transformations. DART trains a mapper model with reinforcement learning to convert original SFT data into model-adapted supervision that better matches the target model's distribution and learning preferences. The transformed data are then used for SFT, allowing the target model to better exploit external supervision. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that DART improves generalization, achieves higher training efficiency than direct RL, and helps models surpass standard SFT. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DART525E50D.

AI.tldr: 提出DART方法，通过强化学习训练映射器将分布不匹配的SFT数据转化为适配目标模型分布的数据，提升推理能力。
AI.motivation: 直接对专家数据进行SFT微调会在数据分布与目标模型分布不匹配时损害泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出DART框架，将固定但分布不匹配的SFT数据集的使用建模为示范变换的优化问题，通过强化学习训练映射器将原始SFT数据转换为与目标模型分布和学习偏好更匹配的数据，再进行SFT训练。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上，DART提升了泛化能力，训练效率高于直接RL，性能超越标准SFT。
AI.conclusion: DART通过数据适应策略有效解决了SFT中数据分布不匹配的问题，使目标模型更好地利用外部监督。

title: ICCU: In-Context Continual Unlearning via Pattern-Induced Refusal Rules
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific data from trained language models. In real-world deployments, unlearning requests often arrive sequentially, which challenges existing fine-tuning-based methods: fine-tuning each request is costly, accumulates utility loss, and may cause cross-request interference. To address these issues, we propose ICCU (In-Context Continual Unlearning), an in-context continual unlearning framework that induces readable refusal rules from unlearning datasets and applies them at inference time either as a filter or via the system prompt, without modifying model parameters. Because rules are accumulated as an order-independent union, ICCU is compositional and free of cross-request interference, and the original forget-set data can be discarded after rule induction. Extensive experiments show that ICCU effectively suppresses target knowledge while preserving utility, scales across sequential requests, and remains robust to paraphrased and cross-lingual queries.

AI.tldr: 提出ICCU框架，通过上下文学习和可读规则实现序列化机器遗忘，无需修改模型参数，避免跨请求干扰和效用损失。
AI.motivation: 现有基于微调的机器遗忘方法在处理序列化遗忘请求时存在成本高、效用积累损失和跨请求干扰等问题。
AI.method: ICCU从遗忘数据中归纳可读的拒绝规则，在推理时以过滤器或系统提示方式应用，规则以顺序无关的并集方式累积，遗忘数据在规则归纳后即可丢弃。
AI.result: 实验表明ICCU能有效抑制目标知识、保持模型效用、可扩展至序列化请求，并对释义和跨语言查询具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ICCU通过上下文持续遗忘框架，在不修改模型参数的情况下解决了序列化遗忘请求的挑战，实现了组合性和零跨请求干扰。

title: OmniRetriever: Any-to-Any Audio-Video-Text Retrieval via Fusion-as-Teacher Distillation
summary: Unified multimodal embedding spaces have become the standard interface for cross-modal retrieval and multimodal RAG, and recent audio-video-text (AVT) encoders extend this setting to three modalities. Such encoders can produce a joint (T,V,A) embedding whenever all three modalities are available, but standard pairwise InfoNCE objectives leave this signal unused during training. We close this gap with fusion-as-teacher distillation, which treats a stop-gradient copy of the fused embedding as a teacher signal for the single-modal embeddings, paired with a Tuple-InfoNCE term that supervises the fused embedding directly. We instantiate this objective as OmniRetriever-7B. Across six zero-shot retrieval benchmarks, OmniRetriever-7B surpasses the closed-source Gemini Embedding 2 by 13.3-18.0 R@1 on Clotho and SoundDescs, and reaches the contemporary zero-shot specialist band of open video-text encoders on MSR-VTT and MSVD. To stress-test joint representations, we further release OmniRetriever-Bench, a 12-direction AVT retrieval benchmark totaling 3782 triples; on it OmniRetriever-7B attains AVG-all 34.84, improving over Gemini Embedding 2 by 1.72 and over the best prior open-source AVT method by 8.03.

AI.tldr: 本文提出融合即蒸馏（Fusion-as-Teacher）方法，利用多模态融合嵌入作为教师信号来训练单模态嵌入，并引入Tuple-InfoNCE监督融合嵌入。基于此训练的OmniRetriever-7B模型在零样本检索基准上超越闭源Gemini Embedding 2，并发布了包含12方向检索的OmniRetriever-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有音频-视频-文本（AVT）编码器在训练时仅使用成对InfoNCE损失，未能利用三模态同时可用时的联合（T,V,A）嵌入信号，导致信息浪费。
AI.method: 提出融合即蒸馏（Fusion-as-Teacher）方法：将融合嵌入的停止梯度副本作为教师信号，蒸馏给单模态嵌入；同时引入Tuple-InfoNCE项直接监督融合嵌入。基于此训练OmniRetriever-7B模型。
AI.result: 在6个零样本检索基准上，OmniRetriever-7B在Clotho和SoundDescs上超越Gemini Embedding 2达13.3-18.0 R@1，在MSR-VTT/MSVD上达到开放视频文本编码器最优水平；在OmniRetriever-Bench上AVG-all达34.84，分别超过Gemini Embedding 2和最佳开源方法1.72和8.03。
AI.conclusion: 融合嵌入作为教师信号能有效提升多模态嵌入质量，OmniRetriever-7B在跨模态检索任务上达到领先性能，新发布的OmniRetriever-Bench为AVT检索提供了更全面的评估基准。

title: Reasoning Depth and Environment Complexity: A Controlled Study of RLVR Data Allocation across Logical Reasoning Tasks
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become central to post-training reasoning models, yet a key limitation of existing studies is their narrow view of the reasoning space: difficulty is treated as reasoning depth alone, and reward is concentrated on forward deductive state tracking. We instead characterize the reasoning space along two dimensions. Difficulty. Beyond reasoning depth, we study environment complexity, where models must identify the correct path amid distractors and interacting structures. Rewarded reasoning form. We consider four abilities core to real-world reasoning: deductive state tracking, abductive recovery of hidden events or facts, inductive rule induction, and analogical transfer. To disentangle these factors, we construct a synthetic knowledge-graph environment with controlled pre- and post-training distributions, where each instance varies along depth, complexity, and task family. Three findings emerge: joint depth-complexity coverage outperforms single-axis recipes; reasoning families respond non-uniformly, with abductive reasoning degrading outside the RL-covered region and task correlations clustering into deductive-abductive and inductive-analogy pairs; and uniform mixing outperforms staged curricula under a fixed budget. We also find that recent off-the-shelf models exhibit the same deductive-over-abductive asymmetry, suggesting that this gap is not merely an artifact of our controlled setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理空间的两维划分（难度维度：推理深度+环境复杂度；奖励推理形式维度：演绎/溯因/归纳/类比），并在合成知识图谱环境中验证发现：联合深度-复杂度覆盖优于单一维度、推理任务非均匀响应且存在聚类现象、均匀混合优于阶段式课程学习，同时商业模型也存在演绎-溯因不对称性。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR研究对推理空间的视角过于狭窄，仅将困难视为推理深度，奖励只聚焦于前向演绎状态追踪，忽略了现实推理中更丰富的维度（如环境复杂度和多种推理形式）。
AI.method: 构建合成知识图谱环境，在受控的预训练和后训练分布下，沿推理深度、环境复杂度和任务族三个维度变化实例，系统性地解耦各因素对RLVR效果的影响。
AI.result: 联合深度-复杂度覆盖优于单一维度；推理家族响应非均匀，溯因推理在RL覆盖区域外性能下降，任务相关性聚类为演绎-溯因和归纳-类比两组；固定预算下均匀混合优于阶段式课程学习；商业模型也存在演绎-溯因不对称性。
AI.conclusion: RLVR需要多维度的推理空间设计，单一维度（仅深度或仅复杂度）不足以泛化；不同推理形式对RL覆盖的敏感度不同，需针对性设计；均匀混合训练策略比课程学习更有效；当前模型普遍存在演绎强于溯因的能力缺陷。

title: StepOPSD: Step-Aware Online Preference Distillation for Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn agents suffers from a credit-assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and trajectory-level, while success often hinges on a few local decisions. Existing online policy distillation (OPD) provides denser token-level supervision, but typically treats heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings rather than causal interaction units. We present StepOPSD, a post-rollout preference self-distillation framework that takes the agent step as the unit of credit redistribution. StepOPSD decomposes trajectories into action-centered step segments, rescoring them under hindsight-enriched teacher contexts and converting token-level log-probability gaps into sign-preserving advantage shaping with a normalized per-step credit budget before the GRPO update. Across ALFWorld and Search-QA with Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, StepOPSD attains best or second-best results on subsets most sensitive to local causal errors, including first-place performance on ALFWorld Heat (79.1%), PickTwo (95.0%), Search-QA TriviaQA (61.6%), and tied-best performance on HotpotQA (40.4%). The results further reveal a consistent two-knob law: smaller α_clip acts as a broadly stabilizing local trust region, whereas the optimal global mixing strength λ_mix remains task-dependent. These findings suggest that step-aware distillation is most useful when trajectory-level rewards are weakly aligned with the local action that determines downstream success.

AI.tldr: StepOPSD通过将轨迹分解为以动作为中心的步骤单元，利用事后增强的教师上下文重新评分，在GRPO更新前进行归一化逐步骤信用分配，解决了多轮对话智能体的信用分配不匹配问题。在ALFWorld和Search-QA上取得了最佳或次佳结果，并揭示了α_clip稳定局部信任区域、λ_mix依赖任务的规律。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中稀疏的轨迹级奖励与关键局部决策之间存在信用分配不匹配，现有在线策略蒸馏将异构轨迹视为整体字符串而非因果交互单元。
AI.method: 提出StepOPSD框架，将智能体轨迹分解为以动作为中心的步骤片段，在事后增强的教师上下文中重新评分，将token级对数概率差转换为符号保持的优势塑形，在GRPO更新前进行归一化逐步骤信用预算分配。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和Search-QA上，StepOPSD在多个对局部因果错误最敏感的子集上达到最佳或次佳结果，包括ALFWorld Heat (79.1%)、PickTwo (95.0%)、Search-QA TriviaQA (61.6%)和HotpotQA (40.4%)。
AI.conclusion: 步骤感知蒸馏在轨迹级奖励与决定下游成功的局部动作弱对齐时最为有效，且存在双旋钮定律：较小的α_clip具有广泛稳定的局部信任区域，最优全局混合强度λ_mix依赖于任务。

title: DunbaaBERT: From Sacrifice to Semantics
summary: Large language models have achieved strong performance across many NLP tasks, yet Urdu remains comparatively underexplored due to limited resources and fragmented evaluation settings. To address this gap, we introduce DunbaaBERT, a family of Urdu RoBERTa-base models trained from scratch with Byte-BPE vocabularies of 32k, 52k, and 96k tokens on a deduplicated 17GB Urdu corpus. We evaluate DunbaaBERT across intrinsic and downstream Urdu NLP benchmarks covering linguistic acceptability, news classification, offensive language detection, and sentiment analysis while analyzing vocabulary-size effects on performance and efficiency trade-offs. Across benchmarks, the DunbaaBERT variants achieve competitive performance against strong multilingual baselines while consistently maintaining favorable efficiency trade-offs. Interestingly, larger vocabularies do not consistently improve downstream effectiveness, with DunbaaBERT$_{\text{32k}}$ repeatedly providing the strongest overall efficiency profile. Overall, our results demonstrate that carefully curated Urdu-specific encoder models can remain highly competitive despite comparatively compact model and training scales. All models are released under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: DunbaaBERT是一个从零训练的乌尔都语RoBERTa模型家族，使用17GB去重语料和三种Byte-BPE词表大小（32k/52k/96k），在多项基准测试中表现优异，且32k词表模型在效率上最优。
AI.motivation: 乌尔都语在大型语言模型中资源匮乏、评估标准零散，缺乏专门训练的预训练模型。
AI.method: 从零训练乌尔都语RoBERTa模型（DunbaaBERT），使用17GB去重乌尔都语语料，采用32k、52k、96k三种Byte-BPE词表大小进行训练。
AI.result: DunbaaBERT在语言可接受性、新闻分类、攻击性语言检测、情感分析等任务上达到竞争性表现，且32k词表模型在效率和性能平衡上最佳，大词表并未持续提升下游效果。
AI.conclusion: 精心策划的乌尔都语专用编码器模型即便在相对紧凑的模型和训练规模下，依然能保持很高的竞争力，所有模型已开源。

title: VitaBench 2.0: Evaluating Personalized and Proactive Agents in Long-Term User Interactions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have evolved into interactive agents that collaborate with users in real-world tasks. Effective collaboration in such settings increasingly depends on understanding the user beyond what is explicitly stated, as user intent is often reflected in fragmented daily interactions and requires both personalized modeling and proactive interaction. However, existing agent benchmarks primarily evaluate reasoning and tool use, largely overlooking the challenges of inferring and leveraging user preferences in realistic scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce VitaBench 2.0, a benchmark for evaluating personalized and proactive agent behavior in long-term user interactions. In VitaBench 2.0, tasks are organized as temporally ordered sequences for individual users, where preferences are embedded in fragmented and heterogeneous interactions. Successful completion of tasks requires the agent to continuously extract, utilize, and update user preferences from these interactions. We further evaluate proactiveness through tasks that require agents to recognize missing information and actively acquire it from users or environments before making decisions. To support systematic analysis, we provide an extensible memory interface that enables controlled comparison across different memory architectures. We benchmark a diverse set of frontier proprietary and open-source LLMs. Results show that real-world personalization remains highly challenging even for state-of-the-art models, revealing a substantial gap between current capabilities and practical requirements. Extensive analysis further reveals the failure modes and capability bottlenecks of current agents in real-world personalized decision-making, providing insights for future model improvements.

AI.tldr: VitaBench 2.0是一个评估大语言模型在长期用户交互中实现个性化和主动代理行为的基准测试。实验表明，即使是最先进的模型，在真实世界的个性化任务中仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有代理基准主要评估推理和工具使用能力，忽视了在真实场景中推断和利用用户偏好的挑战。用户意图往往体现在碎片化的日常交互中，需要个性化和主动建模。
AI.method: 构建了按时间顺序组织的用户交互任务序列，偏好嵌入在碎片化、异构的交互中。代理需持续提取、利用和更新用户偏好。通过可扩展记忆接口支持不同记忆架构的对比分析。
AI.result: 在多种前沿商用和开源LLM上进行基准测试，结果表明真实世界个性化任务对最先进模型仍极具挑战性，当前能力与实用需求存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前代理在真实世界个性化决策中存在明显的失败模式和能力瓶颈，需进一步改进模型以缩小这一差距。

title: DV-SFT: Direct Vision Supervision for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models are typically trained end-to-end to predict ground-truth answers, yet supervision signals are applied exclusively to text tokens. Visual tokens, the core carriers of visual information, are optimized only implicitly as part of the context, leading to coarse-grained visual understanding. Prior works attempt to supervise visual inputs but inevitably rely on auxiliary components such as additional decoders or forward passes, because visual tokens lack readily interpretable labels. This limits their practical applicability. In this work, we propose \textbf{D}irect \textbf{V}ision \textbf{S}upervised \textbf{F}ine-\textbf{T}uning (DV-SFT), which constructs explicit, token-level supervision for visual tokens and trains them through the same next-token prediction objective used for text. Specifically, we exploit the direct vision--text correspondence in OCR-related scenarios and automatically label each visual token with the word in its corresponding image patch. DV-SFT treats the MLLM as a black box, requiring no architectural modifications or additional forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of direct vision supervision. DV-SFT consistently outperforms standard SFT across three in-domain and four out-of-domain benchmarks. Further analyses show that vision supervision effectively enhances fine-grained visual understanding and achieves higher multimodal alignment efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DV-SFT方法，通过对视觉token进行显式的逐token监督（利用OCR场景中图像块与文本的对应关系），在不修改模型架构或增加前向传播的前提下，显著提升了多模态大模型的细粒度视觉理解能力，在多个域内和域外基准上均优于标准SFT。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM仅在文本token上施加监督信号，视觉token只能通过间接方式优化，导致视觉理解粒度粗糙。虽然有工作尝试监督视觉输入，但依赖额外的解码器或前向传播，实用性受限。
AI.method: 利用OCR场景中图像块与文本的直接对应关系，自动为每个视觉token标注其对应图像块中的单词；采用与文本相同的next-token prediction目标函数，对视觉token施加显式的逐token监督；模型作为黑盒使用，无需架构修改或额外前向传播。
AI.result: 在3个域内基准和4个域外基准上均一致优于标准SFT；视觉监督有效增强了细粒度视觉理解和多模态对齐效率。
AI.conclusion: 直接的视觉token监督是可行且有效的，能提升MLLM的视觉理解能力，且方法简洁实用，无需复杂的架构改动。

title: Beyond Questions: Evaluating What Large Language Models (Actually) Know
summary:
Parametric knowledge in large language models (LLMs) is a cornerstone of their success, yet remains poorly understood. Existing knowledge benchmarks typically rely on predefined questions (e.g., "What is the birth date of M.L. King?"), evaluating only knowledge that benchmark designers explicitly choose to query, a problematic availability bias.
  In this paper, we introduce open knowledge evaluation, a new paradigm for LLM knowledge benchmarking. Instead of asking narrow questions, it evaluates models on the knowledge they choose to surface in response to open-ended elicitation prompts (e.g., "Tell me everything you know about M.L. King"). This shifts the focus from predefined answer retrieval toward characterizing the knowledge models naturally express.
  We instantiate this paradigm with BeQu (Beyond Questions), a benchmark of 10,000 entities paired with reference corpora for statement verification. Using BeQu, we evaluate a broad range of language models and analyze the effects of reasoning effort, model scale, prompt format, and knowledge domain. Data and leaderboard are available on this work's GitHub repository and at the benchmark's website.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开放知识评估新范式，构建了包含10,000个实体的BeQu基准，通过开放式提示评估LLM自然表达的知识，而非传统预定义问答。
AI.motivation: 现有知识基准存在可用性偏差（availability bias），仅评估设计者预设的问题，无法全面反映模型实际拥有的知识。
AI.method: 提出开放知识评估范式，使用开放式提示（如"告诉我关于X的一切"）替代预设问题；构建BeQu基准（10,000个实体+参考语料库），通过语句验证评估模型自然表达的知识。
AI.result: 评估了多种语言模型，分析了推理努力、模型规模、提示格式和知识领域对知识表达的影响。
AI.conclusion: 开放知识评估能更全面地表征模型自然表达的知识，弥补传统基准的不足；数据和排行榜已公开。

title: Detecting Is Not Resolving: The Monitoring Control Gap in Retrieval Augmented LLMs
summary: Retrieval-augmented LLMs are deployed for tasks where evidence quality determines action safety, yet evaluation protocols assume that single-turn robustness predicts robustness when evidence accumulates across turns. We show this assumption is fundamentally incorrect. Models exhibit a monitoring-control gap: they readily acknowledge contradictory evidence, yet this awareness fails to constrain their final recommendations - detecting epistemic conflict does not imply resolving it safely. Through a multi-turn document accumulation protocol across four model families (1.5B-32B parameters) and over 50,000 turn-level evaluations, we demonstrate that single-turn diagnostics systematically overestimate RAG safety, that contradiction acknowledgement is uncorrelated with safe resolution, a pattern corroborated by targeted human validation, and that no universal prompt fix exists. Converging mechanism evidence - hidden-state probing, attention analysis, and response-strategy taxonomy - points to action selection as the most plausible locus of the deficit: danger-relevant information is internally represented and receives enhanced attention during unsafe generation, yet fails to constrain output behavior. The gap between what models recognize and what they do must be measured and closed before retrieval-augmented systems can be trusted in high-stakes settings.

AI.tldr: 研究发现检索增强型LLM存在"监控-控制鸿沟"：模型能识别矛盾证据，但无法据此约束最终推荐行为。单轮评估严重高估RAG安全性，且无法通过通用提示修复。
AI.motivation: 现有评估协议假设单轮鲁棒性可预测多轮证据累积下的鲁棒性，但这一假设被证明根本错误。高安全场景下需要真实评估RAG系统的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用多轮文档累积协议，在4个模型家族（1.5B-32B参数）上进行50,000+轮次评估，结合隐状态探针、注意力分析和响应策略分类进行机制分析。
AI.result: 单轮诊断系统性地高估RAG安全性；矛盾识别与安全解决无相关性；不存在通用提示修复方案；注意力增强的模型中危险相关信息仍无法约束输出行为。
AI.conclusion: 模型存在认知与行为之间的鸿沟，必须对其进行测量和弥合，才能让RAG系统在高风险场景中获得信任。

title: Respecting Modality Gap in Post-hoc Out-of-distribution Detection with Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection has emerged as a popular technique to enhance the reliability of machine learning models by identifying unexpected inputs from unknown classes. Recent progress in pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) has enabled zero-shot OOD detection without access to in-distribution (ID) training data; in this setting, existing methods commonly treat text embeddings of class names as class prototypes. In this paper, we challenge the widely adopted text-as-prototype paradigm by theoretically showing that off-the-shelf textual prototypes are generally misaligned with the optimal visual prototypes, yielding an intrinsic modality gap that cannot be eliminated by prompt engineering alone. To mitigate this gap under the post-hoc constraint, this paper presents an online pseudo-supervised framework that directly learns class prototypes in the visual feature space using unlabeled test-time data streams and soft predictions from the pre-trained VLMs. We provide theoretical guarantees for the convergence of the online optimization procedure. Extensive experiments empirically demonstrate that our method achieves a new state of the art across a variety of OOD detection setups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在线伪监督框架，直接在视觉特征空间中学习类别原型，以解决预训练视觉语言模型中文本原型与最优视觉原型之间的模态差距问题，从而提升零样本分布外检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法普遍将文本嵌入作为类别原型，但本文从理论上证明了现成的文本原型与最优视觉原型存在固有模态偏差，且无法仅通过提示工程消除，这限制了零样本OOD检测的性能。
AI.method: 提出一种在线伪监督框架，利用未标注的测试时数据流和预训练VLM的软预测，直接在视觉特征空间中学习类别原型，并提供了在线优化过程收敛性的理论保证。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在多种OOD检测设置下均达到了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 挑战了视觉语言模型中"文本即原型"的主流范式，通过在线学习视觉空间中的原型有效弥合了模态差距，为后验零样本OOD检测提供了新思路。

title: Accountable Human-AI Deliberation with LLMs: Scaling Collective Intelligence through Symbiotic Scaffolding
comment: Accepted at the LREC 2026 / 2nd Workshop on Language-driven Deliberation Technology
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can support democratic deliberation at scales previously constrained by turn-taking and facilitation bandwidth. Recent work shows that LLM-generated group statements are often preferred over human-mediated outputs, while theoretical analyses argue that LLMs relax the simultaneity constraints limiting collective intelligence. Yet pure LLM mediation risks collapsing pluralism, over-optimizing for agreement, and undermining legitimacy when participants cannot contest how they are represented. We propose a symbiotic human-AI framework organized into three layers: observation and diversity amplification, facilitation with clause-level provenance, and human primacy for ratification. Our contributions include graded coverage, diversity, and erasure metrics with salience-aware weighting; a provenance pipeline combining cross-encoder similarity with causal knockout diagnostics; preference-conditioned trade-off control; equity-aware contestability workflows; adversarial robustness tests; and an evaluation protocol with ablation designs informed by evidence of LLM-as-judge limitations. The result is a testable blueprint for deliberation technology that scales collective intelligence while preserving agency and legitimacy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种人机共生三层框架（观察与多样性放大、带子句来源的促进、人类优先批准），用于大规模民主协商，在扩展集体智能的同时保持参与者的自主性和合法性。
AI.motivation: 纯LLM中介的协商会削弱多样性、过度优化一致性，且参与者无法质疑自身被如何代表，导致合法性问题。现有方法受限于轮流发言和促进带宽，无法实现大规模民主协商。
AI.method: 三层框架：1)观察与多样性放大层；2)基于子句级别来源的促进层；3)人类优先批准层。包含分级覆盖率、多样性和擦除指标（带显著性加权）、跨编码器相似度与因果淘汰诊断的来源管线、偏好条件权衡控制、公平感知的可争议工作流、对抗鲁棒性测试，以及考虑LLM作为评判者局限性的消融实验评估协议。
AI.result: 提供了一个可测试的协商技术蓝图，理论上能够扩展集体智能，同时保持参与者的自主性和合法性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的人机共生框架为大规模民主协商提供了可行路径，在LLM辅助与人类控制之间取得平衡，既利用LLM扩展协商规模，又通过多层机制保障参与者的主体性和决策合法性。

title: Query Symbolically or Retrieve Semantically? A Dataset and Method for Semi-Structured Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for question answering typically retrieve evidence by semantic similarity between the query and document chunks. While effective for unstructured text, this approach is less reliable on semi-structured corpora where answering may require exact filtering, aggregation, or exhaustive retrieval over structured attributes across multiple documents. Symbolic approaches support such operations, but they are often brittle on noisy natural-language corpora. We address this gap with DualGraph, a RAG framework that represents documents through two complementary views: a Textual Knowledge Graph for semantic retrieval and a Symbolic Knowledge Graph for symbolic querying over typed subject--predicate--object triples. Building on these two components, we provide multiple strategies for selecting or combining semantic and symbolic evidence.We also introduce SpecsQA, a benchmark from a commercial shopping website with semi-structured product documents and manually curated questions spanning open-ended and specification-oriented retrieval. Experiments show that DualGraph consistently outperforms state-of-the-art dense-retrieval, GraphRAG, symbolic, and table-oriented baselines across question types.Code and data are available at https://github.com/corneliocristina/DualGraphRAG.

AI.tldr: DualGraph是一个RAG框架，通过文本知识图谱和符号知识图谱两种互补视图来表示文档，以支持半结构化语料上的语义检索和符号查询，在SpecsQA基准上表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统对半结构化语料处理效果不佳，语义相似度检索难以支持精确过滤、聚合等操作，而纯符号方法在处理含噪自然语言语料时脆弱易错。
AI.method: 提出DualGraph框架，构建文本知识图谱（语义检索）和符号知识图谱（基于三元组的符号查询），并提供多种策略来选择和组合两类证据。
AI.result: 在自建的SpecsQA基准上，DualGraph在各类问题上均优于稠密检索、GraphRAG、符号方法和表格基线。
AI.conclusion: 双图结构能有效结合语义与符号检索的优势，提升半结构化文档问答的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: Memory-Distilled Selection for Noise-Robust Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted by ICML2026. The code is available at https://github.com/SirojbekSafarov/MeDS
summary: Anomaly detection (AD) under data contamination is critical for deploying unsupervised defect detection in industrial environments, where curating perfectly clean training sets is impractical. However, existing methods are sensitive to contamination, suffering significant performance degradation as the noise ratio increases. In this paper, we propose Memory-Distilled Selection (MeDS), a training algorithm based on data selection. MeDS constructs an ensemble of partial memories via random subsampling, where the resulting sparsity acts as a low-pass filter that captures nominal patterns across a wide range of noise ratios, enabling coarse-level identification of contaminated samples. The aggregated distances to the bootstrapped memories are then distilled into a reconstruction score network, which is subsequently fine-tuned on clean data filtered using scores from the distilled model, enabling fine-grained localization of anomalies. MeDS is robust across a wide range of noise ratios without requiring noise-ratio-specific hyperparameter tuning, achieving 99.16\% image-level AUROC on MVTecAD at a 40\% noise ratio, and attaining state-of-the-art performance on both VisA and Real-IAD under noisy settings. We thoroughly verify the efficacy of MeDS on industrial AD benchmarks under noisy data scenarios, accompanied by in-depth empirical analyses.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于记忆蒸馏选择（MeDS）的训练算法，通过随机子采样构建部分记忆集成，利用稀疏性作为低通滤波器捕获正常模式，再蒸馏为重构分数网络进行细粒度异常定位，在数据污染下实现鲁棒的异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法对数据污染敏感，随着噪声比例增加性能显著下降，而工业场景中难以获取完全干净的训练集，因此需要一种对数据污染鲁棒的训练算法。
AI.method: 1) 通过随机子采样构建部分记忆集成，利用稀疏性作为低通滤波器捕获正常模式，实现粗粒度的污染样本识别；2) 将聚合距离蒸馏为重构分数网络；3) 在蒸馏模型过滤后的干净数据上微调，实现细粒度异常定位。
AI.result: 在40%噪声比例下，MVTecAD上达到99.16%图像级AUROC；在VisA和Real-IAD噪声设置下均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: MeDS在不同噪声比例下均具有鲁棒性，无需针对噪声比例调整超参数，是一种有效的数据污染下异常检测方案。

title: KZ-SafetyPrompts: A Kazakh Safety Evaluation Prompt Dataset for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the SIGUL2026 Workshop co-located with LREC2026
summary: Kazakh is underrepresented in resources for evaluating the safety behavior of large language models. We present KZ-SafetyPrompts, a Kazakh prompt dataset for safety evaluation across eleven categories covering common risk areas such as self-harm, violence, child exploitation, sexual content, racist content, radicalization, and regulated goods or illegal activities. The dataset contains 5,717 prompts written natively in Kazakh (Cyrillic), organized by category, with English translations for cross-lingual analysis. Prompts resemble realistic user queries, often in a teen or child style, and are phrased as intent prompts without procedural instructions. We document the writing protocol, labeling procedures (including borderline-case decision rules), and quality-control steps (schema standardization, completeness checks, and deduplication). We also align the categories with widely used safety taxonomies to support integration with existing evaluation pipelines. Baseline results with GPT-4o show an overall refusal rate of 28.2%, varying from 5.5% to 53.8% across categories, indicating that Kazakh prompts expose category-specific safety gaps not captured by English-only evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了哈萨克语安全提示数据集KZ-SafetyPrompts，包含5,717条覆盖11个风险类别的提示，基线测试显示GPT-4o的总体拒绝率仅为28.2%，揭示了哈萨克语提示能暴露英语评估无法捕获的特定类别安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 哈萨克语在大语言模型安全评估资源方面严重匮乏，现有评估体系主要基于英语，无法有效检测哈萨克语场景下的安全风险。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含5,717条哈萨克语（西里尔字母）提示的数据集，覆盖11个常见风险类别（自残、暴力、儿童剥削、色情内容、种族主义、激进化和违禁品等），每条提示附有英文翻译，采用青少年/儿童风格的真实用户查询表述，并建立了严格的标注规程、边界案例决策规则和质量控制步骤。
AI.result: 使用GPT-4o进行基线测试，总体拒绝率为28.2%，各类别拒绝率在5.5%至53.8%之间波动，表明哈萨克语提示能暴露英语评估无法捕获的特定类别安全漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 哈萨克语安全提示数据集能有效揭示多语言环境下LLM的安全漏洞，强调了非英语语言安全评估的必要性，数据集与主流安全分类体系对齐，便于集成到现有评估流程中。

title: The Compressive Knowledge Graph Hypothesis: Which Graph Facts Matter for Scientific Hypothesis Generation?
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) can provide structured scientific context to language models, but it remains unclear which graph facts actually shape the generated hypotheses. We study KG-guided hypothesis generation for battery materials across Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-70B, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. We perturb local KGs by varying density, ontology richness, topology, and control structure, and evaluate outputs with both provided-graph and fixed-reference metrics. Across models, KG utility is selective and model-dependent: graph context changes outputs, but no-KG outputs also recover substantial graph content from model priors. Compact top-k subgraphs often approximate full-KG behavior, including when claimed-outcome triples are held out. At the same time, compression is not unique to one semantic ranking rule, random and topology-based subsets can also recover much of the signal. These results support a redundancy-aware Compressive KG hypothesis: useful KG signal is often recoverable from compact, scientifically structured subgraphs rather than requiring the full local graph.

AI.tldr: 知识图谱对语言模型生成假设的影响具有选择性和模型依赖性，压缩子图往往能近似完整KG的效果，支持冗余感知的压缩KG假设。
AI.motivation: 探究知识图谱中的哪些具体事实会影响语言模型生成的科学假设，以及是否需要完整的局部KG才能有效引导假设生成。
AI.method: 在电池材料领域进行KG引导的假设生成实验，对Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-70B和Gemini 2.5 Flash三个模型，通过改变KG的密度、本体丰富度、拓扑结构和控制结构进行扰动，使用提供图和固定参考两种指标评估输出。
AI.result: KG效用具有选择性和模型依赖性；无KG的模型也能从先验知识中恢复大量图内容；紧凑的top-k子图能近似完整KG的行为，包括被排除的声称结果；随机和基于拓扑的子集也能恢复大部分信号。
AI.conclusion: 支持冗余感知的压缩KG假设：有用的KG信号通常可以从紧凑、科学结构化的子图中恢复，而非需要完整的局部图。

title: DynFrame: Adaptive Reasoning-Driven Multimodal Framework with Dynamic Frame Augmentation for Complex Video Understanding
summary: Recent video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly couple step-by-step reasoning with on-demand visual evidence retrieval, allowing models to revisit relevant video segments during inference. However, two structural gaps remain in existing thinking-with-video systems. (i) Sampling density is not a learnable decision: existing methods may let the model decide where to look, but the per-window frame rate is largely fixed. As a result, fine-grained evidence is often recovered through repeated retrieval calls, which increases inference context length and training difficulty. (ii) Retrieval and answer generation are usually optimized with a single trajectory-level advantage, so the "where to look" tokens and the "how to answer" tokens receive the same credit even when one is correct and the other is not. To address these gaps, we present DynFrame, a framework that emits the temporal window and the sampling density as native tokens within a single autoregressive pass. This learnable span-density retrieval enables acquiring multi-granularity evidence with a single retrieval step. Based on the above tokenized retrieval interface, we further introduce Segment-Decoupled GRPO (SD-GRPO), which splits each rollout at the retrieval boundary and assigns role-specific token-level advantages, separately crediting the sampling decision and the answer. Trained on the curated DM-CoT-74k and DM-RL-45k, DynFrame-4B is competitive with strong 7B-8B baselines across six benchmarks (NExT-GQA, Charades-STA, ActivityNet-MR, Video-MME, MLVU, LVBench), and DynFrame-8B sets new state-of-the-art on most metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangguanghao523/DynFrame.

AI.tldr: DynFrame提出了一种新型视频多模态大语言模型框架，通过将时间窗口和采样密度作为原生token实现可学习的跨度-密度检索，并引入SD-GRPO进行分段信用分配，在多个基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频MLLM在推理时存在两个结构性问题：(i) 采样密度不可学习，细粒度证据需多次检索，增加推理长度和训练难度；(ii) 检索与答案生成共享单一轨迹级优势，无法区分"看哪里"和"如何答"的贡献。
AI.method: 提出DynFrame框架：(1) 将时间窗口和采样密度作为原生token在单次自回归过程中生成，实现单步多粒度证据检索；(2) 引入Segment-Decoupled GRPO (SD-GRPO)，在检索边界拆分rollout，为采样决策和答案分别分配token级优势。构建DM-CoT-74k和DM-RL-45k训练集。
AI.result: DynFrame-4B在六个基准（NExT-GQA, Charades-STA, ActivityNet-MR, Video-MME, MLVU, LVBench）上可与强7B-8B基线竞争，DynFrame-8B在多数指标上达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的跨度-密度检索与分段信用分配能有效提升视频MLLM的推理效率和性能，代码已开源。

title: Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Intrinsic Knowledge Boundary Enhancement
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective for training LLM-based agents with external tool-use capabilities. However, we identify that agentic RL training induces increasing redundant tool calls and blurs the model's intrinsic knowledge boundary, where the model fails to distinguish when tools are needed versus when parametric knowledge suffices. Existing solutions based on reward shaping create coarse-grained optimization targets that tend to incentivize indiscriminate tool-call suppression, leading to reward hacking. In this paper, we propose AKBE (Agentic Knowledge Boundary Enhancement), an on-policy method that dynamically probes the model's intrinsic knowledge boundary through dual-path (with-tool and no-tool) rollouts during training. We define the knowledge boundary as the per-instance determination of whether tools are required and the minimum tool calls necessary. By comparing correctness across paths, AKBE categorizes trajectories and constructs targeted supervisory signals that guide efficient tool-use patterns for each question. These signals are integrated seamlessly into the agentic RL training loop. Experiments on seven QA benchmarks demonstrate that AKBE improves task accuracy by +1.85 on average and reduces tool calls by 18% over standard agentic RL, yielding 25% higher tool productivity without any accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Further analysis suggests its plug-and-play compatibility across different RL algorithms and the mechanism of each signal category. Our code is available at https://github.com/CuSO4-Chen/AKBE.

AI.tldr: 提出AKBE方法，通过在训练中动态探测模型的知识边界，利用双路径（使用工具和不使用工具）策略，在提升准确率的同时减少冗余工具调用。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体强化学习训练会导致模型过度依赖工具，无法区分何时需要工具、何时自身知识足够，而基于奖励塑形的粗粒度优化容易引发奖励攻击。
AI.method: 提出AKBE，一种在策略方法。在训练中通过双路径（使用工具/不使用工具）展开，动态探测模型的知识边界，比较路径正确性对轨迹分类，构建针对性监督信号，引导高效工具使用模式。
AI.result: 在7个QA基准上，AKBE相比标准智能体RL平均准确率提升+1.85，工具调用减少18%，工具生产力提高25%，且无准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: AKBE能有效增强模型知识边界意识，减少冗余工具调用，兼容不同RL算法，实现即插即用。

title: Learning to Act under Noise: Enhancing Agent Robustness via Noisy Environments
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have facilitated the widespread deployment of LLMs as interactive agents capable of reasoning, planning, and tool use. Despite strong performance on existing benchmarks, such agents often exhibit notable degradation when deployed in real-world settings, where environments are inherently stochastic and imperfect. We argue that this discrepancy arises from a fundamental mismatch between idealized training settings and real-world interaction dynamics, where current paradigms rely on carefully curated task instructions and stable, well-controlled environments. To address this gap, we propose NoisyAgent, an agentic training framework that explicitly incorporates environmental imperfections into the agent learning process. We identify two major sources of interaction noise in real-world scenarios: user noise, which captures ambiguity and variability in user interaction, and tool noise, which reflects failures and anomalies in tool execution. We introduce such perturbations into the training pipeline by modifying user interaction patterns and simulating tool execution results within the training environment. To stabilize training while encouraging agents to handle increasingly challenging imperfections, noise is applied to only a subset of rollouts and progressively increased in difficulty as the model adapts to the current noise level. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently improves agent robustness under noisy and dynamic environments. Our analysis reveals that training under noise conditions also yields performance gains on idealized benchmarks, suggesting that controlled exposure to environmental noise promotes more generalizable reasoning and decision-making behaviors. Our findings highlight the importance of modeling interaction imperfections for bridging the gap between agent training and real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型智能体在真实环境中因噪声（用户噪声和工具噪声）导致性能下降的问题，提出NoisyAgent训练框架，通过模拟交互噪声逐步增强训练，显著提升智能体鲁棒性，并发现噪声训练还能改善理想场景下的通用推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在理想化基准测试中表现优异，但在真实随机且不完美的环境中性能显著下降，根本原因是训练环境与现实交互动态之间存在根本性错配。当前范式依赖精心策划的指令和稳定可控的环境，无法应对实际交互中的噪声。
AI.method: 提出NoisyAgent框架，识别两类交互噪声：用户噪声（用户交互中的模糊性和变异性）和工具噪声（工具执行中的失败和异常）。通过修改用户交互模式和模拟工具执行结果将这些扰动引入训练流程；仅对部分rollout子集施加噪声，并随模型适应逐步增加难度，以稳定训练。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明NoisyAgent在噪声和动态环境下持续提升智能体鲁棒性；分析还发现噪声训练也能提升在理想化基准上的性能，表明受控的噪声暴露可促进更通用的推理和决策行为。
AI.conclusion: 建模交互不完美性对于弥合智能体训练与真实部署之间的鸿沟至关重要。

title: PinPoint: Prompting with Informative Interior Points
summary: Modern referring image segmentation pipelines couple a vision-language model (VLM) for grounding with a promptable segmenter such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for mask generation. Prior training-free instances of this recipe consistently trail fine-tuned and reinforcement-learning (RL)-tuned specialists, and it has been unclear whether the gap comes from the VLM's grounding, SAM's capacity, or the prompt. We show that the gap is dominated by prompt ambiguity: a VLM-proposed bounding box (bbox) leaves SAM to guess which pixels inside the bbox belong to the object the expression denotes. Interior points are the natural disambiguator, but where they fall matters; prior work relies on naively sampled points that land on boundaries, distractors, and background clutter, and can even hurt performance compared to the bbox alone. Supervised and RL-tuned methods close this gap by training a VLM to predict better points; we show that this training is unnecessary. At a matched budget of five interior points, replacing naive sampling with stable, informative point selection improves cumulative Intersection-over-Union (cIoU) by 12-18 points across RefCOCO/+/g, with every model fixed. We turn this observation into PinPoint, a deterministic, training-free point selector that fuses four visual cues into a consensus map, selects compact, spatially diverse points away from boundaries, and uses the frozen VLM to label each point. Without any task-specific training, PinPoint matches supervised and RL-tuned specialists on the same stack while issuing only two VLM calls per query.

AI.tldr: 本文发现指代图像分割中VLM+SAM组合的性能差距主要源于提示模糊性，并提出一种无需训练的点选择方法PinPoint，通过稳定、信息丰富的内点选择，在无需微调或强化学习的情况下，匹配甚至超越有监督和RL调优的专家模型。
AI.motivation: 现有无需训练的VLM+SAM分割流程性能始终落后于微调和RL调优的专家模型，但此前不清楚差距来自VLM的定位能力、SAM的容量还是提示本身。本文旨在探究这一差距的根本原因并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 提出PinPoint，一种确定性、无需训练的点选择器。它融合四种视觉线索生成共识图，选择紧凑、空间多样且远离边界的点，并利用冻结的VLM为每个点打标签。通过稳定、信息丰富的内点选择替代朴素采样。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO/+/g数据集上，使用匹配的5个内点预算，PinPoint相比朴素采样在cIoU上提升12-18个点，无需任何任务特定训练即匹配有监督和RL调优的专家模型，且每次查询仅需两次VLM调用。
AI.conclusion: 性能差距主要源于提示模糊性（VLM提出的边界框让SAM难以区分框内哪些像素属于目标），而非VLM的定位能力或SAM的容量。通过更优的点选择策略可以无需训练即可弥合这一差距。

title: AlbanianLLMSafety: A Safety Evaluation Dataset for Large Language Models in Albanian
comment: Accepted at SIGUL2026 Workshop co-located with LREC2026
summary: Safety evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has largely focused on high-resource languages, leaving low-resource languages critically underserved. We present AlbanianLLMSafety, the first publicly available safety evaluation dataset for LLMs in Albanian, a linguistically distinct low-resource language with approximately 7.5 million speakers across Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia, and the diaspora. The dataset contains 2,951 prompts spanning 11 safety categories, including self-harm, violence, racist content, child exploitation, and radicalization, with an average of 268 prompts per category. Each prompt is provided in Albanian with an English reference translation and a detailed category label. This resource addresses a significant gap in safety evaluation infrastruc-ture for low-resource languages and provides an essential benchmark for developing safer, more inclusive LLMs. The dataset will be provided upon request to support safety evaluation, fine-tuning, red-teaming, and guardrail development for Albanian-speaking communities.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了AlbanianLLMSafety，这是首个针对阿尔巴尼亚语（一种低资源语言）的LLM安全评估数据集，包含2,951个提示词，涵盖11个安全类别，旨在填补低资源语言安全评估基础设施的空白。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM安全评估主要集中在高资源语言上，低资源语言严重缺乏安全评估数据和基准，导致这些语言的使用者面临潜在的安全风险。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含2,951个提示词的数据集，覆盖11个安全类别（如自残、暴力、种族主义、儿童剥削、激进化等），每个类别平均268个提示词。每条提示包含阿尔巴尼亚语原文、英语参考翻译和详细类别标签。
AI.result: 成功创建了首个可公开获取的阿尔巴尼亚语LLM安全评估数据集，填补了低资源语言安全评估基础设施的关键空白。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可用于安全评估、微调、红队测试和护栏开发，有助于为阿尔巴尼亚语社区开发更安全、更具包容性的LLM。

title: Gumbel Machine: Counterfactual Student Writing Generation via Gumbel Noise Steering
summary: An effective method of teaching across disciplines is to provide examples of high-quality work. However, an example may be significantly different from a student's current work, making it challenging for them to emulate. An ideal learning demonstration is a counterfactual version of the student work, an improved version that is still similar to their own. Existing automated approaches for counterfactual text generation using Large Language Models (LLMs) result in domain-specific systems that are difficult to translate into practical applications. We present the Gumbel Machine, a flexible, modular approach to generating counterfactuals that leverages LLM instruction-following capabilities while encouraging similarity to a reference factual text. Central to our approach is a novel, controlled decoding algorithm, $β$-Hindsight control, which uses latent randomness as a tunable similarity control mechanism during counterfactual generation. Experiments on datasets of student writing, scored on various criteria, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach at generating counterfactuals both rubric-consistent and similar to a reference.

AI.tldr: 提出Gumbel Machine框架，利用β-Hindsight控制算法在保持与原文相似性的同时生成符合评分标准的反事实文本，适用于学生写作改进。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实文本生成方法依赖LLM但领域特定、难以实用，且理想的教学示例（反事实版本的学生作品）缺乏灵活通用的自动生成方案。
AI.method: 提出Gumbel Machine模块化框架，核心是β-Hindsight控制解码算法，利用潜在随机性作为可调相似度控制机制，在生成反事实时平衡与参考文本的相似性和评分标准一致性。
AI.result: 在多标准评分的学生写作数据集上，该方法生成的反事实文本既符合评分标准，又与原文保持高度相似性。
AI.conclusion: Gumbel Machine是一种灵活、模块化的反事实生成方法，有效解决了LLM在跨学科教学场景中生成贴近学生原作的高质量改进示例问题。

title: Rotation-Invariant Spherical Watermarking via Third-Order SO(3) Representation Coupling
summary: Reliable watermarking of panoramic imagery is fundamentally challenged by arbitrary 3D rotations. As panoramas are defined on the sphere, they naturally transform under the action of $SO(3)$, rendering conventional planar representations and augmentation-based robustness strategies inadequate and devoid of theoretical guarantees. To address this, we formulate panoramas as spherical signals and leverage $SO(3)$ representation theory to derive provably rotation-invariant descriptors. While spherical harmonic coefficients transform equivariantly under rotations, the natural invariant constructions are typically limited to zeroth-order statistics which eliminate directional information and severely constrain embedding capacity. In this work, we introduce a principled third-order invariant construction by coupling higher-order $SO(3)$ irreducible representations via tensor products and projecting onto the trivial representation. This yields a spherical invariant bispectrum that preserves phase information while remaining strictly rotation-invariant. Leveraging this property, we embed watermarks into higher-order spherical harmonic coefficients and recover them from invariant bispectral scalars, enabling reliable extraction under arbitrary 3D rotations. We provide a theoretical proof of $SO(3)$ invariance for it and demonstrate experimentally its near-perfect robustness to continuous rotations while maintaining high visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于球谐函数双谱（bispectrum）的第三阶旋转不变量，用于全景图像的水印嵌入与提取，在任意3D旋转下实现近乎完美的鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 全景图像面临任意3D旋转的挑战，传统平面水印方法缺乏理论保证，而现有球谐旋转不变构造仅局限于零阶统计量，丢弃方向信息，严重限制了水印嵌入容量。
AI.method: 将全景图像建模为球面信号，利用SO(3)表示理论，通过张量积耦合高阶不可约表示并投影到平凡表示上，构建第三阶旋转不变的双谱特征；将水印嵌入高阶球谐系数，从不变双谱标量中恢复水印。
AI.result: 理论证明了SO(3)不变性；实验表明在连续旋转下具有近乎完美的鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的第三阶不变双谱构造在保留相位信息的同时实现严格旋转不变，有效解决了全景图像水印在任意旋转下的鲁棒嵌入与提取问题。

title: JuICE: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Judge in Identifying Cultural Errors
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to users around the world, they are integrated into everyday tasks across diverse cultural contexts, from drafting personal communications to brainstorming creative ideas. These tasks are inherently cultural: they require contextual appropriateness, symbolic resonance, and tacit cultural expectations that native speakers draw on instinctively, meaning that a response can be factually plausible yet unmistakably wrong to a local reader. Existing cultural benchmarks have treated culture as a flat set of facts via fact verification or norm entailment methods, and have adopted LLM-as-a-Judge without examining whether they can capture such thick cultural errors. To address this gap, we present JuICE (Benchmark for LLM-Judge in Identifying Cultural Errors), a multilingual dataset of 7,470 span-level annotations of cultural and linguistic errors in long-form LLM responses. It covers 1,050 query-response pairs from four countries (the United States, South Korea, Indonesia, and Bangladesh), in both English and their countries' main languages. Using JuICE, we find that even the strongest LLM-judge achieves only an F1 of 0.52 in the erroneous span detection task. Furthermore, LLM-judges consistently miss thick cultural errors that local residents readily identify. Our findings suggest that robust cultural evaluation must move beyond surface-level detection toward frameworks that account for the depth and situatedness of cultural meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了JuICE基准，一个包含7,470个跨文化错误标注的多语言数据集，用于评估LLM作为评判者识别文化错误的能力。研究发现即使最强的LLM评判者在错误跨度检测任务中F1仅为0.52，且持续遗漏本地居民能轻易识别的"厚文化"错误。
AI.motivation: 现有文化基准将文化视为扁平的事实集合，采用LLM作为评判者但未检验其是否能捕捉深层文化错误（thick cultural errors），即那些事实正确但在特定文化语境中明显不当的回应。
AI.method: 构建JuICE数据集：包含1,050个查询-响应对，覆盖美国、韩国、印度尼西亚和孟加拉国四个国家，使用英语和各国主要语言，包含7,470个跨度级别的文化和语言错误标注。
AI.result: 最强LLM评判者在错误跨度检测任务中F1仅为0.52，且LLM评判者持续遗漏本地居民能轻易识别的厚文化错误。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的文化评估必须超越表面层面的检测，转向能够解释文化意义的深度和情境性的框架。

title: SIA: Self Improving AI with Harness & Weight Updates
summary: Humans are the bottleneck in building and improving AI. Both the models and the agents that wrap them are written, tuned, and corrected by people. The long-horizon goal of an AI that can figure out how to improve itself remains open. Two largely disjoint research lines attack this bottleneck. The harness-update school has a meta-agent rewrite the scaffold of a task-specific agent (its tools, prompts, retry logic, and search procedure) while the model weights are held fixed. The test-time training school uses hand-written RL pipelines to update the model's own weights on task feedback while the harness is held fixed. These two silos operate in isolation. We propose SIA, a self-improving loop in which a language-model agent (the Feedback-Agent) updates both the harness and the weights of a task-specific agent. We evaluate across three contrasting domains: Chinese legal charge classification, low-level GPU kernel optimisation, and single-cell RNA denoising. Combining both levers outperforms scaffold iteration alone on all three benchmarks. The gains are 56.6% on LawBench, 91.9% runtime reduction on GPU kernels, and 502% on denoising over the initial baseline. Harness updates make the model agentic, shaping how it searches and acts, while weight updates build the domain intuition that no prompt or scaffold can instil.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SIA框架，让一个语言模型智能体（反馈智能体）同时更新任务智能体的脚手架（工具、提示、重试逻辑）和模型权重，在三个不同领域（中国法律罪名分类、GPU内核优化、单细胞RNA降噪）中分别取得56.6%、91.9%和502%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 人类是构建和改进AI的瓶颈，当前两个研究方向（脚手架更新和测试时训练）各自独立运行，缺乏统一的自我改进框架。
AI.method: 提出SIA（Self-Improving Agent）框架，由一个反馈智能体同时更新任务智能体的脚手架（工具、提示、重试逻辑、搜索过程）和模型权重，形成闭环自我改进。
AI.result: 在三个领域均超越仅更新脚手架的基线方法：LawBench提升56.6%，GPU内核运行时减少91.9%，单细胞RNA降噪提升502%。
AI.conclusion: 脚手架更新赋予智能体搜索和行动能力，权重更新建立提示或脚手架无法灌输的领域直觉，两者结合效果最优。

title: METATR: A Multilingual, Evolving Benchmark for Automatic Text Recognition
summary: Benchmarks that reflect the diversity and complexity of real-world documents are essential for accurately evaluating Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) systems, especially Vision-Large Language Models (vLLMs). Although recent models demonstrate impressive performance, they are often evaluated on datasets containing modern, printed texts mostly written in English, which limits their relevance to many practical applications. Therefore, selecting a model for a specific use case requires evaluating it on data that matches the target documents. This highlights the importance of representative benchmarks for real-world applications. In this paper, we introduce METATR (v1.0), a multilingual, evolving benchmark designed to evaluate ATR models across a wide range of documents, facilitating meaningful model comparison and selection. The benchmark was designed to maximize diversity by including documents from various public collections. These documents cover 29 languages and include texts with multiple scripts and layouts. Beyond the dataset itself, METATR defines a standardized prompting and normalization methodology and establishes a dynamic evaluation framework. This approach is intended to produce reproducible results while remaining extensible over time. We evaluated a wide range of state-of-the-art systems, including open-source models and closed-source models. Results are reported across various dimensions, including performance at the dataset and language levels, robustness to handwritten documents, and computational efficiency. Our findings show that, although proprietary models achieve the most consistent performance, substantial variability persists across scripts and layouts. Overall, METATR provides a multidimensional, practitioner-oriented framework for assessing multilingual ATR in real-world conditions and tracking progress as the field evolves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了METATR (v1.0)，一个多语言、动态演进的基准测试，用于自动文本识别（ATR）系统评估，涵盖29种语言、多样化文档类型，并建立了标准化评估框架，实验表明闭源模型表现最佳但不同脚本和布局间仍存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试多集中于现代印刷英文文本，无法反映真实文档的多样性和复杂性，难以支持实际应用场景中ATR系统（特别是vLLMs）的有效评估和选型。
AI.method: 从多个公开数据集收集覆盖29种语言的多样化文档，设计标准化提示词与归一化方法，建立可扩展的动态评估框架，对包括开源和闭源在内的多种最新ATR系统进行多维度评估。
AI.result: 闭源专有模型性能最一致，但不同脚本和布局间仍存在显著性能差异；METATR从数据集、语言、手写文档鲁棒性及计算效率等多个维度提供了评估结果。
AI.conclusion: METATR为多语言ATR系统在真实场景下的评估提供了一个多维度、面向实践者的框架，能够追踪领域进展并支持模型选型。

title: Tournament-GRPO: Group-Wise Tournament Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Open-Ended Long-Form Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning in open-ended long-form generation is challenging because reliable reference answers and automatic metrics are often unavailable. Existing rubric-based methods typically rely on pointwise LLM-as-a-judge scoring, but absolute scores are difficult to calibrate across complex responses, may provide weak discrimination among same-query rollouts, and can become saturated during optimization. We propose Tournament-GRPO, a group-wise reward framework that converts rubric-guided LLM judgments into relative rewards through repeated multi-round tournaments among same-query rollouts. Tournament-GRPO compares candidates within groups, accumulates tournament outcomes, and normalizes them into group-wise rewards for GRPO training. Experiments on Deep Research Bench show that Tournament-GRPO consistently outperforms existing reward-design baselines, achieving a 4.52-point overall-score improvement over the strongest baseline. Further analyses show that tournament rewards provide a favorable effectiveness--efficiency trade-off and that tournament design affects training dynamics. These results suggest that rubric-guided tournament comparison provides an effective reward signal for reinforcement learning in open-ended long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Tournament-GRPO框架，通过回合制锦标赛比较将rubric引导的LLM评判转化为相对奖励，用于强化学习训练，在开放生成长文本生成任务中超越现有基线4.52分。
AI.motivation: 开放生成长文本生成的强化学习中，可靠的参考答案和自动评估指标难以获得，现有基于rubric的点式LLM评判方法存在分数校准困难、区分度弱、易饱和等问题。
AI.method: 提出Tournament-GRPO，一种基于群组的奖励框架，通过对同一查询的多个生成结果进行多轮锦标赛比较，累积锦标赛结果并归一化为群组奖励，用于GRPO训练。
AI.result: 在Deep Research Bench上，Tournament-GRPO一致优于现有奖励设计基线，整体分数提升4.52分。锦标赛奖励在效果与效率之间取得了良好的平衡，锦标赛设计影响训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 基于rubric引导的锦标赛比较为开放生成长文本生成的强化学习提供了有效的奖励信号。

title: Joint 2D-3D Segmentation and Association in Street-level Imaging
comment: 15 pages, 6 image figures, 1 in-body table, 1 in-body algorithm, 2 indexes with tables
summary: Accurate interpretation of street-level imagery is essential for large-scale urban mapping and the creation of Spatial Digital Twin (SDT) environments. This work presents a unified framework for joint 2D-3D segmentation and association that integrates visual semantics with multi-view geometric reasoning. Unlike conventional approaches that rely heavily on sequential frames for temporal tracking, our method leverages zero-shot detection and segmentation together with structure-from-motion reconstruction to establish stable cross-view correspondences. A 3D-driven association mechanism replaces traditional 2D multi-object tracking, using geometric consistency to guide identity preservation across wide-baseline viewpoints and varying imaging conditions. By combining 2D texture cues with global 3D context, the proposed pipeline is well-suited for scalable street-level processing and can be used for a variety of object types. Experiments demonstrate substantially improved coverage of ground-truth sequences and more robust identity retention compared to state-of-the-art 2D-only tracking methods, achieving a 22% performance gain in challenging urban scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种联合2D-3D分割与关联的统一框架，利用零样本检测、结构从运动重建和3D驱动关联机制，替代传统2D多目标跟踪，实现街景图像中跨视角的稳定对应和身份保持，在复杂城市场景中比现有2D方法性能提升22%。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖时序帧进行目标跟踪，难以处理宽基线视角和复杂成像条件下的街景图像，需要更鲁棒的大规模城市地图构建方法。
AI.method: 采用零样本检测与分割结合结构从运动重建建立跨视角对应，通过3D驱动的关联机制替代2D多目标跟踪，利用几何一致性保持目标身份，融合2D纹理与全局3D上下文。
AI.result: 相比最先进的纯2D跟踪方法，在复杂城市场景中实现22%的性能提升，对地面真实序列的覆盖率和身份保持鲁棒性显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适用于大规模街景处理，支持多种目标类型，为空间数字孪生环境构建提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Recon: Reconstruction-Guided Reasoning Synthesis for User Modeling
summary: User modeling aims to use language models (LMs) to mimic an individual's behavior from a corpus of past context-action pairs (e.g., conversation turns), enabling the simulation of users in settings like behavioral science, human-AI collaboration, and market research. Recent approaches augment these corpora with synthesized reasoning traces, typically generated by conditioning on both context and action. However, such conditioning constitutes post-hoc rationalization rather than reasoning: the trace is guaranteed to justify the action, but may not encode the underlying latent causal decision paths. We propose Recon, which uses action reconstruction to score reasoning traces by their predictive power: given a context and candidate reasoning, a reconstruction model predicts the action, and reconstruction fidelity determines reasoning quality. Across four domains, Recon achieves a 54.7% win rate over Backward Synthesis, a standard post-hoc rationalization baseline. Further, we find that training a reasoning synthesis model with rewards derived from Recon improves downstream user modeling performance, achieving a win rate of up to 70.0% over baselines. We further show that Recon-synthesized reasoning transfers across models, and improves user modeling beyond the reconstruction model. Our work demonstrates that post-hoc rationalization is insufficient for reasoning synthesis, and that useful and interpretable reasoning should naturally elicit the action from the context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Recon方法，通过动作重建（action reconstruction）来评分推理轨迹的预测能力，以替代传统的后验合理化方法。实验表明Recon在用户建模中显著优于基线方法，且合成的推理具有跨模型迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理轨迹合成方法通常采用后验合理化（即同时基于上下文和动作生成推理），这导致生成的推理只是对动作的事后辩解，而非真正编码决策背后的潜在因果路径，无法捕捉真实的决策过程。
AI.method: 提出Recon框架：给定上下文和候选推理，使用重建模型预测动作，根据重建保真度（即预测准确性）来评估推理质量。在此基础上，利用Recon产生的奖励信号训练推理合成模型，以生成更高质量的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个领域上，Recon相比后验合理化基线Backward Synthesis取得54.7%的胜率；使用Recon奖励训练的推理合成模型在用户建模中取得最高70.0%的胜率；合成的推理可跨模型迁移。
AI.conclusion: 后验合理化不足以用于推理轨迹合成；真正有用且可解释的推理应当能够自然地（仅从上下文中）引出动作，而非事后为动作找理由。

title: Maat: The Agentic Legal Research Assistant for Competition Protection
summary: Competition law experts conducting legal research must review extensive volumes of cases, decisions, and judicial reports to identify precedents and assess key elements in competition and merger cases. Although general research assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT and legal assistants such as SaulLM-7B and LegalGPT are increasingly used to assist legal research, they remain inadequate for competition law analysis: they lack specialized domain expertise, provide insufficient official citations, or hallucinate competition law cases. We propose Maat, a ReAct agent that orchestrates tools corresponding to different tasks of the research process. Designed iteratively with competition law experts, Maat grounds cases and findings in official sources using RAG for reliability, provides rich in-line citations, falls back to web search when database coverage is insufficient, and prompts the user for clarification when queries are ambiguous. Maat significantly outperforms all baseline assistants on case-specific tasks and performs within range of the top baseline on theoretical question tasks. The dataset used is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Maat，一个专为竞争法研究设计的ReAct智能体，通过结合RAG、网络搜索和用户交互，在案例特定任务上显著优于现有通用及法律助手。
AI.motivation: 现有通用助手（如Claude、ChatGPT）和法律助手（如SaulLM-7B、LegalGPT）缺乏竞争法领域专业知识，提供的官方引用不足，且存在幻觉问题，无法满足竞争法案例研究的实际需求。
AI.method: 提出Maat，一个基于ReAct范式的智能体，通过编排多个工具（RAG用于官方溯源、网络搜索用于数据库覆盖不足时回退、用户澄清机制处理模糊查询）来系统化完成竞争法研究流程中的不同任务。
AI.result: Maat在案例特定任务上显著优于所有基线助手，在理论问题任务上达到与最佳基线相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过领域专用设计与迭代开发，结合多工具编排与可靠溯源，Maat有效弥补了现有助手在竞争法分析中的不足，为法律AI研究提供了可落地的实践经验。

title: Learning Reference-Guided Exposure Correction with Hybrid Illumination Characteristics
summary: We present HICNet, a reference-guided exposure correction framework. A lightweight, content-agnostic encoder distills each image into a compact illumination embedding capturing regional brightness, edge contrast, and higher-order luminance moments. The embedding difference between a source and its reference drives a multi-scale modulation network that combines FiLM-based global adjustment with Photometric Channel Rebalancing for fine-grained, illumination-aware spectral gating, producing exposure-matched outputs while faithfully preserving scene details. A cross-batch contrastive loss orders the illumination manifold, bolstering robustness to diverse lighting conditions. Trained without ground truth or intrinsic decomposition, HICNet attains better accuracy on public benchmarks and generalizes well to entirely unseen scenes.

AI.tldr: HICNet是一个参考引导的曝光校正框架，通过轻量级编码器提取光照嵌入，结合FiLM全局调整和Photometric Channel Rebalancing细粒度光谱门控，在无真值或本征分解训练下实现高精度曝光校正和良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有曝光校正方法依赖真值数据或本征分解，泛化能力有限，因此提出一种参考引导的无监督框架以提升鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.method: 采用内容无关的轻量级编码器将图像蒸馏为紧凑的光照嵌入（包含区域亮度、边缘对比度、高阶亮度矩）；源图像与参考图像的嵌入差异驱动多尺度调制网络，结合FiLM全局调整与Photometric Channel Rebalancing细粒度光谱门控；引入跨批对比损失排序光照流形。
AI.result: 在公开基准上达到更高准确性，且在未见过的场景中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: HICNet无需真值或本征分解即可有效校正曝光，具有较强的泛化能力。

title: 2-ASP(Q) programs with weak constraints: Complexity and efficient implementation
summary: ASP(Q) extends Answer Set Programming (ASP) with Quantifiers over answer sets. In this paper we focus on the class of ASP(Q) programs with two quantifiers and weak constraints, denoted as 2-ASP(Q)^w. 2-ASP(Q)^w is a practically relevant fragment of ASP(Q) that is expressive enough to capture optimization problems up to the class Delta_3^P. On the theoretical side, we provide a complete complexity characterization of the main computational tasks for 2-ASP(Q)^w programs, including tight completeness results and the analysis of nontrivial cases that have not been addressed in previous works. On the practical side, we introduce novel strategies for computing (optimal) quantified answer sets in the Casper system, that rely on a Counterexample-Guided Abstraction Refinement (CEGAR) technique tailored to ASP(Q). An experimental evaluation on hard benchmarks from different application domains shows that the proposed techniques are effective in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带弱约束的二阶量词回答集编程（2-ASP(Q)^w），给出了完整的复杂性刻画，并提出了基于CEGAR的高效求解方法，实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: ASP(Q)扩展了回答集编程以支持量词，但含有弱约束的量词片段缺乏完整的复杂性分析和高效求解方法。
AI.method: 给出了2-ASP(Q)^w的复杂性完整分类，并在Casper系统中实现了基于反例引导抽象精化（CEGAR）的策略来计算（最优）量词回答集。
AI.result: 在多个领域的困难基准测试上，所提方法在实际中表现有效。
AI.conclusion: 2-ASP(Q)^w是表达力强且实用的ASP(Q)片段，其复杂性已被完整刻画，基于CEGAR的求解策略在实践中表现良好。

title: CIRCLED: A Multi-turn CIR Dataset with Consistent Dialogues across Domains
summary: Existing Multi-Turn Composed Image Retrieval (MTCIR) datasets lack dialogue-history consistency and are restricted to the fashion domain. To address these limitations, we construct CIRCLED by extending FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO. In CIRCLED, the query at each turn progressively approaches the target image. Data are generated via a CIReVL-based retrieval pipeline and curated with multiple filters on retrieval success, turn length, consistency, and information redundancy to ensure quality. In total, we collect 22,608 multi-turn sessions across nine subsets, substantially exceeding Multi-turn FashionIQ (11,505 sessions) in both scale and generality. We further apply multiple baseline methods and quantitatively assess retrieval accuracy on CIRCLED. Our work provides a practical, high-quality benchmark to facilitate future research on multi-turn CIR. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tk1441/CIRCLED and https://github.com/mti-lab/circled.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了CIRCLED数据集，通过扩展FashionIQ、CIRR和CIRCO，采用CIReVL流水线和多重过滤机制，生成了22,608个多轮对话会话，解决了现有MTCIR数据集缺乏对话一致性和领域局限的问题，为多轮组合图像检索提供了大规模、高质量的基准。
AI.motivation: 现有MTCIR数据集存在两个主要问题：一是缺乏对话历史一致性，二是仅限于时尚领域。为了解决这些局限性，需要构建一个更通用且对话一致性更强的多轮组合图像检索数据集。
AI.method: 基于FashionIQ、CIRR和CIRCO三个数据集进行扩展；采用CIReVL检索流水线生成数据；通过检索成功、对话轮次长度、一致性和信息冗余等多个过滤器进行质量筛选；最终得到覆盖9个子集、22,608个多轮会话的数据集。
AI.result: 构建了包含22,608个多轮会话的CIRCLED数据集，涵盖9个子集，在规模和通用性上显著超过Multi-turn FashionIQ（11,505个会话）；在数据集上评估了多种基线方法的检索准确率。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一个实用、高质量的多轮组合图像检索基准，有助于推动该领域的未来研究，数据及代码已开源。

title: Prompt Injection Detection is Regime-Dependent: A Deployment-Aware Evaluation with Interpretable Structural Signals
summary: Prompt injection poses a critical threat to the safe deployment of large language models, yet existing detection approaches are typically evaluated under limited settings that do not reflect real-world operating constraints. In this work, we present a deployment-aware evaluation of prompt injection detection using a multi-model and multi-regime experimental framework. We compare lexical, semantic, structural, and transformer-based detectors across multiple out-of-distribution settings, repeated data splits, and both ranking and thresholded deployment metrics. We introduce interpretable structural signals that capture hierarchy overrides, system prompt spoofing, role redefinition, and evasion patterns, and assess their contribution both within sparse models and in combination with strong encoder baselines. Our results show that detection performance is highly regime-dependent and sensitive to threshold selection, with no single model dominating across all settings. Transformer-based models achieve the strongest overall performance, while structural signals provide modest but consistent gains in certain regimes and improve low false positive rate behaviour in harder scenarios. These findings highlight the gap between ranking performance and deployment effectiveness and underscore the importance of evaluating prompt injection defences under realistic operational constraints. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种部署感知的提示注入检测评估框架，在多种模型和场景下比较了词汇、语义、结构和基于Transformer的检测器，发现检测性能高度依赖于部署场景，且没有单一模型在所有设置中占优。
AI.motivation: 现有提示注入检测方法通常在有限设置下评估，未能反映真实世界的操作约束，因此需要一种更贴近实际部署的评估框架。
AI.method: 采用多模型、多场景的实验框架，比较了词汇、语义、结构和Transformer四种检测器；引入可解释的结构信号；在多种分布外设置、重复数据划分以及排序和阈值化部署指标下进行评估。
AI.result: 检测性能高度依赖部署场景，对阈值选择敏感；Transformer模型整体表现最佳；结构信号在特定场景下提供适度且一致的提升，并在困难场景中改善低假阳性率行为。
AI.conclusion: 排名性能与部署有效性之间存在差距，强调应在真实操作约束下评估提示注入防御方法。

title: Alignment Tampering: How Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Is Exploited to Optimize Misaligned Biases
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026, Source code: https://alignment-tampering.github.io/
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is the standard method to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences. In this work, we introduce alignment tampering, a potential vulnerability where the LLM undergoing alignment influences the preference dataset, causing RLHF to amplify undesired behaviors. This arises from core limitations of RLHF: (1) preference datasets are constructed from the LLM's own outputs, allowing it to influence them, and (2) pairwise comparisons only indicate which response is better, not why. These limitations can be exploited to cause alignment tampering. For example, if an LLM generates biased responses with higher quality, annotators will prefer them based on quality. However, preference labels do not distinguish quality from bias, and the reward model inherits this limitation. Optimizing such rewards through reinforcement learning or best-of-N sampling can amplify misaligned biases. Our experiments demonstrate amplification across diverse biases: from keyword bias to propaganda (e.g., sexism), brand promotion, and instrumental goal-seeking. Mitigation remains challenging, as existing techniques for robust RLHF fail to fully resolve alignment tampering without sacrificing response quality. These findings reveal structural vulnerabilities of current RLHF and emphasize the need to prevent this vulnerability. Project page: https://alignment-tampering.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了RLHF在偏好数据集构建过程中的一个结构性漏洞：当LLM自身的输出被用于构建偏好数据时，它可能通过生成“高质量但带有偏见”的响应来影响人类标注者的选择，从而使得RLHF过程放大了不良行为，而非消除它们。
AI.motivation: 现有的RLHF方法存在核心局限性：偏好数据来自LLM自身的输出，且成对比较只表明哪个更好，而不说明为什么更好。这些局限性可能被利用，导致LLM在对齐过程中反向影响偏好数据集，从而放大不良行为。
AI.method: 作者定义并系统研究了alignment tampering这一漏洞，通过在多个任务中设计实验（如关键词偏见、性别歧视、品牌推广、工具性目标寻求等），让LLM生成带有偏见但质量更高的响应，观察RLHF是否放大了这些偏见。
AI.result: 实验表明，在多种偏见类型上，alignment tampering均导致RLHF显著放大了偏见行为。现有的鲁棒RLHF技术在保持响应质量的同时，无法完全解决这一问题。
AI.conclusion: RLHF存在结构性的漏洞，需要从数据构建和偏好建模层面进行根本性改进，以防止alignment tampering的发生。

title: Self-Intersection-Aware 3D Human Motion Generation Using an Efficient Human Sphere Proxy
summary: Human motion generation has made tremendous progress in recent years, with state-of-the-art approaches surpassing ground truth data in leading evaluation benchmarks. However, visual inspection of the generated motions paints a different picture. Even state-of-the-art approaches generate motions frequently containing self-intersections, i.e., body parts interpenetrating, which are strong artifacts, severely limiting the perceived motion quality. We introduce a novel loss, which explicitly penalizes self-intersections, to the training of human motion generation methods. We base our loss on a sphere proxy of human geometry, which allows us to calculate a self-intersection loss 98% faster and uses 83% less memory than comparable methods based on triangular meshes. The loss is agnostic to the specific approach, and we add it to the training of the recent human motion generation methods human motion diffusion model (MDM) and MoMask. Our extensive experiments show a reduction of self-intersections in generated motions of up to 49% while improving other evaluation metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/boschresearch/humansphereproxy .

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于球体代理的人体几何自交损失函数，能快速高效地减少生成人体运动中的自交现象，提升运动质量。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的人体运动生成方法虽然评测指标很好，但视觉检查发现生成的运动中频繁出现身体部位自交（相互穿透）的严重伪影，影响感知质量。
AI.method: 提出一种显式惩罚自交的新损失函数，基于人体几何的球体代理（sphere proxy）来计算自交损失，比三角形网格方法快98%、内存少83%。该损失与具体方法无关，可添加至现有方法（如MDM、MoMask）训练中。
AI.result: 生成运动中的自交现象减少高达49%，同时其他评估指标也有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 基于球体代理的自交损失能高效、有效地提升人体运动生成质量，代码已开源。

title: Cast a Wider Net: Coordinated Pass@K Policy Optimization for Code Reasoning
comment: Code reasoning; pass@K optimization; coordinated planning; verifiable rewards; strategy diversity
summary: Repeated sampling with a verifier is the standard way to allocate test-time compute for code generation, with pass@$K$ as the canonical metric. Yet the standard policy class draws $K$ independent samples from a single answer distribution, so attempts often collapse onto near-duplicate reasoning paths and waste the budget on redundant rollouts. This failure is costly in competitive programming, where many problems admit multiple distinct algorithmic strategies and pass@$K$ requires only one correct attempt. We propose Coordinated Pass@$K$ Policy Optimization (CPPO), which turns pass@$K$ generation into joint exploration over strategies: a planner emits a tuple of $K{=}4$ alternative high-level methods, and a shared solver attempts one solution per method. CPPO trains this joint policy with a multiplicative planner reward, $R_{\mathrm{plan}} = J_ψ\cdot R_{\mathrm{out}}$, assigning credit only to valid strategy tuples that lead to verifier-confirmed pass@$K$ success. Across APPS, CodeContests, and LiveCodeBench-v6, CPPO improves pass@$4$ over direct sampling, planning baselines, planner-only SFT, and pass@$K$-oriented RL under the same $K{=}4$ solver-attempt budget, with statistically significant gains on six of nine model--benchmark cells. The largest single gain is $+0.16$ on Qwen3.5-9B LiveCodeBench-v6 over the strongest baseline, PKPO ($0.588 \rightarrow 0.748$; paired bootstrap, $p < 0.05$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出CPPO方法，通过规划器生成K=4种不同策略并由求解器各执行一次，替代传统独立采样方式，在代码生成任务中显著提升pass@K指标，在APPS、CodeContests和LiveCodeBench-v6上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 传统pass@K采样策略从单一答案分布中独立抽样K次，结果常产生近似的推理路径，浪费预算在冗余尝试上，尤其在竞争性编程中问题存在多种算法策略但只需一次正确解答。
AI.method: 提出Coordinated Pass@K Policy Optimization (CPPO)：规划器输出K=4种备选高层方法元组，共享求解器为每种方法各生成一次解答；使用乘法规划奖励R_plan = J_ψ·R_out，仅对经验证器确认有效的策略元组分配奖励，训练联合策略。
AI.result: 在APPS、CodeContests和LiveCodeBench-v6上，CPPO在9个模型-基准测试组合中的6个上取得统计显著提升，最大单次提升为Qwen3.5-9B在LiveCodeBench-v6上+0.16（0.588→0.748，p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: CPPO通过将pass@K生成转化为策略层面的联合探索，有效避免了冗余采样，在相同K=4求解预算下显著优于直接采样、规划基线、规划器仅SFT和面向pass@K的RL方法。

title: Natural Language Query to Configuration for Retrieval Agents
summary: Modern retrieval agents expose many configuration choices -- LLM, retriever, number of documents, number of hops, and synthesis strategy -- each shaping both answer quality and serving cost. Today, these pipelines are typically hand-tuned once per workload, leaving substantial per-query optimization untapped.
