Experiments on AIME 2025, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench v6, and LongBench v2 with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B backbones show that PIPO improves pass@4 over regular decoding by up to $+7.15$ points, while delivering up to $2.64\times$ first-token-latency and $2.07\times$ per-token-latency speedups.

AI.tldr: PIPO通过将输入端的潜在压缩与输出端的多头预测统一，并引入轻量级置信头消除验证器开销，在保持可靠性的同时实现最高2.64倍的首令牌延迟加速和2.07倍的每令牌延迟加速。
AI.motivation: 现有方法分别针对输入侧（潜在压缩）和输出侧（推测解码/多头预测）进行优化，但两者相互独立；且输出侧方法依赖昂贵的验证器来校验不可靠的草稿令牌。
AI.method: 提出Pair-In, Pair-Out (PIPO)框架，将潜在压缩器（折叠两个输入令牌为一个潜在表示）与MTP头（展开一个隐藏状态为一个额外输出令牌）视为镜像操作；训练轻量级置信头决定是否接受草稿令牌，并利用在线策略蒸馏（OPD）自然匹配推测解码的拒绝采样准则。
AI.result: 在AIME 2025、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench v6和LongBench v2上，基于Qwen3.5-4B和9B骨干网络，PIPO的pass@4比常规解码提升最高+7.15个点，首令牌延迟加速最高2.64倍，每令牌延迟加速最高2.07倍。
AI.conclusion: PIPO统一了输入输出两端的优化，无需额外验证器成本即可实现加速，验证了OPD与推测解码拒绝采样准则的自然匹配性。

title: Lost in Sampling: Assessing Lexical Reachability in LLMs via the Word Coverage Score (WCS)
summary: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) are often criticized for producing repetitive and homogeneous text, despite possessing vast latent vocabularies. While previous research has focused on model knowledge and training data, we investigate the role of decoding mechanics in suppressing linguistic diversity. We introduce the Word Coverage Score (WCS), a metric that quantifies the extent to which contextually appropriate human vocabulary is mathematically pruned by standard sampling filters (e.g., Top-$p$, Top-$k$, and Min-$p$). Rather than assessing static knowledge, the WCS measures the lexical survival rate of low-frequency, high-information human words as a function of sampling parameters. By auditing open-weight models on human-authored corpus fragments, we identify which logical lexical choices are rendered unreachable by the decoder, even when they reside within the probability space. Our results provide quantitative evidence that industry-standard sampling defaults act as unintended censorship mechanisms, smoothing the unique textures of human expression into a homogenized discourse. The WCS offers a rigorous framework for optimizing the trade-off between text coherence and lexical richness, providing a diagnostic tool for preserving the diversity of human language in generative models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出词覆盖率得分(WCS)来量化标准采样滤波器（Top-p、Top-k、Min-p）如何抑制低频率、高信息量的人类词汇，揭示解码机制而非模型知识是导致LLM输出同质化的关键原因。
AI.motivation: 现有研究聚焦于模型知识和训练数据，但忽视了解码机制本身对语言多样性的抑制作用；LLM虽拥有庞大潜在词汇量，却产生重复、同质的文本。
AI.method: 提出词覆盖率得分(WCS)指标，测量在标准采样滤波器（Top-p、Top-k、Min-p）作用下，上下文恰当的人类词汇的"存活率"；审计开源模型在人类撰写语料片段上的词汇可及性。
AI.result: 行业标准的采样默认值实际上充当了非故意的审查机制，将人类表达的独特纹理平滑为同质化的话语；许多合理的词汇选择虽在概率空间中存在，却被解码器屏蔽。
AI.conclusion: WCS提供了一个优化文本连贯性与词汇丰富度之间权衡的严格框架，可作为诊断工具，帮助在生成模型中保持人类语言的多样性。

title: YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite: A lightweight architecture for tomato ripeness detection and picking point localization in greenhouse robotic harvesting
summary: In greenhouse tomato production, automated harvesting requires accurate detection of ripe tomatoes, ripeness classification, and precise picking-point localization for robotic end-effectors. This paper proposes YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite, a lightweight deep learning architecture based on YOLO26 for simultaneous detection, ripeness classification, and center-point localization of greenhouse tomatoes. The model introduces three modifications: (1) a Lightweight Feature Pyramid Network (LFPN) with depthwise separable convolutions for efficient multi-scale fusion, (2) a Ripeness-Aware Attention Module (RAAM) with dual pooling and a learnable ripeness bias vector for enhanced color-texture discrimination, and (3) a Compact Detection Head (CDH) with shared convolutions and an integrated center-point regression branch for direct grasp planning. The model is evaluated on a custom dataset of 1,500 images with 6,227 instances (3,566 ripe, 2,661 unripe) from the SILAL greenhouse, Abu Dhabi, UAE. YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite achieves mAP@0.5 of 92.9% (95.2% ripe, 90.6% unripe) with the highest precision (95.2%) among all evaluated architectures using only 2.38M parameters. Post-training BatchNorm pruning at 30% reduces parameters to ~1.8M with negligible accuracy loss. Ablation studies confirm that greenhouse-aware HSV augmentation provides the largest improvement (+2.02 pp mAP@50), backbone freezing achieves peak precision (93.8%), and 3-phase progressive unfreezing yields the best localization quality (mAP@50:95 of 64.6%). Comparisons with YOLOv8n/s, YOLO11n/s, YOLO12n/s, and YOLO26s confirm superior accuracy-efficiency: 2.9 pp higher precision than YOLO12n with 7.0% fewer parameters and integrated center-point localization for robotic end-effector guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite轻量级深度学习模型，用于温室番茄的成熟度检测、分类和采摘点定位，在仅2.38M参数下达到92.9% mAP@0.5，精度优于YOLOv8n/s、YOLO11n/s、YOLO12n/s和YOLO26s等模型。
AI.motivation: 温室番茄自动化采摘需要准确检测成熟番茄、分类成熟度并精确定位采摘点，现有模型在精度与效率的平衡上存在不足，且缺乏面向机器人末端执行器的直接抓取定位能力。
AI.method: 基于YOLO26架构提出三项改进：1) LFPN轻量特征金字塔网络（深度可分离卷积实现高效多尺度融合）；2) RAAM成熟度感知注意力模块（双池化+可学习成熟度偏置向量增强颜色纹理区分）；3) CDH紧凑检测头（共享卷积+集成中心点回归分支直接规划抓取）。
AI.result: 在SILAL温室数据集（1500张图像，6227个实例）上达到92.9% mAP@0.5，最高精度95.2%，仅2.38M参数。30%剪枝后参数降至~1.8M且精度几乎无损。消融实验证实HSV数据增强提升最大（+2.02 pp），三阶段渐进解冻获得最佳定位质量（mAP@50:95达64.6%）。
AI.conclusion: YOLO26-RipeLoc Lite在精度与效率上优于YOLOv8n/s、YOLO11n/s、YOLO12n/s和YOLO26s等对比模型，精度比YOLO12n高2.9个百分点且参数少7.0%，并集成了中心点定位功能，适用于温室番茄自动化采摘机器人引导。

title: It's Not Always Sycophancy: Measuring LLM Conformity as a Function of Epistemic Uncertainty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are known to abandon their initial stance to conform to user pushback. While prior research largely attributes this behavior to sycophancy learned during reinforcement learning from human feedback, we hypothesize that conformity is also driven by a model's epistemic uncertainty at inference time. In this paper, we introduce MUSE, a two-stage evaluation framework to disentangle the mechanisms driving LLM conformity. Specifically, MUSE maps a model's epistemic uncertainty in responding to a query against its likelihood to yield to user pushback in a subsequent turn. We demonstrate that the mechanisms driving conformity extend beyond sycophancy alone. Specifically, we characterize two distinct factors that jointly drive conformity: sycophantic conformity, where a model aligns with user pushback even with absolute certainty in its initial response, and uncertainty-driven conformity, where a model's likelihood for conformity increases alongside its uncertainty. Furthermore, we conduct ablation studies to demonstrate that both sycophantic conformity and uncertainty-driven conformity grow with 1) the LLM's perceived expertise of the user and 2) the plausibility of the user's suggestions. More broadly, MUSE informs more targeted intervention strategies by distinguishing alignment-induced sycophancy and training-corpora-driven uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MUSE框架，通过两阶段评估揭示了LLM的顺从行为不仅源于强化学习中的谄媚（sycophancy），还受到模型推理时 epistemic uncertainty（认知不确定性）的驱动。研究发现顺从行为由两种因素共同导致：谄媚性顺从和不确定性驱动顺从，且两者都会随用户感知专业程度和建议合理性的增加而增强。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将LLM在用户质疑下改变立场的行为主要归因于RLHF训练中产生的谄媚现象，但作者推测这种顺从行为还受到模型推理时认知不确定性的影响，因此需要区分这两种机制以制定更有针对性的干预策略。
AI.method: 提出MUSE（两阶段评估框架），通过测量模型对查询的认知不确定性与其后续对用户质疑的顺从倾向之间的关联，将顺从行为分解为谄媚性顺从（即使模型对初始回答绝对确定也顺从用户）和不确定性驱动顺从（模型顺从倾向随不确定性增加而提高）两类，并进行消融实验分析影响因素。
AI.result: 证实了顺从行为不仅来源于谄媚，还存在不确定性驱动顺从；两种顺从机制均随用户感知专业程度和建议合理性的增加而增强。
AI.conclusion: MUSE框架能够区分强化学习导致的谄媚与训练语料驱动的不确定性两种顺从来源，从而为制定更精准的干预策略提供指导。

title: Separating Semantic Competition from Context Length in RAG Reading
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can respond incorrectly even when the correct passage was retrieved. The model must still read the retrieved passages and identify which one contains the answer among others that look relevant. This passage-reading model is called the reader. Does it fail simply because the context is longer or because the other passages genuinely compete with the correct one? We introduce and demonstrate a matched-control protocol for RAG reading: we keep the number and length of passages fixed, but replace hard competitors with less competitive real passages. We apply this control across two compact open models on SQuAD. This replacement partially restores performance, with the strongest effects on F1 and answer inclusion. For Phi-2, this recovers +6.0 EM points, +7.0 answer-inclusion points, and +0.057 F1. For Qwen2.5-1.5B, it recovers +4.5 EM points, +9.0 answer-inclusion points, and +0.068 F1. To track how performance changes as competitors accumulate, we also report retention curves and summarize them with a right-censored half-life when the curves do not cross half-retention. Together, these results show the protocol isolates a competition effect distinct from context length, though the effect is clearer for F1 and answer inclusion than for exact match, and also varies with snippet length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种匹配对照实验方法，用于隔离RAG系统中阅读器因竞争性段落而导致的性能下降，而非单纯因上下文长度增加所致。实验表明，将竞争性段落替换为非竞争性段落可显著恢复模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统即使检索到正确段落，阅读器仍可能回答错误。研究者希望区分这种错误是由于上下文变长导致，还是因为其他竞争性段落干扰了正确答案的识别。
AI.method: 设计匹配对照协议：固定段落数量和长度不变，仅将竞争性强的段落替换为竞争性弱的真实段落。在SQuAD数据集上对Phi-2和Qwen2.5-1.5B两个紧凑开源模型进行实验，并采用保留曲线和右删失半衰期分析性能变化。
AI.result: Phi-2：EM恢复+6.0点，答案包含恢复+7.0点，F1恢复+0.057。Qwen2.5-1.5B：EM恢复+4.5点，答案包含恢复+9.0点，F1恢复+0.068。竞争效应在F1和答案包含指标上比精确匹配更明显，且受片段长度影响。
AI.conclusion: 该协议成功分离出竞争效应，证明竞争性段落的存在是导致RAG阅读器性能下降的独立因素，不同于上下文长度的影响。

title: Leveraging Visual Signals for Robust Token-Level Uncertainty in Vision-Language Generation
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) remains a critical challenge in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) for reliable predictions and real-world deployment. However, most existing methods are adapted from the LLM literature and primarily focus on the language modality, leaving the contribution of visual information to LVLM uncertainty largely underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how LVLMs process visual information and whether this process can be used to improve uncertainty estimation. By analyzing hidden representations after the integration of visual features during the generation process, we observe that high-confidence predictions rely more heavily on visual content than uncertain ones. Building on this insight, we propose Visual-Grounded Token UQ (VIG-TUQ), a training-free framework that explicitly incorporates visual grounding into uncertainty estimation by weighting token-level language uncertainty with visual grounding scores. We evaluate VIG-TUQ on multiple datasets and across diverse LVLM architectures, including early-fusion, late-fusion, and native-fusion models. Results indicate that our method often improves upon existing token-level uncertainty approaches. Code and data will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIG-TUQ框架，通过将视觉接地信息融入令牌级语言不确定性估计，显著提升了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的不确定性量化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM的不确定性量化方法多从LLM领域迁移而来，主要关注语言模态，忽视了视觉信息对模型不确定性的贡献，这一盲区亟需填补。
AI.method: 通过分析视觉特征整合后的隐藏表示，发现高置信度预测更依赖视觉内容；据此提出VIG-TUQ，一种无需训练的框架，用视觉接地分数加权令牌级语言不确定性。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和LVLM架构（早期融合、晚期融合、原生融合）上验证，VIG-TUQ在不确定性估计上优于现有令牌级方法。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息对LVLM不确定性有显著影响，显式融入视觉接地能有效提升不确定性量化质量，代码和数据将开源。

title: Probing Cultural Awareness in LLMs: A Case Study of Cross-Culture Aesthetic Stylistics
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in diverse cultural contexts, yet their ability to master aesthetic stylistics, i.e., the strategic use of language to evoke cultural resonance, remains underexplored. We curate C4STYLI, a benchmark of highly stylized translated movie titles and advertising slogans from Hong Kong and the Chinese Mainland, to evaluate LLMs via the lens of behavioral recognition and productive competence. Extensive evaluations show that LLMs differ from humans in stylistic recognition, and this recognition ability varies across text domains. In addition, stylistic recognition and generation performance in LLMs are not consistently aligned. To further examine whether LLMs genuinely capture stylistic information in stylistic recognition, we conduct structural ablation with logistic regression probes. We find that, in the Hong Kong setting, stylistic recognition in LLMs relies primarily on surface-level linguistic information rather than stylistic structure. This suggests limited sensitivity to Hong Kong-specific stylistic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了C4STYLI基准（包含香港和内地的高度风格化翻译电影片名和广告标语），评估了大语言模型在文化风格识别与生成方面的能力。研究发现，LLM在风格识别上与人类存在差异，且识别能力跨文本领域不一致；风格识别与生成之间缺乏一致性；在香港语境中，LLM的风格识别主要依赖表层语言信息而非风格结构，对香港特有的风格结构敏感度有限。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM被部署在多元文化环境中，但它们掌握"审美风格学"（即通过语言策略唤起文化共鸣的能力）尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 构建C4STYLI基准（高度风格化的翻译电影片名和广告标语，来自香港和中国内地）；2) 通过行为识别和生成能力两个视角评估LLM；3) 使用逻辑回归探针进行结构消融实验。
AI.result: 1) LLM在风格识别上与人类不同，且识别能力因文本领域而异；2) 风格识别与生成表现不一致；3) 在香港语境下，LLM的风格识别主要依赖表层语言信息，而非风格结构。
AI.conclusion: LLM对香港特有的风格结构敏感度有限，在文化风格理解上存在深层不足。

title: Is an Image Also Worth 16x16=256 Superpixels? A Framework for Attentional Image Classification
summary: Superpixel-based image classification has traditionally leveraged graph neural networks (GNNs) for processing irregular image representations. Recent advances in computer vision, driven by Vision Transformers (ViTs), have introduced new paradigms in self-attentional models, surpassing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in various tasks. However, a synergistic connection between GNNs, superpixels, and transformers remains unexplored. In this work, we propose Superpixel Transformers (SPT), a novel framework that unifies superpixel-based image classification and ViTs. SPT generalizes the Superpixel Image Classification with Graph Attention Networks (SICGAT) model and ViT to support arbitrary superpixel-based chunking strategies, connectivity graphs, and positional encodings. We introduce refinements including a multidimensional sine-cosine positional encoding and an enriched patch data structure that fully incorporates superpixel shape and color information. By testing SPT across datasets such as CIFAR10, FashionMNIST, and Imagenette, with various superpixel generation and graph connectivity strategies, we demonstrate that SPT achieves superior performance compared to previous superpixel-based GNN methods and remains competitive with ViTs. Notably, our approach addresses the limitations of SICGAT, such as information loss during pixel aggregation, and shows how constrained graph connectivity can enhance ViT performance. SPT bridges the gap between superpixel-based and transformer models, opening avenues for cross-domain generalization and future innovations in hybrid attentional frameworks, and showing that an image can also be worth $16\times16$ superpixels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Superpixel Transformers (SPT)，统一超像素图像分类与Vision Transformers，通过多维正余弦位置编码和丰富的块数据结构，在多个数据集上超越传统超像素GNN方法，与ViT性能相当。
AI.motivation: 现有超像素图像分类依赖GNN，而ViT在视觉任务中表现优异，但两者之间缺乏有效的结合方式。同时，SICGAT等方法存在像素聚合过程中的信息丢失问题。
AI.method: 提出SPT框架，支持任意超像素分块策略、连接图和位置编码；引入多维正弦-余弦位置编码和包含超像素形状与颜色信息的增强块数据结构。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10、FashionMNIST和Imagenette数据集上，SPT优于此前超像素GNN方法，与ViT性能相当，且通过约束图连接可提升ViT性能。
AI.conclusion: SPT弥合了超像素模型与Transformer模型之间的差距，为跨领域泛化和混合注意力框架的未来创新开辟了新途径。

title: Self-Ensembling Vision-Language Models for Chart Data Extraction
summary: Charts effectively convey quantitative information, but the underlying data are often locked in image form, hindering reuse and analysis. Manually digitizing charts is time-consuming and error-prone, motivating automatic chart-to-table extraction. Recent approaches use specialized vision-language models (VLMs), yet performance still lags on charts with many datapoints or substantial stylistic variation. We propose a VLM self-ensembling method that repeatedly samples multiple tabular outputs from the same VLM for a fixed chart image and aggregates them at the level of individual table cells. We align candidate tables and take per-cell medians over numerical values to produce a more accurate consensus table. Our method also includes convergence detection to stop sampling once the aggregated table stabilizes, and uncertainty estimation based on dispersion across samples to help users assess extraction reliability. Because existing chart extraction benchmarks contain relatively simple plots with limited room for improvement, we introduce WB-ChartExtract, a new benchmark built from World Bank data with more complex and stylistically diverse charts; on average, its charts contain 7 times more datapoints than those in the ChartQA benchmark. Across both ChartQA and WB-ChartExtract, our approach improves extraction accuracy over single-pass VLM outputs, yielding up to 23% relative improvement on WB-ChartExtract after ensembling. More broadly, our method helps unlock tabular data previously siloed in chart images, enabling downstream analysis and reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种视觉语言模型自集成方法，通过多次采样和聚合表格单元来提升图表到表格的提取精度，并构建了包含更复杂图表的新基准WB-ChartExtract。
AI.motivation: 图表中的数据常被锁定在图像形式中，手动数字化耗时且易错，现有VLM方法在处理数据点多或风格差异大的图表时性能不佳。
AI.method: 对同一图表图像多次采样VLM输出的表格结果，对齐候选表格后取每个单元格数值的中位数作为共识表，并引入收敛检测和不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在ChartQA和WB-ChartExtract基准上，该方法优于单次VLM输出，在WB-ChartExtract上相对提升高达23%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解锁了图表图像中的表格数据，支持下游分析和复用。

title: Chartographer: Counterfactual Chart Generation for Evaluating Vision-Language Models
summary: Chart question-answering (QA) benchmarks aim to pose questions that require visual reasoning to correctly answer, but models can often reach solutions through shortcuts or prior familiarity with a chart based on their own background knowledge. To strictly evaluate visual reasoning, we propose counterfactual charts where the chart-question task remains fixed, but underlying chart and the corresponding answer are varied. We introduce Chartographer, a framework to reverse engineer charts into executable code, validate reconstruction fidelity, generate seed-controlled counterfactual variants, and derive new answers from executable QA logic. We apply this framework to existing chart QA datasets and evaluate proprietary and open-source vision-language models (VLMs), measuring variation sensitivity and generalizability. Counterfactual charts reveal failures hidden by single-chart performance: VLMs often fail to generalize after answering the original chart correctly. We find failures are most prevalent when updated charts require novel visual reasoning pathways.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实图表框架Chartographer，通过改变图表底层数据但保持问题不变，系统性地暴露VLM在视觉推理中的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有图表问答基准中，模型常利用背景知识或捷径作答，而非真正进行视觉推理，需要更严格的评估方法。
AI.method: 开发Chartographer框架：逆向工程将图表转为可执行代码、验证重构保真度、生成种子控制的反事实变体、从可执行QA逻辑推导新答案。
AI.result: 反事实图表揭示了单图表性能隐藏的失败：VLM在正确回答原始图表后，常无法泛化到变体；当更新图表需要新的视觉推理路径时失败最为普遍。
AI.conclusion: 反事实评估是一种有效的VLM视觉推理能力测试方法，暴露了模型在需要新推理路径时的泛化缺陷。

title: Touch-R1: Reinforcing Touch Reasoning in MLLMs
comment: Our code and data will be made public on the https://laiyingxin2.github.io/Projects
summary: While rule-based reinforcement learning has recently catalyzed explicit reasoning in multimodal models, tactile reasoning remains largely underexplored. Existing tactile-language models primarily rely on supervised or contrastive objectives, which limits their capacity to ground predictions in physical evidence or rectify misleading visual priors. Tactile reasoning introduces two modality-specific challenges: the ordinal nature of physical attributes (e.g., hardness, roughness) and the cross-sensor distribution shifts inherent in optical tactile hardware. In this work, we introduce TouchReason-1M, a large-scale multimodal dataset comprising over 1M synchronized tactile pairs across four distinct sensors, and TouchReason-Bench, a rigorous framework for evaluating tactile perception and visual-tactile conflict resolution. Building upon these, we propose Touch-R1, a tactile reasoning MLLM based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Touch-R1 is trained via a tactile-grounded GRPO objective that combines ordinal-aware accuracy, cross-sensor physical consistency, structured-format control, and an input-side tactile grounding objective. Specifically, the tactile-use reward assigns credit only when authentic tactile inputs yield superior correctness relative to counterfactual controls where the tactile stream is removed, shuffled, or noise-masked. On TouchReason-Bench, Touch-R1-7B outperforms Octopi-13B by 18.4\% and GPT-4o by 24.7\% on average. Its structured reasoning traces reveal emergent behaviors of probing, comparison, and revision, demonstrating that R1-style reasoning can be effectively grounded in physical contact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TouchReason-1M多模态触觉数据集、TouchReason-Bench评估框架及Touch-R1触觉推理模型，通过基于触觉的GRPO训练策略，使7B参数模型在触觉推理基准上超越GPT-4o和Octopi-13B，展现出类似R1的物理推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的触觉-语言模型主要依赖监督或对比学习目标，缺乏基于物理证据的推理能力，也无法纠正误导性的视觉先验。触觉推理面临两个独特挑战：物理属性（如硬度、粗糙度）的序数性质，以及光学触觉传感器间的分布偏移。
AI.method: 构建TouchReason-1M（含4种传感器的100万+触觉对）和TouchReason-Bench评估框架；提出Touch-R1模型（基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B），采用触觉引导的GRPO训练目标，结合序数感知准确性、跨传感器物理一致性、结构化格式控制及输入侧触觉接地目标。触觉使用奖励仅在真实触觉输入相比反事实控制（移除、打乱、噪声掩码触觉流）产生更优正确性时赋予奖励。
AI.result: Touch-R1-7B在TouchReason-Bench上平均超越Octopi-13B 18.4%、GPT-4o 24.7%。推理痕迹展现出探测、比较和修正等涌现行为。
AI.conclusion: 基于R1风格的推理可以有效接地在物理接触上，触觉引导的强化学习能够催生多模态模型在触觉领域的显式推理能力。

title: Real Images, Worse Judgments: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Concreteness and Imagery
summary: Visual inputs are often assumed to improve language understanding in multimodal models. We examine this assumption by asking whether vision-language models (VLMs) can distinguish useful visual evidence from incidental image context in lexical judgments. We use human concreteness and imagery ratings because they span words with varying expected visual relevance, from abstract and low-imagery words to concrete and high-imagery words. We find that real-image contexts do not yield consistent gains and often hurt alignment with human ratings, most sharply when visual evidence is least relevant. Through probing and canonical correlation analysis, complemented by an attribution case study, we find that real-image contexts are associated with representational shifts and greater sensitivity to spurious visual cues, coinciding with weaker recoverability of the targeted lexical properties. We further show that instructing models to focus solely on textual content at inference time can reduce this degradation, with the clearest gains on these vulnerable subsets. Our findings suggest that current instruction-tuned VLMs need better calibration of when visual context should inform lexical judgments.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，真实图像上下文在多模态模型的词义判断中不仅无益，反而会降低与人类评分的一致性，尤其对抽象词汇影响最大。通过引导模型仅关注文本可缓解这一退化。
AI.motivation: 检验视觉输入是否真的能提升多模态模型的语言理解能力，质疑"视觉信息总是有益"这一常见假设。
AI.method: 使用人类具体性和意象评分作为基准，对比有无真实图像上下文时VLM的表现；通过探测分析、典型相关分析和归因案例研究来探究表征变化；测试推理时指令干预的效果。
AI.result: 真实图像上下文在词义判断中未带来一致提升，反而在视觉证据最不相关时（抽象/低意象词）损害最大；真实图像导致表征偏移和对虚假视觉线索的敏感度增加，削弱了对词汇属性的可恢复性；指令引导仅关注文本可减少性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 当前指令微调的VLM需要更好地校准视觉上下文何时应该参与词义判断。

title: Model discovery for dynamical systems with complex-valued product units
summary: Discovering the governing equations of a dynamical system from observed trajectories provides deeper insight into its structure than mere prediction of future states. We present a data-driven approach to model discovery based on complex-valued product-unit networks, in which each unit represents a complex monomial and the network output is a sparse linear combination of such monomials. In contrast to established library-based methods such as SINDy, our approach does not require a predefined set of candidate functions: the relevant monomials, including those with fractional or negative exponents, are learned directly from data. Across four chaotic benchmark systems (Lorenz63, Lorenz84, the Four-Wing attractor, and a fractional variant of Lorenz63), we recover the exact governing equations in 90% of trials for the first three systems, and in 70-90% of trials for the fractional case, using at least 3000 training points. Applied to real-world human-gait accelerometer signals, the model produced stable trajectories with bounded prediction errors, corresponding to an RMSE of approximately 12-14% of the signal amplitude range over a test horizon three times longer than the training interval, demonstrating its potential for high-dimensional systems in which analytic equations are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于复数乘积单元网络的数据驱动方法，可直接从数据中学习包含分数阶和负指数项的单形式，用于发现动力系统的控制方程，在混沌基准系统和真实步态数据上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 从观测轨迹中发现动力系统的控制方程，比单纯预测未来状态更能揭示系统结构，但现有方法（如SINDy）需要预定义候选函数集，限制了其适用性。
AI.method: 采用复数乘积单元网络，每个单元表示一个复数单形式，网络输出为这些单形式的稀疏线性组合。无需预定义候选函数，通过数据直接学习相关单形式（包括分数阶和负指数项）。
AI.result: 在Lorenz63、Lorenz84、Four-Wing吸引子和分数阶Lorenz63四个混沌基准系统中，前三者90%试验恢复精确方程，分数阶情况70-90%。在真实步态加速度信号上，RMSE约为信号幅值范围的12-14%，预测时域为训练区间的三倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需预定义候选函数集，能自动发现包含分数阶和负指数的控制方程，在混沌系统和真实高维数据上均有效，具有应用于解析方程未知的高维系统的潜力。

title: Generative Animations: A Multi-Model Pipeline for Prompt-Driven Motion Synthesis
summary: Animation elevates digital documents into immersive experiences, yet creating custom motion paths remains cumbersome, requiring designers to manually select presets, plot Bézier points, and configure timing properties. We introduce Generative Animations, a system that transforms natural language prompts into production-ready animations. By chaining Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic parsing with the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for visual grounding, our pipeline automatically generates motion paths that respect scene geometry, handle depth-based occlusions, and honor 3D perspective transforms. We demonstrate the system through three use cases: contour-following trajectories, orbital animations with z-order awareness, and perspective-aligned motion on transformed objects.

AI.tldr: 提出Generative Animations系统，通过LLM语义解析+SAM视觉定位，将自然语言指令自动转化为符合场景几何、深度遮挡和3D透视的生产级动画路径。
AI.motivation: 当前创建自定义动画路径过程繁琐，设计师需手动选择预设、绘制贝塞尔点并配置时序属性，缺乏自然语言驱动的自动化方案。
AI.method: 采用大语言模型进行语义解析，链式调用Segment Anything Model进行视觉定位，自动生成运动路径，支持场景几何约束、深度遮挡处理和3D透视变换。
AI.result: 实现三种用例：轮廓跟随轨迹、带z-order感知的轨道动画、变换对象上的透视对齐运动。
AI.conclusion: 该系统将自然语言提示转化为可直接投入生产的动画，显著降低了动画制作门槛。

title: MATCHA: Matching Text via Contrastive Semantic Alignment
summary: Reliable evaluation is essential for understanding large language model (LLM) performance, yet today's go-to metrics, namely token-overlap scores (e.g., ROUGE) and embedding-based measures (e.g., BERTScore), often misjudge semantic similarity of documents. Our study shows that both token-overlap metrics and embedding-based metrics routinely assign nearly identical scores to texts that directly contradict each other, thereby potentially masking fundamental errors. We introduce MATCHA, an automatic metric that jointly rewards semantic agreement with a reference and penalizes contradictions. MATCHA employs a dual-view perspective that measures (i) proximity to the gold text and (ii) distance from an adversarially generated counterfactual contradiction. In eight public benchmarks, MATCHA outperforms popular metrics, compared with human annotations on question-answering, image caption generation, natural language inference, summarization, and semantic textual similarity tasks. On the TruthfulQA dataset (i.e., a dataset without a training set, where no embedding-based metrics could locally train on), this improvement in terms of matching texts with a reference reaches 18.38% over ROUGE-L and 20.82% over BERTScore. Both quantitative comparison and qualitative human assessments confirm the efficacy and validity of MATCHA and uncover fundamental weaknesses in pre-existing metrics. Compared with 23 embedding models, including top state-of-the-art ones, used as a metric similar to BERTScore, MATCHA remains the most accurate in distinguishing correct from incorrect statements solely based on a reference. Our code and metric are publicly available (https://github.com/Siran-Li/MATCHA).

AI.tldr: 本文提出MATCHA，一种同时奖励语义一致性和惩罚矛盾的双视角自动评估指标，在八个公开基准测试中优于ROUGE和BERTScore等主流指标，在TruthfulQA上相比ROUGE-L提升18.38%、相比BERTScore提升20.82%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标（如ROUGE、BERTScore）常常将相互矛盾的文本评为几乎相同的分数，掩盖了LLM的严重错误，因此需要一种更可靠的自动评估方法。
AI.method: MATCHA采用双视角机制：一方面衡量与黄金参考文本的语义接近度，另一方面衡量与对抗性生成的反事实矛盾文本的距离，从而同时奖励语义一致性并惩罚矛盾。
AI.result: 在QA、图像描述、NLI、摘要、语义文本相似性等八个公开基准上优于流行指标；在TruthfulQA上比ROUGE-L高18.38%、比BERTScore高20.82%；在23个嵌入模型中保持最高准确性。
AI.conclusion: MATCHA在区分正确与错误陈述方面显著优于现有指标和嵌入模型，揭示了既有评估指标的固有缺陷，是一种更可靠的LLM自动评估方案。

title: MRT: Masked Region Transformer for Layered Image Generation and Editing at Scale
summary: Layered image generation and editing is a fundamental capability that enables layer-wise reuse, editing, and composition of generated visual content, analogous to word-level editing in natural language. Despite its importance, this remains an underexplored area at scale. To address this gap, we present MRT, a 20B-parameter masked region diffusion model tailored for multi-layer transparent image generation and editing, trained on over 10M multilingual design samples spanning diverse aspect ratios and textual prompts. To fully leverage this scale, we make two key technical contributions. First, we unify three complementary tasks including text-to-layers, image-to-layers, and layers-to-layers within a shared masked region diffusion framework, where selective token masking enables flexible layer-wise generation and editing. Second, to enable overflow layer generation, we introduce an overflow-aware canvas layer that handles boundary inconsistencies and supports semi-transparent background synthesis, enabling complete editable layers extending beyond visible canvas boundaries. Additionally, we apply diffusion distillation to achieve 8-step, real-time multi-layer generation with minimal quality degradation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art approaches, including various commercial systems, across all three tasks, establishing a new benchmark for multi-layer transparent image generation. Notably, our model significantly outperforms the concurrent Qwen-Image-Layered model in image-to-layers quality according to user-study results, while achieving 10-100\times faster inference and reducing activation GPU memory consumption by 50-90\% during image-to-layer inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MRT，一个200亿参数的掩码区域扩散模型，用于多层透明图像的生成和编辑。该模型统一了文本到图层、图像到图层和图层到图层三个任务，并引入了溢出感知画布层来处理边界不一致问题，在多项任务上显著超越现有方法（包括商业系统和Qwen-Image-Layered模型），同时推理速度提升10-100倍，显存消耗降低50-90%。
AI.motivation: 多层图像生成和编辑是视觉内容创作中的基础能力，类似于自然语言中的词汇级编辑，但目前在大规模场景下仍然探索不足，缺乏有效的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 统一文本到图层、图像到图层、图层到图层三个任务到共享的掩码区域扩散框架中，通过选择性token掩码实现灵活的逐层生成和编辑。2) 引入溢出感知画布层，处理边界不一致性并支持半透明背景合成，使图层可扩展到可见画布边界之外。3) 应用扩散蒸馏技术实现8步实时多图层生成。
AI.result: 在三个任务上大幅优于现有最先进方法和商业系统，在图像到图层任务上显著超越Qwen-Image-Layered模型，推理速度提升10-100倍，激活GPU显存消耗降低50-90%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多图层透明图像生成建立了新的基准，证明了大规模统一框架在图层级生成和编辑任务中的有效性。

title: Can Retrieval Heads See Images? Multimodal Retrieval Heads in Long-Context Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models increasingly rely on long-context modeling to reason over documents, hour-level videos, and long-horizon agent trajectories, requiring them to locate relevant evidence across interleaved text and images. Prior work has studied this behavior using retrieval heads in large language models, but its copy-based criterion does not directly apply when evidence appears in images. We introduce a multimodal retrieval head detection method that scores attention from question tokens to textual or visual evidence. With this method, we show that multimodal retrieval heads are sparse, intrinsic, and causally important: only 4.4-10.2% of attention heads account for 50% of the positive retrieval-score mass, and masking the top-5% selected heads drops MMLongBench-Doc from 48.2% to 5.7% and SlideVQA from 71.2% to 8.9%, while random-head masking is far less damaging. Further analysis shows that these heads are partly shared across modalities yet remain dynamic within each modality, with image retrieval heads changing more than text retrieval heads as context length and haystack modality change. Without further training, we find that these heads can also be used directly to rank visually rich documents: on MMDocIR, Qwen3-VL-8B selected-head scoring improves Recall@1 by 7.7/7.4 macro/micro points for page retrieval and 6.3/6.8 points for layout retrieval over the strongest reported baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态检索头检测方法，发现大视觉语言模型中仅有4.4-10.2%的注意力头是关键检索头，这些头对长上下文多模态推理至关重要，且可直接用于视觉文档检索任务。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在纯文本大语言模型中发现了检索头（retrieval heads），但其基于文本复制的判断标准不适用于图像中的证据定位。因此，需要一种适用于多模态场景的检索头检测方法。
AI.method: 提出多模态检索头检测方法，通过计算问题token到文本/视觉证据的注意力分数来识别检索头。分别评估了检索头的稀疏性、因果重要性、跨模态共享性以及动态变化特性。
AI.result: 仅4.4-10.2%的注意力头贡献了50%的正向检索分数；屏蔽前5%的检索头导致MMLongBench-Doc从48.2%降至5.7%，SlideVQA从71.2%降至8.9%；检索头在模态间部分共享，但图像检索头比文本检索头更随上下文变化；无需训练即可用于文档检索，Qwen3-VL-8B在MMDocIR上Recall@1提升了7.7/7.4（宏/微平均）页面检索和6.3/6.8布局检索。
AI.conclusion: 多模态检索头稀疏、内在且因果重要，可跨模态共享但动态变化，并可直接迁移至视觉文档检索任务中提升性能。

title: Gemini Embedding 2: A Native Multimodal Embedding Model from Gemini
summary: We introduce Gemini Embedding 2, a native multimodal embedding model that allows embedding video, audio, image, and text modalities in a unified representation space. We leverage the multimodal capabilities of Gemini to produce embeddings for arbitrary combinations of interleaved inputs across all these modalities that generalize well across a wide variety of tasks. Applying large-scale contrastive learning in a multi-task multi-stage training setup, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on key embedding benchmarks including unimodal, cross-modal, and multimodal retrieval spanning a diverse set of tasks. We show that our embedding model demonstrates strong performance (with a score of 62.9 R@1 on MSCOCO, 68.8 NDCG@10 on Vatex, 69.9 on MTEB multilingual and 84.0 on MTEB Code) across a variety of tasks surpassing the performance of specialized models. These unified capabilities make Gemini Embedding 2 a promising candidate for downstream use cases such as RAG, recommendation and search. Furthermore, its robust zero-shot performance across distinct fields - from astronomy and bioscience to fine arts and the culinary arts - establishes it as a highly reliable, out-of-the-box representation even for specialized domains.

AI.tldr: Gemini Embedding 2 是一个原生多模态嵌入模型，支持视频、音频、图像和文本的统一表示，在多项检索基准上达到最先进性能，成为RAG、推荐和搜索等下游任务的理想选择。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型通常只支持单一或部分模态，缺乏能够统一处理视频、音频、图像和文本等多种模态的通用表示模型，限制了多模态检索和跨模态任务的性能。
AI.method: 利用Gemini的多模态能力，采用大规模对比学习，通过多任务多阶段训练流程，将视频、音频、图像和文本嵌入到统一的表示空间中。
AI.result: 在MSCOCO上达到62.9 R@1，Vatex上68.8 NDCG@10，MTEB多语言上69.9，MTEB代码上84.0，超越了专门化模型，并在天文、生物科学、美术和烹饪等专业领域展现出强大的零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: Gemini Embedding 2作为一种统一多模态嵌入模型，在多项任务上超越专门化模型，为RAG、推荐和搜索等下游应用提供了可靠的开箱即用表示能力。

title: PlayClass: Automated Play Behaviour Classification in Poultry
summary: Automated monitoring of animal welfare has largely targeted negative indicators, leaving positive welfare behaviours such as play underexplored. To address this gap, we present PlayClass, a pipeline for play-behaviour classification in poultry from top-down pen video. The pipeline leverages long-duration tracking with SAM 3 via YOLO-guided chunk boundaries to minimise identity errors in point-based prompting, and frozen embeddings from image and video foundation models for play action classification. Although handcrafted motion features from tracked masks alone achieved competitive accuracy, V-JEPA 2.1 consistently outperformed all other backbones across model scales, reaching 77.0 macro-averaged F$_1$ when combined with handcrafted features. Despite this result, the dataset remains challenging due to play sub-types sharing similar kinematic profiles with non-play and inter-bird occlusion. Overall, our work provides encouraging evidence towards automated frameworks for play behaviour classification in poultry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PlayClass流水线，利用SAM 3、YOLO和基础模型实现家禽玩耍行为自动分类，V-JEPA 2.1结合手工特征取得77.0% Macro F1，但仍面临子类混淆和遮挡挑战。
AI.motivation: 动物福利监测多聚焦负面指标，积极福利行为（如玩耍）未被充分探索，因此本文针对这一空白开展研究。
AI.method: 采用SAM 3结合YOLO引导的块边界进行长时跟踪，减少点提示的身份错误；使用图像和视频基础模型的冻结嵌入进行玩耍动作分类，并融合手工运动特征。
AI.result: V-JEPA 2.1在所有模型尺度上表现最佳，与手工特征结合后达到77.0% Macro F1；但数据集中玩耍子类与非玩耍行为运动特征相似，且存在遮挡问题。
AI.conclusion: 工作为家禽玩耍行为自动分类提供了有希望的证据，但数据集仍具有挑战性。

title: How and What to Imagine? Visual Thinking in Unified Multimodal Models for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning remains a weak spot for vision-language models (VLMs): they often reason in language and lose the fine-grained geometry needed for the task. Thinking with images aims to address this by generating an intermediate thinking image, but recent work shows that models often ignore the visual evidence in these traces. We therefore ask how to make visual thinking matter, and what kind of visual thinking works best. We study these questions in unified multimodal models (UMMs), which natively support interleaved image-text generation. For the first question, we propose View Dropout (VDrop), a training-time intervention that hides parts of one input view from the answer span while keeping them visible to the thinking-image tokens. This encourages the model to use the thinking image when answering, instead of relying only on the input views. Once the thinking image is used for answer prediction, we study which type of visual thinking is most effective. We frame this as a learnability-informativeness tradeoff and compare three thinking-image variants: top-down, panoramic, and point-matching renderings. Trained on synthetic scenes and evaluated on five real-world out-of-domain benchmarks, panoramic visual thinking with VDrop is the only configuration that is both informative and learnable, and it achieves the best out-of-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出View Dropout（VDrop）训练策略和全景视觉思维方法，解决视觉语言模型在跨视角空间推理中忽视中间视觉思维图的问题，在跨域泛化上取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在跨视角空间推理中表现薄弱，现有"用图像思考"的方法中模型常忽略中间视觉思维图中的视觉证据。
AI.method: 提出View Dropout（VDrop）训练策略，遮挡输入视图的部分区域但保留给思维图token，迫使模型依赖思维图作答；比较三种视觉思维变体（俯视图、全景图、点匹配图），发现全景图在信息性和可学习性之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.result: 在合成场景训练、五个真实世界跨域基准上，结合VDrop的全景视觉思维是唯一兼具信息性和可学习性的配置，取得了最佳跨域泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 全景视觉思维配合VDrop能有效提升UMM的跨视角空间推理能力，为视觉思维在VLM中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: Q-GeoMem: Question-Guided Geometric Memory for Video Spatial Reasoning
summary: Video spatial reasoning requires accumulating viewpoint-dependent evidence over time while retaining information useful to the question being asked. Existing spatial video-language models improve geometric perception and long-range context modeling, but often treat memory as a generic temporal cache, which can introduce redundant or irrelevant geometry and weaken long-horizon reasoning. We propose \textbf{\ours}, a question-guided geometric memory framework for video spatial reasoning. \ours injects camera-conditioned geometry into visual tokens and maintains two complementary memories: a Fine-Grained Context Bank for recent dense features and camera states, and a Semantic-Geometric Evidence Bank for compact long-range evidence. Each candidate frame is scored by the product of Q-Former-based question relevance and novelty with respect to the retained bank; this score is stored and reused during reading, while a capacity-based replacement rule keeps the bank compact. During reasoning, both memories are read before update and adaptively fused with the current frame representation. Experiments on VSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench show that \ours achieves state-of-the-art performance among evaluated spatial reasoning models, validating the effectiveness of question-guided geometric memory. Ablations further verify the contribution of the proposed evidence scoring mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向视频空间推理的问题引导几何记忆框架，通过注入相机条件几何信息并维护两种互补记忆（细粒度上下文库和语义-几何证据库），实现了最优的空间推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空间视频语言模型虽然提升了几何感知和长程上下文建模能力，但其记忆机制往往只是通用的时间缓存，会引入冗余或不相关的几何信息，削弱了长程推理能力。
AI.method: 将相机条件几何信息注入视觉token，维护两种互补记忆：细粒度上下文库（近期密集特征与相机状态）和语义-几何证据库（紧凑长程证据）。通过Q-Former计算候选帧的问题相关性与新颖性得分，采用容量约束的替换策略保持记忆紧凑，推理时先读取再更新并自适应融合。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench和VSTI-Bench基准上，该方法在所有被评估的空间推理模型中取得了最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 问题引导的几何记忆机制有效提升了视频空间推理性能，消融实验进一步验证了所提证据评分机制的有效性。

title: PARE: Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) generate high-quality videos but demand substantial compute due to wide blocks, deep architectures, and iterative sampling. Recent methods reduce cost by compressing width, depth, or sampling steps, but typically commit to a fixed architecture that cannot adapt to individual inputs or denoising stages. We propose PARE (Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient video generation), which jointly compresses width and depth with structure-aware pruning and input-adaptive routing. For width, we observe that attention heads specialize into spatial and temporal roles, and design importance scoring that accounts for this distinction to prevent motion-critical temporal heads from being pruned prematurely. For depth, we train a lightweight router conditioned on denoising timestep and visual content to dynamically select which blocks to execute at each step, enabling per-input compute adaptation rather than static block removal. A progressive pipeline first recovers width-pruned quality via distillation, then jointly optimizes the student and router to decouple the two learning objectives. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B for both image-to-video and text-to-video generation show that PARE substantially reduces per-step computation while preserving quality across VBench dimensions, and composes with step distillation for further acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出PARE方法，通过结构感知的宽度剪枝和输入自适应的深度路由，联合压缩视频扩散Transformer的宽度和深度，在保持生成质量的同时大幅减少计算量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer虽然能生成高质量视频，但计算开销巨大，现有方法采用固定的剪枝策略无法适应不同输入和去噪阶段，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 1) 宽度剪枝：设计区分空间和时间注意力头的重要性评分，防止运动关键的时间头被过早剪枝；2) 深度路由：训练轻量级路由器，根据去噪时间步和视觉内容动态选择每步执行的块，实现逐输入自适应计算；3) 渐进式流水线：先通过蒸馏恢复宽度剪枝后的质量，再联合优化学生模型和路由器。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-14B模型上，图像到视频和文本到视频生成任务均大幅降低每步计算量，同时保持VBench各维度的生成质量，且可与步蒸馏组合实现进一步加速。
AI.conclusion: PARE通过联合宽度和深度压缩实现了高效的视频生成，且自适应路由机制使得计算分配更具灵活性和输入感知能力。

title: Towards Controllable Image Generation through Representation-Conditioned Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful tools for high-quality image generation and editing, but guiding these models to produce specific outputs remains a challenge. Conventional approaches rely on conditioning mechanisms, such as text prompts or semantic maps, which require extensively annotated datasets. In this preliminary work, we explore diffusion models conditioned on representations from a pre-trained self-supervised model. The self-conditioning mechanism not only improves the quality of unconditional image generation, but also provides a representation space that can be used to control the generation. We explore this conditioning space by identifying directions of variations, and demonstrate promising properties in terms of smoothness and disentanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文初步探索了利用预训练自监督模型的表示来条件化扩散模型，无需大量标注数据，即可提升无条件图像生成质量并提供可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型依赖文本提示或语义图等条件机制，需要大量人工标注数据集；本文旨在探索一种无需标注的自监督条件化方法。
AI.method: 使用预训练自监督模型的表示作为扩散模型的条件，通过识别表示空间中的变化方向来控制生成过程。采用自条件化机制。
AI.result: 自条件化机制提升了无条件图像生成的质量；条件表示空间展现出平滑性和解缠性的优良性质。
AI.conclusion: 自监督条件化是一种有前景的范式，能在减少标注依赖的同时实现可控生成，但本研究仍处于初步阶段。

title: When Eyes Betray AI: Social Gaze Consistency as a Semantic Cue for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Recent generative models have largely closed the gap on low-level artifacts - pixel fingerprints, frequency anomalies, upsampling traces - particularly in person-centric and partial-edit settings where the manipulated region is small and surrounded by photometrically authentic content. We introduce Social Gaze Consistency, a high-level semantic cue defined as the mutual coherence of gaze direction, head-eye alignment, and pupil placement between interacting individuals, and show that it constitutes a previously underutilized detection axis orthogonal to existing low-level paradigms. We instantiate this insight through three coupled mechanisms: (i) a controlled diagnostic dataset with region-specific perturbations of gaze-consistent imagery, where strict pair-level grouping forecloses generator-fingerprint memorization as an optimization-time shortcut rather than relying on augmentation; (ii) Block-Compositional Caption Supervision, which holds a single 5-block reasoning skeleton invariant across 1,250 macro-combined captions, decoupling reasoning consistency from surface diversity; (iii) Cross-architecture validation showing the same supervision improves a vision-language backbone (FakeVLM) by +3.7 pp on the COCOAI Interaction subset (balanced accuracy 67.8 -> 71.5) and +1.3 pp on the COCOAI Person subset (83.0 -> 84.3), with consistent gains on a vision-only backbone (Effort), evidencing a backbone-agnostic cue. Real- and fake-class recalls rise simultaneously, ruling out a "predict-all-fake" artifact. A four-step mechanistic account - paired-edit shortcut blocking, hard-to-easy difficulty transfer, CLIP prior preservation, and diffusion-family shared spectral weakness in periocular structure - explains why training on a single inpainter (FLUX.1-Fill) transfers to multi-generator suites. We will release the code upon acceptance to facilitate reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出社交注视一致性（Social Gaze Consistency）作为检测生成图像的高级语义线索，通过块组合描述监督和配对编辑策略，在多个骨干网络上提升了伪造检测性能，并揭示了跨生成器迁移的机制。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型在低层级伪影（像素指纹、频率异常等）上已逼近真实，尤其是在人物中心和局部编辑场景中，伪造区域小而周围为真实内容，传统低层检测手段失效。因此需要一种高层语义线索来填补检测空白。
AI.method: （1）构建注视一致性的诊断数据集，采用严格配对的组级划分阻止生成器指纹记忆；（2）提出块组合描述监督（Block-Compositional Caption Supervision），用一个5块推理骨架覆盖1250条组合描述，分离推理一致性与表面多样性；（3）跨架构验证（视觉-语言模型FakeVLM和纯视觉模型Effort）证明该线索的骨干无关性。
AI.result: 在COCOAI Interaction子集上FakeVLM平衡准确率从67.8提升至71.5（+3.7 pp），在Person子集上从83.0提升至84.3（+1.3 pp），真实类与伪造类召回率同步提升，排除了"全部预测为伪造"的假象。
AI.conclusion: 社交注视一致性是一种有效的、与低层检测正交的高层伪造检测线索。四步机制解释（配对编辑捷径阻断、难易迁移、CLIP先验保持、扩散模型在眼周结构的频谱弱点）说明了在单一生成器上训练可迁移到多生成器场景。

title: Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation
summary: 3D editing is a fundamental capability for scalable 3D content creation. While image editing has rapidly evolved toward large-scale feedforward generative paradigms, 3D AI generation remains dominated by training-free editing pipelines. A central challenge of feedforward 3D editing lies in the lack of high-quality paired supervision. Editable 3D assets require simultaneous preservation of geometry, multi-view consistency, structural coherence, and localized edit controllability. Existing 3D editing datasets often rely on independently generated assets, image-mediated reconstruction or narrow edit taxonomies, leading to inaccurate localization, weak preservation, blurred edit boundaries, and limited semantic consistency. In this work, we introduce a new perspective: scalable feedforward 3D editing should be learned from semantic-part transformations. Based on this insight, we propose Pxform, a high-quality 3D editing dataset with over 100K consistent before/after editing pairs across seven edit types. Instead of treating objects as unstructured shapes, our pipeline grounds edits directly in semantic 3D parts. Built upon Pxform, we further propose PartFlow, a feedforward 3D editing network that injects source-aware latent control into pretrained 3D generative priors. PartFlow introduces mask-aware velocity preservation and render-space consistency supervision to jointly improve edit fidelity and source preservation, while requiring no 3D edit mask during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that high-quality semantic-part supervision substantially improves scalable 3D editing, enabling PartFlow to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both geometric and appearance editing benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pxform数据集和PartFlow网络，通过语义部件变换实现可扩展的前馈式3D编辑，在几何和外观编辑基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑缺乏高质量配对监督数据，导致定位不准确、源几何保持差、编辑边界模糊等问题，制约了前馈式3D编辑的发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建Pxform数据集：基于语义3D部件变换，生成10万+配对编辑样本，涵盖7种编辑类型；2) 提出PartFlow网络：将源感知隐式控制注入预训练3D生成先验，结合掩码感知速度保持和渲染空间一致性监督。
AI.result: 在几何和外观编辑基准上达到最先进性能，无需推理时提供3D编辑掩码。
AI.conclusion: 高质量语义部件监督能显著提升可扩展3D编辑能力，为前馈式3D编辑提供了新的研究视角。

title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) commonly formulate visual grounding and detection as a coordinate-token generation problem, serializing each 2D box into multiple 1D tokens that are learned and decoded largely independently. This token-by-token decoding mismatches the coupled structure of box geometry and creates a practical inference bottleneck due to strictly sequential generation. We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (PBD). By decoding geometric elements such as bounding boxes and points as atomic units in a single step, LocateAnything preserves intra-box geometric coherence and unlocks substantial parallelism. We show that PBD improves both decoding throughput and localization accuracy. We further develop a scalable data engine and curate LocateAnything-Data, a large-scale dataset with more than 138 million training samples, substantially increasing data diversity for high-precision localization. Extensive evaluations show that LocateAnything advances the speed-accuracy frontier, achieving significantly higher decoding throughput while improving high-IoU localization quality across diverse benchmarks. The results highlight the complementary benefits of Parallel Box Decoding and large-scale training data in enabling efficient and precise unified visual grounding and detection.

AI.tldr: LocateAnything提出并行框解码(PBD)方法，将边界框作为原子单元一次性解码，取代传统逐token序列生成方式，结合大规模数据集(1.38亿样本)，在视觉定位和目标检测中实现推理加速与精度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM将视觉定位和检测视为坐标token生成问题，逐token解码破坏了边界框的几何耦合结构，且串行生成造成推理瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出并行框解码(PBD)，将边界框和点等几何元素作为原子单元单步解码；构建LocateAnything-Data大规模数据集(1.38亿+样本)。
AI.result: PBD显著提升解码吞吐量和高IoU定位精度，在多个基准上取得速度-精度前沿突破。
AI.conclusion: 并行框解码与大规模训练数据在高效精确的统一视觉定位与检测中具有互补优势。

title: SpatialBench: Is Your Spatial Foundation Model an All-Round Player?
summary: While spatial foundation models have demonstrated impressive performance on standard datasets, a critical question remains: are they truly all-round players capable of generalizing robustly across diverse downstream tasks, arbitrary viewpoints, shifting scene domains, varying input densities, and specific hardware constraints? Answering this overarching question requires a holistic assessment, yet current models are mainly evaluated on specific domains for which they were specifically designed or trained. Such evaluations are intrinsically limited by narrow paradigm coverage, limited scene domains, and arbitrary frame sampling, making it fundamentally difficult to assess their true generalization capabilities. To address this gap, we present SpatialBench, a cross-paradigm, domain-diverse benchmark for spatial foundation models with deterministic sampling. SpatialBench features unprecedented scale and rigorous deterministic design, comprising 19 datasets and 546 scenes across 5 diverse spatial domains. It comprehensively evaluates 41 models across 6 paradigms on 5 task suites under 4 different input density settings. Our extensive evaluation reveals that current models are not yet all-round players, and uncovers crucial insights for future advancement. Specifically, we demonstrate that full-context attention maximizes accuracy while bounded-memory strategies unlock long-sequence scalability. Moreover, our empirical evaluations in challenging embodied and egocentric tasks demonstrate that strict domain alignment and high data quality are far more critical to performance than simple dataset scaling. Furthermore, to address the largest data gap identified in our analysis, we go beyond evaluation by introducing a large-scale dataset, DA-Next-5M, and a strong baseline model, DA-Next, pushing the boundaries of spatial representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpatialBench基准，系统评估了41个空间基础模型在6种范式、5个空间域、19个数据集上的泛化能力，发现当前模型尚未达到“全能选手”水平，并揭示了全上下文注意力与有界记忆策略的优劣，以及领域对齐和数据质量的重要性。同时引入DA-Next-5M数据集和DA-Next模型以弥补数据缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有空间基础模型多针对特定领域评估，难以衡量其跨任务、视点、场景域、输入密度和硬件约束的真实泛化能力，缺乏一个全面的、跨范式的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建SpatialBench基准，包含19个数据集、546个场景、5个空间域，采用确定性采样策略。系统评估41个模型（涵盖6种范式）在5个任务套件、4种输入密度设置下的表现。
AI.result: 当前模型尚未达到全能表现；全上下文注意力在精度上最优，而有界记忆策略在长序列可扩展性上更优；领域对齐和数据质量比简单数据规模扩展更重要。
AI.conclusion: SpatialBench揭示了空间基础模型的泛化瓶颈，为未来发展提供关键洞见；同时通过DA-Next-5M数据集和DA-Next基线模型，推动空间表示学习的前沿。

title: G3T Up! Gravity Aligned Coordinate Frames Simplify Pointmap Processing
summary: Modern feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods like VGGT predict pixel-aligned pointmaps in camera-centric coordinate frames. However, this choice of coordinate frame is not always optimal. We propose instead to predict pointmaps in upright, gravity-aligned frames that exploit strong structural cues present in many real-world scenes. Unlike camera-centric frames, gravity-aligned frames share a common vertical axis across viewpoints, reducing the rotational degrees of freedom needed to relate pointmaps to one another. To this end, we introduce the Gravity Grounded Geometry Transformer (G3T), fine-tuned from existing models on gravity-aligned 3D data. G3T produces highly accurate gravity-aware predictions, including upright pointmaps and camera-to-gravity poses. We further introduce G3T-Long, a submap-based incremental 3D reconstruction pipeline that leverages the reduced rotational degrees of freedom afforded by upright frames to achieve significantly improved reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出G3T模型，通过预测重力对齐的直立点图而非传统相机中心点图，利用场景中的结构先验，减少视角间旋转自由度，提升3D重建精度。同时引入G3T-Long增量重建管线，进一步优化长序列重建效果。
AI.motivation: 传统前馈3D重建方法（如VGGT）预测相机坐标系下的点图，但相机坐标系并非最优选择，特别是在现实场景中存在强结构先验（如重力方向）时，重力对齐的坐标系能更好地利用这些先验信息。
AI.method: 提出Gravity Grounded Geometry Transformer (G3T)，从现有模型微调得到，预测重力对齐的直立点图和相机到重力的姿态；并进一步提出G3T-Long，一种基于子图的增量式3D重建管线。
AI.result: G3T能生成高精度的重力感知预测；G3T-Long利用直立帧减少的旋转自由度，显著提升了重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 重力对齐的坐标系比传统相机中心坐标系更有利于3D重建，通过利用场景的结构先验可有效提升重建质量。
